jobs.title: Transit architect
jobs.description:
Als Arcadiaan help je bij het leveren van toonaangevende ontwerp-, engineering- en adviesdiensten. Je maakt deel uit van onze wereldwijde organisatie met 34.000 mensen in ruim 30 landen die zich inzetten om onze passie ‘improving quality of life’ ook echt tot leven te brengen. Iedereen speelt een belangrijke rol. Met de denkkracht van onze mensen in combinatie met technologie werken we aan het oplossen van ’s werelds meest complexe uitdagingen en maken samen het verschil.

Architectuur is overal om ons heen. De gebouwde omgeving bepaalt in grote mate de wereld waarin we leven. De architecten van Arcadis verrijken deze complexe leefomgeving met integrale en duurzame ontwerpoplossingen. Samen met onze klanten werken we aan projecten die een blijvende positieve impact hebben op huidige én toekomstige generaties.  
  
**Rolbeschrijving:**  
Als (medior) architect binnen Transit Architecture maak je deel uit van multidisciplinaire projectteams en geef je vorm aan een duurzame leefomgeving. Je werkt aan projecten door heel Nederland en mogelijk ook daarbuiten. Je weet jouw visie helder te verwoorden, te verbeelden en te vertalen naar kwalitatieve en haalbare oplossingen. Je analyseert de vraag van de klant en brengt samen met stakeholders de eisen en wensen in kaart. Vervolgens ontwikkel je samen met ervaren architecten een conceptontwerp, werk je dit technisch verder uit en breng je het visueel tot leven. Je werkt aan de renovatie en nieuwbouw van trein- en metrostations, maar ook aan uiteenlopende ontwerpopgaven zoals cultureel erfgoed, binnenstedelijke gebiedsontwikkelingen, multifunctionele gebouwen en de ruimtelijke inpassing en vormgeving van bruggen, tunnels en andere infrastructurele kunstwerken.

**Servicea area group Transit Architecture:**  
Binnen Transit Architecture bundelen we onze expertise op het gebied van trein- en metrostations. De groep bestaat uit architecten, bouwkundige ontwerpers en civieltechnische ontwerpers die samenwerken aan toonaangevende projecten in binnen- en buitenland. De afdeling telt circa 45 collega's, waaronder projectmanagers, projectbeheersers, technisch managers, contractspecialisten en ontwerpers. Het team kenmerkt zich door een sterke samenwerking, een informele sfeer en een gedeelde passie voor de gebouwde omgeving. Bij Arcadis hebben we vrijwel alle benodigde disciplines in huis. Daardoor kunnen we specialisten op het gebied van duurzaamheid, installatietechniek, landschapsarchitectuur, spoorinfrastructuur en vele andere vakgebieden direct aan projecten verbinden. Deze integrale aanpak stelt ons in staat om complexe ontwerpvraagstukken succesvol op te lossen en een breed scala aan projecten te realiseren. Amersfoort is onze thuisbasis, terwijl collega's daarnaast samenwerken vanuit de hub in Rotterdam.  
  
**Rolverantwoordelijkheden:**

* Je beheert zelfstandig (deel)projecten en zorgt ervoor dat deze worden gerealiseerd binnen de afgesproken planning, kwaliteit en financiële kaders;
* Je ontwikkelt architectonische ontwerpoplossingen en werkt deze uit in tekeningen, rapportages en andere projectdocumentatie;
* Je werkt nauw samen met opdrachtgevers, projectleiders en multidisciplinaire teams om integrale en kwalitatieve oplossingen te realiseren;
* Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van ontwerpen en zorgt voor naleving van relevante wet- en regelgeving, normen en Arcadis-richtlijnen;
Je begeleidt en coacht junior collega's en draagt actief bij aan kennisdeling en de ontwikkeling van het team.  

**Kwalificaties & Ervaring:**

* Afgeronde opleiding Architectuur aan een Technische Universiteit of Academie van Bouwkunst;
* Minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring als architect;
* Ervaring met het begeleiden en ondersteunen van junior collega's in hun vakinhoudelijke en professionele ontwikkeling;
* Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

Je voelt je comfortabel in een omgeving waarin ontwerp, techniek en stakeholdermanagement samenkomen. Kennis van ontwerpsoftware zoals Revit, AutoCAD, SketchUp en Adobe Creative Suite is geen must maar waardevol, net als jouw inschrijving in het Architectenregister. Bij Arcadis werken we wereldwijd. Afhankelijk van je ambitie bieden we jou dan ook graag de mogelijkheid om mee te werken aan internationale projecten.  
  
**Vervolg je carrière als Arcadiaan:**  
We bereiken onze doelen door iedereen in staat te stellen het beste uit zichzelf te halen. Wij geloven dat ieders bijdrage ertoe doet. Daarom pionieren we met een aanpak gebaseerd op jouw vaardigheden. Met jouw unieke ervaring en expertise stippel je zo je eigen carrièrepad uit. Samen maximaliseren we de impact! Jouw werk maakt het verschil. Waar je volgende rol bij Arcadis je ook brengt, je helpt duurzame oplossingen te bieden voor een gezondere planeet. Je drukt jouw stempel op je eigen carrière, je collega's, klanten, je leven en de wereld om je heen.  
  
**Together, we can create a lasting legacy:**  
Onze inzet voor gelijkheid, diversiteit, inclusie en erbij horen:  
We willen dat je elke dag je beste zelf kunt zijn. Gelijkheid en inclusie nemen we heel serieus en we houden onszelf verantwoordelijk voor onze acties. We willen een voorkeurswerkgever zijn en bieden iedereen een geweldige werkplek.

**Contactinformatie:**  
Wij ontvangen graag jouw CV en motivatiebrief via de Apply-button. Heb je vragen? Neem dan contact op met Femke van Viegen of TA- collega Jasper Kunstt.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description:
**Reports to an Engineering Manager · Remote (working hours within ±2 hours of CET)**

You'll own a slice of our platform outright, not just the tickets in it. Can you make the sound call, ship it, and leave the code healthier than you found it? Read on.

#### **Why this role exists**

We're growing Engineering's capacity. As the platform and team scale, we need engineers who can take a component and run with it independently — spotting risks early and raising the people around them.

#### **About C Teleport**

We move maritime, aviation, and energy crews around the world, automating high-stakes travel that used to be run by hand. We're a lean, international company: small squads, real ownership, decisions made close to the work.

#### **What you'll own**

* A component or a slice of the system, independently. Make the technical calls, keep it healthy, and know it well enough to catch problems before they become incidents.
* Production. Ship what you build and keep it running for real users, not just "done" in a ticket.
* Requirements, not just tickets. Turn a business need into a clear technical plan with Product, and flag gaps early.
* Raising the bar around you. Teach what you know, exchange feedback across the team, and document so your team isn't stuck without you.
* Your own delivery, reliably. Deliver what you commit to, and flag a slip early.
* Making the team's practices better. Improve a process, tool, or approach that no longer fits.

#### **Must-haves (these are gates)**

* You've independently owned a component or service in production — you made the calls, kept it healthy, and were accountable when something broke.
* You can turn a business requirement into a technical plan yourself, working directly with Product or another stakeholder.
* You mentor as you go; you can point to specific examples of raising another engineer's skill or judgment.
* You deliver what you commit to, and say so early when you won't.
* You're comfortable working within ±2 hours of CET, for real-time overlap with the team.
* 4+ years of hands-on .NET and C#, as your active day-to-day language.
* You actively use AI coding agents for implementation and code review. You can guide them effectively, critically assess their output, and take ownership of the resulting code.
* You apply OOD, TDD, SOLID, and CQRS deliberately; the right pattern, not just the first one.
* Strong analytical skills, proactive, and quick to pick up new concepts.

#### **Nice-to-haves (bonus, genuinely not required)**

* Experience working fully remote in a distributed team.
* A track record of landing a tool, pattern, or process change that became your team's standard.
* Experience owning a production incident end to end, including the postmortem and fix.
* Proficiency with NoSQL databases.
* Experience with message brokers (RabbitMQ or similar).
* Experience with Galileo, Amadeus, or other travel-industry APIs — a strong plus given our domain.

#### **This is not…**

* …an entry-level seat. You'll own a component early on, not a queue of pre-specified tickets.
* …a people-management role. No direct reports — your influence comes from your ownership and how much you raise the people around you.
* …the technical ceiling. The next step is Staff Software Engineer, owning a whole domain's technical direction. This is the runway to it.

#### **Remote and working hours**

Fully remote, with working hours within ±2 hours of CET/CEST for real-time overlap with the team.

#### **What you get**

* A remote-first setup, built for distributed work.
* A clear next step: Staff Software Engineer, owning a whole domain's direction.

#### **Hiring process**

* Recruiter / HR call — role, motivation, and logistics.
* Technical interview — a deep dive on how you've owned production systems, plus a technical exercise.
* Final call with the Engineering Manager you'd report to.

Target: ~2–3 weeks end to end.

#### **Pre-employment screening**

If your application is successful, we may conduct a pre-employment screening through a trusted third party, in line with applicable laws. This may include employment history, education, and other relevant publicly available information to help us understand your suitability for the role.

#### **Equal opportunity and privacy**

C Teleport is an equal-opportunity employer. We assess every application on merit and handle your data in line with GDPR.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Device Control
jobs.description:
Drive design and development of software components to control complex hardware.

#### **About Nearfield Instruments**

Nearfield Instruments (NFI) is a fast-growing scale-up high-tech company. We design, develop, integrate, market and service advanced metrology machines. Our machines enables our customers - the world’s leading chipmakers – to increase the production yields, and thus, functionality of their microchips, which in turn leads to smaller, more powerful consumer electronics.

Founded in 2016, we bring together the most creative minds (approx. 320 employees) in science and technology and develop a one-of-a-kind, revolutionary high throughput Scanning Probe Microscopy system.

Accelerating quality testing is essential for chipmakers to meet the soaring demand for computing capabilities. To meet this need, Nearfield Instruments has developed revolutionary metrology machines. As a (Senior) Software Engineer for Device Control, you will help us write software that drives these machines. Would you like to work at the forefront of metrology innovations while rapidly growing your career? Join us and experience the direct impact that your work has on our and our clients’ performance.

#### **Who you’ll be working with**

Within our Design & Engineering department this role is part of the Software Group. This SW Group consists of 5 teams (Architectural, Machine Control, Device Control, Data Science, Integration & Support).

You will join the Device Control team consisting of software engineers with a diverse range of knowledge such as embedded software, motion control and PLC software.

#### **What you’re going to do**

* Lead a wide range of software development aspects from design to production
* Collaborate closely with other disciplines such as mechatronics and production
* Design and implement software components to control complex hardware
* Write and maintain high quality, testable and efficient code
* Support our customer support and production engineers with their software related questions
* Initiate and promote new ideas for continuous improvement of the product
* Work independently and as a team member (sometimes on a global scale)

#### **Who you are**

* Education: Masters or Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems or a related field.
* Experience: A minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in software development with a strong foundation in Design/Architecture, Software Testing, and Software Integration.
* Knowledge: Machine Vision / Computer Vision, Object recognition and Signal Processing knowledge are a plus.
* Background: Previous experience in the semiconductors industry is also a plus.

#### **Skills:**

* Coding/Design/Quality: Proficient in C#, Python, with a deep understanding of OOP Design and Unit Testing.
* Source Control and Configuration: Hands-on experience with Git, as well as familiarity with Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) practices.
* Process and Tracking: Demonstrated experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and practical experience using Jira for project management and tracking.

#### **Apply for the job**

If the above challenges excites you, we encourage you to send us your details using the Apply now button on our career site.

**Our recruitment process:**

* Screening by Recruiter.
* Tech assignment.
* 1st interview ( Team Manager + Software Engineer).
* 2nd interview (HRBP + Director of D&E).
* Meeting our CEO.
* Offer.
* Onboarding and welcome at Nearfield Instruments!

If you have any questions? Feel free to contact me via:

#### **Recruitment, consultancy and/or other agency?**

We appreciate the interest, but we source all our candidates directly. We understand that you as an intermediary want to present candidates to our interesting positions. This is not how we have structured our recruitment.

This means that all profiles offered to Nearfield Instruments will be treated as direct applications. Unless we have explicitly agreed otherwise.

jobs.title: Director, Value Engineering
jobs.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

**About Celonis**
-----------------

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes.

The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and operational intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand—turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. By providing the essential business context that AI agents and tools need to act effectively, Celonis makes AI truly enterprise-ready.

Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global partner ecosystem to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together to achieve transformational outcomes. Headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, Celonis operates globally with over 20 offices worldwide.

**About the Role**
------------------

Based at our global headquarters in **Munich**, as a **Value Engineering Manager / Director** for **CPG & Retail**, you will hold full operational and leadership responsibility specifically for the **CPG & Retail segment across the DACH region**. In this role, you will lead a dedicated, high-performing team of 6–7 Value Engineers operating at the intersection of process transformation, executive consulting, and AI-driven product execution, driving the end-to-end customer value journey and accelerating enterprise AI adoption across major retail and consumer goods brands.

In this role, you will serve as a player-coach, actively guiding, coaching, and developing a talented, high-potential team with diverse backgrounds spanning supply chain, procurement, management consulting, and retail operations. This role offers tremendous growth potential as you both develop and learn alongside top-tier talent, while serving as a trusted advisor to C-level executives at major enterprise accounts.

**What Sets Our Patch Apart**
-----------------------------

The DACH CPG & Retail patch represents some of the world's most recognizable consumer brands, retail giants, and mobility innovators.

As our DACH CPG & Retail customers navigate complex global supply chains, omnichannel fulfillment challenges, and the rapid rise of Process Intelligence and Agentic AI, you will engage directly—in both German and English—with vocal customer champions, C-level decision-makers, and pioneering thought leaders shaping the future of retail and consumer goods innovation.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Drive Business Outcomes & Account Growth:** Take full ownership of ARR targets, renewal forecasts, and net retention across the DACH CPG & Retail sector. Ensure high forecasting accuracy and steer accounts toward tangible, realized value.
* **People Leadership & Coaching:** Recruit, onboard, lead, and mentor a team of 6–7 Munich-based Value Engineers. Maintain high standards through proactive coaching, performance management, and career progression planning.
* **Executive Advisory & Player-Coach:** Serve as a Celonis Executive Sponsor on critical DACH deals. Join your team in the field to lead high-impact executive meetings, dry runs, value sprints, and strategic transformation workshops.
* **Enterprise AI Champion:** Partner with customer executives to position Celonis as the foundation for modern process intelligence, digital operational excellence, and next-generation Agentic AI adoption using our Context Model and Digital Twin capabilities.
* **Ecosystem & Partner Strategy:** Cultivate executive-level relationships across regional partner networks, services teams, and account executives to align CPG and retail customer strategies with Celonis AI solutions.
* **Thought Leadership:** Standardize and scale best practices, reusable solution blueprints, and CPG/Retail industry-specific frameworks internally and across external customer communities.

**Leadership Behaviors We Value**
---------------------------------

* **Deliver Business Outcomes:** Focus on top- and bottom-line impact, maintaining green customer health and expanding retention across new logos and key enterprise accounts.
* **Motivate, Develop & Nurture Talent:** Build an inclusive, high-trust environment that attracts top-tier external talent, retains top performers, accelerates individual growth, and addresses underperformance early.
* **Lead by Example:** Embody the "player/coach" mentality, maintaining an active on-site presence with priority accounts and upholding strict quality standards across all engagements.
* **Think BIG, Be BOLD:** Champion an entrepreneurial growth mindset by expanding your internal/external network, spearheading new go-to-market motions, and positioning Celonis as an essential innovation driver in retail and consumer goods.

**Qualifications & Scope**
--------------------------

* **Language Skills:** Native or business-fluent **German** (spoken and written) and fluent **English** are required to interface effectively with executive decision-makers across the DACH market.
* **Location Presence:** Based in or willing to relocate to **Munich**, with willingness to travel to customer sites across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland as needed.
* **Proven Leadership Experience:** Track record leading pre-sales, management consulting, or value engineering teams within Enterprise SaaS, Enterprise AI, or Management Consulting.
* **Domain Expertise:** Deep domain familiarity with supply chain, procurement, fulfillment, and operational processes within the CPG & Retail industries.
* **People Management:** Demonstrated ability to directly manage or mentor a team of 6–7 high-performing individual contributors, with a strong passion for team coaching and talent development.
* **Commercial Acumen:** Strong business acumen with experience owning ACV, net retention, and renewal pipeline metrics.
* **Executive Presence:** Outstanding executive presence with a proven track record of building C-level relationships across global brands and regional retail leaders.

  

**What Celonis can offer you:**

* **Pioneer Innovation:** Work with the leading, award-winning process mining technology, shaping the future of business.
* **Accelerate Your Growth:** Benefit from clear career paths, internal mobility, a dedicated learning program, and mentorship opportunities.
* **Receive Exceptional Benefits:** Including generous PTO, hybrid working options, company equity (RSUs), comprehensive benefits, extensive parental leave, dedicated volunteer days, and much more. Interns and working students explore your benefits here.
* **Prioritize Your Well-being:** Access to resources such as gym subsidies, counseling, and well-being programs.
* **Connect and Belong:** Find community and support through dedicated inclusion and belonging programs.
* **Make Meaningful Impact:** Be part of a company driven by strong values that guide everything we do: Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future.
* **Collaborate Globally:** Join a dynamic, international team of talented individuals.
* **Empowered Environment:** Contribute your ideas in an open culture with autonomous teams.

  

**About Us:**  
Celonis makes processes work for people, companies and the planet. The Celonis Process Intelligence Platform uses industry-leading process mining and AI technology and augments it with business context to give customers a living digital twin of their business operation. It's system-agnostic and without bias, and provides everyone with a common language for understanding and improving businesses. Celonis enables its customers to continuously realize significant value across the top, bottom, and green line. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Job Description

Obwohl Slalom schon seit 2001 ein globaler Player ist, befinden wir uns in einer für unsere Branche besonderen Ausgangslage und werden nach wie vor von unseren Gründern geführt. Unser Ziel ist es, unsere Kunden mit allen nötigen Skills auszustatten, damit diese vollumfänglich hinter ihrer Reise in die Cloud stehen und nach dem erfolgreichen Abschluss der gemeinsamen Projekte diese Veränderung eigenständig und nachhaltig leben. Man könnte fast sagen: „wir kommen, um zu gehen“.

**Milestones**

Mehr als 12.000 Slalomer:innen. Acht Länder. 45 Standorte. Und stetiges, schnelles Wachstum. In Deutschland haben wir unseren ersten Standort 2022 in München eröffnet, Düsseldorf und Frankfurt folgten in 2023 und 2024. Das Team ist auf über 150 Mitarbeiter:innen angewachsen und wird sich auch im Jahr 2026 stetig vergrößern.

Who will you join?
  
  
As part of Global Sustainability (GS) at Allianz, you will join an international team of sustainability and business experts and work in the team responsible for Sustainability Integration and Climate change mitigation. The team works with all Allianz business segments on strategic Sustainability priorities.
  
In this role, you will drive the implementation of Allianz's sustainability strategy, with a particular focus on climate change mitigation, and sustainability-related growth opportunities. Working across Group Centers, Operating Entities and business segments, you will support the delivery of Allianz's Net-Zero Transition Plan and related sustainability commitments, ensuring effective coordination, stakeholder engagement and execution. The role combines strategic thinking, business engagement and strong delivery to translate sustainability ambitions into tangible business outcomes and support long-term value creation.
  
  
How can you make an impact?
  
  

* Climate Mitigation Strategy: Shape and strengthen the further development of the climate mitigation strategy as part of the overall Allianz Group Sustainability strategy in close collaboration with Business and Group functions, taking into account Allianz's commitments (e.g. Net-Zero Transition Plan), technological, political regulatory developments, as well as external stakeholder requirements
* 2030 intermediate targets: Contribute to the strategy delivery incl. implementation of related 2030 intermediate targets (with particular focus on Proprietary Investments and Asset Management) and strategic initiatives required to achieve them
* Link to wider Climate Strategy: Support integration of climate mitigation adaptation efforts in close collaboration with teams within/outside of GS, as well as identify, set up and leverage relevant external partnerships to strengthen the wider Sustainability/ climate ecosystem
* Growth Strategy: Shape and contribute to the Sustainability/ climate growth strategy and related initiatives together with the wider GS function, as well as Business / OE stakeholders (mainly Proprietary Investments and/ or Asset Management) to strengthen business impact
* Cross-Functional Orchestration: Support in delivering on the GS mandate for orchestrating consistent and impactful sustainability action across the entire organization by acting as interface between GS, Group Centers, Business Divisions / OEs and other decision-making committees at Allianz SE on sustainability matters
* Stakeholder Engagement: Contribute to engagement with a diverse group of internal and external stakeholders (e.g. NGOs, investors, customers, media, external partners), incl. governance bodies to drive consistent and impactful sustainability action across Allianz
* OE engagement on Business Value Impact: Actively engage with and support Allianz Operating Entities in driving value and impact of sustainability initiatives for the business

* Ability to perform in a dynamic, changing environment
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Outlook)
* Excellent presentation and interpersonal skills
* International experience is an asset
* MBA or Masters Degree
* Previous experience in insurance or asset management business functions, consulting, digital / tech is a plus

jobs.title: Software-Engineer / IT-Consultant (m/w/d) in Wetzlar
jobs.description:
**Werde Teil unseres Teams und revolutioniere die Produktionsplanung!**

Die Asprova GmbH ist die europäische Niederlassung des renommierten japanischen Softwarehauses Asprova Corp. mit Sitz in Wetzlar. Unsere Lösung ist die weltweit führende Software für Advanced Planning and Scheduling (APS) und somit das erfolgreichste Planungssystem für die produzierende Industrie. Von Wetzlar aus betreuen wir viele Kunden und Händler in Deutschland und Europa. Unter den weltweit mehr als 4.000 Kunden befinden sich viele namhafte Unternehmen.

**Wir suchen starke Persönlichkeiten, die unser Beratungs- und Implementierungsteam langfristig unterstützen. Berufsanfänger sind bei uns herzlich willkommen.**

**Deine Aufgaben nach einer ausführlichen Einarbeitungsphase:**

* **Implementierung & Beratung:** Du begleitest nationale und internationale Industrieunternehmen bei der Einführung unserer APS-Software und unterstützt sie dabei, ihre Produktionsplanung effizienter, transparenter und zukunftssicher zu gestalten.
* **Customizing:** Du erstellst kundenspezifische Anwendungserweiterungen und passt die Software perfekt an.
* **Lean & Produktionsplanung:** Du baust bei uns ein fundiertes Wissen in Lean-Produktion und Lean-Management auf und lernst, wie moderne Produktions- und Planungsprozesse effizient gestaltet und kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden.
* **Wissensvermittlung:** Du führst Anwenderschulungen durch und unterstützt unsere Kunden bei technischen Fragen und der optimalen Nutzung von Asprova.
* **Projektleitung:** Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für nationale und internationale Softwareprojekte.
* **Prozessoptimierung:** Du entwickelst unsere Implementierungsmethoden und Projektmanagement-Tools strategisch weiter.
* **Vertriebsunterstützung:** Du stehst unserem Vertrieb bei komplexen technischen Fragestellungen beratend zur Seite.

**Das bringst Du mit:**

* **Fundierte Basis:** Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Ingenieurswissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
* **Tech-Stack:** Gute Programmierfähigkeiten in mindestens einer der folgenden Sprachen: C++, C# oder VB.NET).
* **Nice-to-have:** Kenntnisse in SQL oder REST API sowie eine gute Allgemeinbildung.
* **Arbeitsweise:** Eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe, ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke, lösungsorientiertes Handeln und Freude an Teamarbeit.
* **Sprachkompetenz:** Für die Beratung unserer Kunden sind verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau erforderlich.
* **Reisebereitschaft:** Anders als bei vielen Beratungsunternehmen liegt unsere Reisetätigkeit bei durchschnittlich 10% und ermöglicht eine ausgezeichnete Vereinbarung von Beruf und Privatleben.

**Das bieten wir Dir:**

* **Echte Teamkultur statt Video-Call-Einsamkeit:** Bei uns implementieren und beraten wir im direkten Austausch. Wir schätzen kurze Entscheidungswege am Schreibtisch.
* **Selbstständig arbeiten, gemeinsam stark:** Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben und Projekte und kannst dabei jederzeit auf ein erfahrenes und hilfsbereites Team zurückgreifen.
* **Erstklassige Vor-Ort-Bedingungen:** Dich erwartet ein moderner, ergonomisch und klimatisiert eingerichteter Arbeitsplatz mit High-End-Hardware.
* **Nachhaltige Mobilität:** Freue dich über unser JobRad-Leasing. Nach einigen erfolgreichen Jahren ist auch ein Firmenwagen möglich:
* **Gesundheit & Vorsorge:** Wir fördern dich mit dem EGYM Wellpass sowie einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge.
* **Finanzielle Attraktivität:** Neben einem attraktiven Grundgehalt profitierst du von jährlichen Bonuszahlungen.
* **Flexible Arbeitszeiten:** Dank unseres Gleitzeitmodells bei geregelten Strukturen kannst du deinen Feierabend verlässlich planen.
* **Sicherheit & Entwicklung:** Freue dich auf einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz mit langfristiger Perspektive und Entwicklungschancen in einem internationalen Umfeld.

**Haben wir Dein Interesse geweckt?**

Dann freuen wir uns darauf dich kennenzulernen. Sende uns einfach deine Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Anschreiben, Lebenslauf und Zeugnissen per E-Mail an: **karriere@asprova.eu** oder bewirb dich direkt über unsere Homepage: https://www.asprova.eu/offene-stellen/**.**

Charlotte-Bamberg-Straße 4  
35578 Wetzlar

* Betriebliche Weiterbildung

jobs.title: New Product Introduction Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Die Rolle verantwortet die Planung und Steuerung der Industrialisierung neuer Produkte vom Prototyp bis zur Serienproduktion. Im Fokus stehen dabei die standortübergreifende Koordination von Entwicklung, Produktion und Beschaffung, inklusive Launch- und Änderungsmanagement, Ressourcen- und Investitionsplanung sowie Lean Manufacturing.

### **Aufgaben**

* Organisation der Fertigung von Prototypen (Beschaffung, Produktion, Entwicklung)
* Sicherstellen der interdisziplinären und standortübergreifenden Kommunikation zwischen den Fachabteilungen Beschaffung, Produktion und Entwicklung
* Unterstützung im Bereich des Änderungsmanagements auf Produkt- und Prozessebene
* Definition und Aufsetzen von Prozessen im Bereich der Einführung von neuen Produkten in die Serienproduktion (Launch Managements)
* Abstimmen von Schnittstellenfunktionen zwischen den Fachabteilungen Beschaffung, Produktion und Entwicklung
* Koordination der Definition von Anforderungen an Produktionsstätten
* Erstellen einer bedarfsgerechten Ressourcenplanung, Planung und Kalkulation der nötigen Investitionen für Anlagentechnik, Peripherie, Anlaufkosten sowie des operativen Personalbedarfs (Total Cost of Ownership)
* Einführung von neuen Produkten in nationalen und internationalen Produktionsstätten
* Aufsetzten, Aktualisieren und Sicherstellen von Projektplänen und Projektzielen
* Einhaltung von Prinzipien Lean Manufacturing und Design to Manufacturing

### **Qualifikationen**

* Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes technisches oder kaufmännisches Studium oder vergleichbare Ausbildung (z.B. Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder Vergleichbares)
* Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projektmanagement
* Ausgeprägtes strategisches Denken
* Tiefgreifendes technisches und wirtschaftliches Verständnis
* Fähigkeit, komplexe Situationen zu kontrollieren, den Fokus nicht zu verlieren und eine zielgerichtete Prioritätensetzung durchzuführen
* Hohes Kosten- und Qualitätsbewusstsein und lösungsorientiertes Denken
* Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
* Strukturierte Arbeitsweise im Team sowie eigenverantwortlich
* Hands-on Mentalität und Flexibilität
* Reisebereitschaft national und international
* Selbständige, dynamische Arbeitsweise, Verhandlungsgeschick, Durchsetzungsvermögen und Belastbarkeit
* Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch

### **What we offer**

* A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
* Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
* Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
* Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
* Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
* Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

### **About us**

**Agile Robots SE** is an international high-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than **3500** employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state-of-the-art force-moment-sensing and world-leading image-processing technology. This unique combination of technologies allows us to provide user-friendly and affordable robotic solutions that enable intelligent precision assembly.

This is made possible by our employees, who bring out the best in each and every day with creativity and enthusiasm. Become part of this team and shape the future of robotics with us!

We are proud of our diversity and welcome your application regardless of gender and sexual identity, nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, or disability.

jobs.title: (Senior) Full Stack Softwareentwickler (m/w/d) – B2B-Webshop
jobs.description:
**Spannend, aufstrebend und verdammt schnell – wir sind flaschenpost!**

Wir liefern den Wocheneinkauf innerhalb von 120 Minuten zu unseren Kund:innen.

Gemeinsam mit über 20.000 Kolleg:innen schaffen wir es, eine komplette Branche neu zu erfinden. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2016 sind wir mittlerweile als Sofortlieferdienst für Getränke und Lebensmittel in nahezu allen Metropolregionen Deutschlands vertreten.

Seit 2020 ist die flaschenpost Teil der Oetker-Gruppe.

### **(Senior)****Full****Stack Softwareentwickler (m/w/d) – B2B-Webshop**

Um unsere Mission zu erfüllen, suchen wir für unseren **B2B-Webshop** zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen **Fullstack****Software Entwickler (m/w/d)**. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinem neuen Team den B2B-Webshop weiter und trägst zum Wachstum unseres B2B-Kundenbereichs bei.

### **Dein Liefergebiet:**

* Du entwickelst neue Features für unseren B2B-Webshop – von der Idee über die Architektur bis zum Go-Live.

* Du arbeitest entlang der gesamten Customer Journey unserer B2B-Kund:innen – von Registrierung und Produktentdeckung über Warenkorb und Checkout bis hin zu Self-Service-Funktionalitäten.

* Du übernimmst Verantwortung für technische Entscheidungen, sorgst für eine saubere Architektur und treibst technische Exzellenz im Team voran.

* Du unterstützt bei der Anbindung von neuen Business Kunden über ERP-Systeme.

* Du arbeitest eng mit den Fachbereichen zusammen, um fachliche Anforderungen in skalierbare technische Lösungen zu übersetzen.

* Du unterstützt deine Kolleg:innen als Sparringspartner:in, z.B. bei Code-Reviews, Pair Programming und bei der Weiterentwicklung der Team-Standards.

* Tech-Stack: .NET 8, Entity-Framework, Blazor

### **Das hast du im Sortiment:**

*Die folgenden Qualifikationen stellen lediglich eine Orientierung dar. Du erkennst dich in den Punkten wieder oder hast Lust, dich in diese einzuarbeiten? Gerne geben wir auch**Quereinsteiger:innen**mit IT-Begeisterung und Motivation die Chance bei uns einzusteigen!*

* Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Fullstack-Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise in E‑Commerce- oder B2B-Webapplikationen.

* Du besitzt gute Kenntnisse in der Frontend-Entwicklung, vorzugsweise Blazor, und bist motiviert, deine eigenen Ideen in das Design des B2B-Webshops einzubringen und umzusetzen.

* Du verfügst über gute Kenntnisse im Bereich Datenbanken, idealerweise MS-SQL und Entity Framework

* Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für Softwarearchitektur, Clean Code, Testing und wartbare, skalierbare Systeme.

* Du arbeitest gerne cross-funktional in einem agilen Umfeld (Scrum/Kanban) und bringst dich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen und Teamkultur ein.

* Du kommunizierst klar und wertschätzend – auf Deutsch fühlst du dich sicher, Englisch ist für dich in technischen Kontexten kein Problem.

### **Die Top-Angebote der flaschenpost:**

* **Work-Life Balance**– Gestalte deinen Arbeitstag flexibel nach deinen Vorstellungen und genieße die Freiheit des mobilen Arbeitens

* **Job-Ticket & Business-Bike** – Damit nicht nur die Arbeitszeit flexibel ist

* **Start-Up-Features**– Genieße Freigetränke und die ein oder andere Partie Kicker oder Tischtennis als Ausgleich zur Arbeit

* **Flaschenpost Learning** – Erstelle deine persönliche Learning Journey und erweitere dein Know-how durch vielfältige und innovative Trainings

* **Buddy Programm** – Dein flaschenpost-Buddy steht dir während der Einarbeitung mit Rat und Tat zur Seite

* **Modernste Technik** – Wir legen großen Wert auf Fortschritt und Innovation

* **Team- und Networking-Events**– Halte dich fit und lerne deine Kolleg:innen beim Betriebssport, Spieleabend und Stammtisch besser kennen

* **Corporate Benefits** – Profitiere von Rabatten und Angeboten in Online-Shops und Fitnessstudios

* **Social****Responsiveness** – Blutspenden während der Arbeitszeit und damit Leben retten

Wir haben dich überzeugt und du möchtest unseren Erfolg aktiv mitgestalten? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung über unser Onlineformular.

jobs.title: Cooling Flow System and Clearance Design Engineer (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
**Momentaufnahme von Ihrem Tag**

Als Cooling Flow System and Clearance Design Engineer (w/m/d) arbeiten Sie in einem internationalen Team von Ingenieuren an Projekten zur Entwicklung von Service-Upgrades und neuen Produkten sowie zur Unterstützung unserer Serviceorganisation. Typischerweise arbeiten Sie zusammen mit Projektmanagern, Komponenten-Ingenieuren und Kollegen aus Produktion und Service.  
Sie bearbeiten Ihre individuellen Aufgaben eigenständig und stimmen die Prioritäten gemeinsam innerhalb eines globalen Teams ab.

**Wie Sie etwas bewirken können**

  

* Anwendung von interner und kommerzieller Berechnungssoftware für:
* + Erstellung von Berechnungsmodellen zur Beschreibung der Kühlluftversorgung von Heißgaskomponenten in einer Gasturbine und Auswertung der entsprechenden Ergebnisse
  + Erstellung von Berechnungsmodellen zur Beschreibung der transienten Erwärmung und thermischen Ausdehnung der gesamten Gasturbine sowie Bestimmung optimaler Montage-Spalte zwischen rotierenden und stationären Komponenten
  + Auswertung der Modellergebnisse und Ableitung von konstruktionsrelevanten Schlussfolgerungen
* Mitarbeit bei der konzeptionellen Entwicklung des Sekundärluftsystems und zugehöriger Gasturbinenkomponenten
* Auswertung von Betriebsdaten und Erkenntnissen aus Prototypen und der bestehenden Flotte

**Was Sie mitbringen**

* Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Masterstudium im Bereich Maschinenbau oder vergleichbar; Promotion von Vorteil
* Langjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Wärmeübertragung und Strömungsmechanik sowie idealerweise mit Kühlluftsystemen und Spaltkonstruktion für Gasturbinen
* Gute technische Kenntnisse im Maschinenbau oder in der Energietechnik, idealerweise in der Entwicklung, Auslegung und Integration komplexer technischer Systeme
* Kenntnisse in der Anwendung numerischer Software (z. B. Ansys, Abaqus, NX, StarCCM etc.) wie von Programmiersprachen (Visual Basic, C#, Fortran, Python) sind von Vorteil
* Kenntnisse in Machine Learning, datengetriebenen Methoden und deren Anwendung auf technische bzw. physikalische Fragestellungen sind von Vorteil
* Interkulturelle Arbeitserfahrung in globalen Teams ist ebenso von Vorteil wie gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

**Über das Team**

Unser Geschäftsbereich Gas Services bietet emissionsarme Stromerzeugung durch Service und Dekarbonisierung. Emissionsfreie oder emissionsarme Stromerzeugung und alle Gasturbinen unter einem Dach, Dampfturbinen und Generatoren. Dekarbonisierungschancen durch Serviceangebote, Modernisierung und Digitalisierung der Flotte.

**Wer ist Siemens Energy?**  
  
Wir bei Siemens Energy sind mehr als nur ein Energietechnologieunternehmen. Mit ~100,000 engagierten Mitarbeitern in mehr als 90 Ländern entwickeln wir die Energiesysteme der Zukunft und stellen sicher, dass der wachsende Energiebedarf der Weltgemeinschaft zuverlässig und nachhaltig gedeckt wird. Die in unseren Forschungsabteilungen und Fabriken entstehenden Technologien treiben die Energiewende voran und bilden die Grundlage für ein Sechstel der weltweiten Stromerzeugung.
  
  
Unser globales Team setzt sich dafür ein, nachhaltige, zuverlässige und bezahlbare Energie Wirklichkeit werden zu lassen, indem es die Grenzen des Möglichen immer weiter hinausschiebt. Wir blicken zurück auf eine 150-jährige Tradition der Innovation, die unsere Suche nach Mitarbeitern bestärkt, die unseren Fokus auf Dekarbonisierung, neue Technologien und Energiewandel unterstützen.
  
  
Hier erfahren Sie, wie Sie bei Siemens Energy etwas bewirken können: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

**Unser Engagement für Vielfalt**  
  
Gut, dass wir nicht alle gleich sind. Vielfalt macht uns leistungsstark. Wir leben von Inklusion und unsere gemeinsame kreative Energie wird von über 130 Nationalitäten gespeist. Siemens Energy setzt auf den Charakter - unabhängig von ethnischem Hintergrund, Geschlecht, Alter, Religion, Identität oder Behinderung. Wir versorgen die Gesellschaft mit Energie - die ganze Gesellschaft - und wir diskriminieren nicht aufgrund von Unterschieden, die zwischen uns bestehen.  
  
**Benefits**

* Neben einem attraktiven, marktgerechten Vergütungspaket erwartet Sie eine attraktive arbeitgeberfinanzierte betriebliche Altersversorgung
* Daneben bieten wir die Möglichkeit, zu sehr interessanten Mitarbeiterkonditionen Aktionär\*in von Siemens Energy zu werden
* Unter unserem Motto #BetterTogether bieten wir unseren Mitarbeitenden die Möglichkeit, flexibel und auch remote zu arbeiten. Aber auch unsere Büros lassen keine Wünsche offen und bieten Raum für inspirierende Zusammenarbeit und Kreativität
* Die berufliche und auch persönliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Mitarbeitenden ist uns ein großes Anliegen. Sie haben bei uns die Möglichkeit selbstbestimmt zu lernen und sich zu entwickeln. Dafür stehen unterschiedliche attraktive Programme und Maßnahmen zur Verfügung
Unter dem Aspekt "Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Beruf" haben wir ein vielfältiges Angebot, z.B. flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, Kinderbetreuungsplätze an vielen Standorten, die Möglichkeit zur Schnupperteilzeit oder auch ein Sabbatical  

Wir legen Wert auf Chancengleichheit, deswegen sind Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung ausdrücklich gewollt.

jobs.title: 2027 Software Dev Engineer Intern - Germany
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Please note the role is available across multiple locations in Germany.  
  
Do you want to solve real customer problems through innovative technology? Do you enjoy working on scalable services in a collaborative team environment? Do you want to see your code directly impact millions of customers worldwide?
  
  
At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. Customer obsession is part of our company DNA, which has made us one of the world's most beloved brands.
  
  
Our Software Development Engineer (SDE) interns use modern technology to solve complex problems while seeing their work's impact first-hand. The challenges SDE interns solve at Amazon are meaningful and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products globally. We seek individuals passionate about creating new products, features, and services while managing ambiguity in an environment where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years.
  
  
At Amazon, we believe in ownership at every level. As an SDE intern, you'll own the entire lifecycle of your code - from design through deployment and ongoing operations. This ownership mindset, combined with our commitment to operational excellence, ensures we deliver the highest quality solutions for our customers.
  
  
We're looking for curious minds who think big and want to define tomorrow's technology. At Amazon, you'll grow into the high-impact engineer you know you can be, supported by a culture of learning and mentorship. Every day brings exciting new challenges and opportunities for personal growth.
  
  
Amazon internships across all seasons are full-time positions, and interns should expect to work in office, Monday-Friday, up to 40 hours per week typically between 8am-5pm. Specific team norms around working hours will be communicated by your manager. Interns should not have conflicts such as classes or other employment during the Amazon work-day. Applicants should have a minimum of one quarter/semester/trimester remaining in their studies after their internship concludes.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Collaborate and communicate effectively with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to design, build, and operate innovative products and services that delight our customers, while participating in technical discussions to drive solutions forward.
  
  
Break down complex, ambiguous problems into well-defined, solvable components before implementation.
  
  
Contribute to the design and development of scalable, reliable services, with distributed-systems scope varying by team.
  
  
Participate in code reviews as a core engineering practice, providing constructive feedback and validating correctness.
  
  
Contribute to clear and accurate technical documentation.
  
  
Use GenAI and AI-powered tools to enhance development productivity, and critically validate, verify, and integrate AI-generated code, exercising sound judgement about when to trust AI output.
  
  
Write clean, maintainable code following best practices and design patterns.
  
  
Work in an agile environment practicing CI/CD principles while participating in operational responsibilities including on-call duties.
  
  
Demonstrate operational excellence through monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving production issues.
  
  
A day in the life  
As an intern, you will be matched to a manager and a mentor and will have the opportunity to influence the evolution of Amazon technology and lead critical projects early in your career.
  
  
In addition to working on an impactful project, you will have the opportunity to engage with Amazonians for both personal and professional development, expand your network, and participate in activities with other interns throughout your internship. No matter the location of your internship, we give you the tools to own your project and learn in a real-world setting.
  
  
About the team  
Intern Community:  
  
As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a vibrant, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.  
  
Support:  
  
The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.  
  
Learning Sessions:  
  
Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's cutting-edge learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.  
  
Opportunities:  
  
Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or related STEM fields
* Experience with at least one general-purpose programming language such as Java, Python, C++, C#, Go, Rust, or TypeScript
* Knowledge of computer science fundamentals such as object-oriented design, operating systems, algorithms, data structures, and complexity analysis

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience from previous technical internship(s) or demonstrated project experience
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools in academic or professional settings
* Experience with Cloud platforms (preferably AWS), database systems (SQL and NoSQL), AI tools for development productivity, contributing to open-source projects, and/or version control systems
* Strong problem decomposition, problem-solving, and analytical skills
* Demonstrated ownership and initiative in seeing work through from design to operation
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Demonstrated ability to learn and adapt to new technologies quickly

  
Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  
  
m/w/d  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer

Are you a qualified Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer looking for excellent earning potential, structured work and the security of working directly for an established energy supplier?

At Utilita, we're growing our award-winning Field Services team. Join one of the UK's fastest-growing energy suppliers and a business that has been recognised as one of the UK's Top 50 Best Workplaces for four consecutive years.

What is in it for you?

You'll receive a base salary of £38,993, alongside uncapped earning potential and a variety of opportunities to boost your overall earnings, including:

* **On-call payment:** Receive £330 for each on-call week, based on an average rota of one week in five. (OTE of £42,293 just with the base salary and conducting mandatory on call requirements)
* **Industry-leading installation bonus:** Benefit from an uncapped installation bonus of £25 per meter or £50 per dual installation once you have completed a minimum of four installations in a day, with additional work opportunities available to further enhance your earnings.

jobs.title: Senior Estimator – Civil Engineering
jobs.description:
**About the role**

**Job Title**: Senior Estimator – Civil Engineering

**Location:** Balfour Beatty Maxim Business Park Eurocentral

**Company:** Balfour Beatty

**Project:** SCAPE Framework

**Build your future with Balfour Beatty**

Balfour Beatty is looking for an experienced Senior Civils Estimator to join our civil engineering work-winning team and support the successful delivery of projects through the SCAPE framework.

This is more than a traditional estimating position. It is a genuine career-development opportunity, created as part of our longer-term succession planning. You will be given the support, exposure and responsibility needed to continue developing your technical, commercial and leadership capabilities, with a clear opportunity to progress into a more senior role within the estimating and work-winning function.

We are looking for someone with approximately 8–10 years of project-focused civil engineering estimating experience who is ready to take the next significant step in their career.

 **What you'll be doing**

**Key Responsibilities**

You will take ownership of the estimating and tendering process for a varied portfolio of civil engineering projects, working closely with operational, commercial, design and supply-chain teams.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Reviewing tender enquiries, scopes of work and commercial requirements.
* Producing accurate estimates from first principles for earthworks, drainage, concrete, reinforcement and formwork.
* Completing quantity take-offs from drawings, specifications and schedules.
* Developing bills of quantities, schedules of rates and material requirements.
* Assessing construction methodologies, temporary works, plant, labour and site-resource requirements.
* Preparing and issuing subcontract and supplier enquiries.
* Interrogating supply-chain quotations, identifying exclusions, omissions and commercial risks.
* Attending pre-tender meetings, site visits and client discussions.
* Producing tender summaries, qualifications and supporting submission documents.
* Supporting tender adjudications and agreeing the final tender price with senior leadership.
* Assisting with post-tender reviews, contract handovers and project kick-off meetings.
* Sharing knowledge and supporting the development of less-experienced estimators

  
**Who we're looking for**

**About you**

You will bring strong estimating experience gained across project-focused civil engineering environments, ideally covering areas such as:

* Roads and highways.
* Bridge construction.
* Public-realm improvements.
* Structural concrete.
* Coastal defence.
* Infrastructure and civil engineering frameworks.

You should also have:

* Approximately 8–10 years’ civil engineering estimating experience.
* The ability to price work accurately from first principles.
* Experience of the NEC suite of contracts.
* Knowledge of highways methods of measurement and CESMM.
* Experience pricing civil engineering projects of varying size and complexity.
* A good understanding of temporary works and associated costs.
* Confidence using estimating software, Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word.
* The ability to manage competing deadlines with minimal supervision.
* Strong communication skills and the confidence to engage with clients, operational teams and supply-chain partners.

**A role designed around your development**

This position offers the opportunity to work on visible and varied SCAPE projects while learning from experienced leaders across our work-winning and operational teams.

As part of our succession-planning strategy, we want to appoint someone who has the ambition and potential to take on greater responsibility over time. You will receive structured support to develop your leadership skills, strengthen your commercial decision-making and build the experience required for future progression within Balfour Beatty.

**Why join us?**

You will be joining a collaborative business where your ideas, experience and career ambitions will be valued. Alongside the opportunity to work on meaningful civil engineering projects, you will benefit from the scale, expertise and long-term career opportunities available across Balfour Beatty.

**Ready to take the next step in your estimating career? Apply today and help us shape the next generation of civil engineering projects and estimating leadership.**

**Professional and personal development**

The size and scale of Balfour Beatty coupled with our strong pipeline of work provides incredible opportunities, regardless of what stage you are at in your career.

We encourage and empower our employees to take control of their career and explore which part of the business they want to work in and what role is right for them. We actively encourage our managers and employees to have open communication throughout the year about wellbeing, development and career opportunities.

We're proud of the Balfour Beatty Academy. Whether it’s sharpening your technical expertise, improving your personal skills or seeking support to become professionally qualified, our 70:20:10\* approach to development means we have a learning approach that suits everyone.

* 70% learning on the job, 20% learning from those around you, and 10% formal training courses and learning events.

**For further information about Balfour Beatty Scotland please go to www.balfourbeatty.com/ Scotland - You can also check out further job opportunities in the careers section**

**Why work for us**

Day in, day out, our teams deliver some of the UK’s most ambitious, exciting and meaningful projects; developing, building and maintaining the vital infrastructure that supports national economies and strengthens communities.

**Why join us?**

As if contributing to and supporting work that makes life better for millions wasn’t rewarding enough, we offer a full range of benefits too. You’ll have the freedom to shape the package that’s right for you and your life. Here are some of our key benefits:

* Smart working, giving you more flexibility such as staggered start and finish times, with up to 40% remote working, where roles allow.
* 25 days paid annual leave (pro rata)
* Family friendly policies which include 28 weeks full pay for maternity/adoption leave and four weeks full pay for paternity/partners leave
* Pension, share incentive plan, volunteering leave, recognition schemes and much more…

 **About us**

From Dunfermline’s tramways in 1909 to highland hospitals today, Balfour Beatty has been trusted for over a century to deliver the complex and critical infrastructure and iconic buildings Scotland relies on.

We have the people, knowledge and experience to safely deliver projects right first time, maximising value for money and ensuring a positive social impact and inclusive economic growth for local communities.

Our award-winning sustainable projects, including active travel, Passivhaus and retrofit, demonstrate our commitment to supporting Scotland’s transition towards net zero in the built environment.

**Diversity and inclusion**

At Balfour Beatty we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential components of any successful, happy workplace. jobs.title: AI/CoPilot Senior Engineer
jobs.description:
**AI/ CoPilot Senior Engineer- Manager (Level 7)**  
**Location: London**  
**Salary: Competitive salary package depending on experience**  
**Career Level: Manager (Level 7)**

Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services in strategy and consulting, interactive, technology and operations, with digital capabilities across all of these services. With our thought leadership and culture of innovation, we apply industry expertise, diverse skill sets and next-generation technology to each business challenge.

We believe in inclusion and diversity and supporting the whole person. Our core values comprise of Stewardship, Best People, Client Value Creation, One Global Network, Respect for the Individual and Integrity. Year after year, Accenture is recognized worldwide not just for business performance but for inclusion and diversity too.

“Across the globe, one thing is universally true of the people of Accenture: We care deeply about what we do and the impact we have with our clients and with the communities in which we work and live. It is personal to all of us.” – **Julie Sweet, Accenture CEO**

**As a team:**

We have an exciting opportunity for a Data Architecture Manager to join our Data & AI practice. We deliver scalable, business-critical and end-to-end data solutions for our clients - from data strategy/governance to Core Engineering, enabling them to transform and work in Cloud Technologies.

The Data Architecture Practice at Accenture’s mission is to define and own Data Architecture vision for our clients, providing architecture enablers for innovative data and AI capabilities driving multiplier value for the business. We design and architect modern data platforms and automate cloud data migration to help clients scale AI for digital core and explore new data driven business opportunities. We’re differentiating through our ability to architect solutions using proven design patterns and reusable architecture assets.

You'll learn, grow and advance in an innovative culture that thrives on shared success, diverse ways of thinking and enables boundaryless opportunities that can drive your career in new and exciting ways

If you’re looking for a challenging career working in a vibrant environment with access to training and a global network of experts, this could be the for you. As part of our team, you'll be working with cutting-edge technologies and will have the opportunity to develop a wide range of new skills on the job.

**In our team you will:**

* Work on a variety of challenging and innovative projects
* Work at the forefront of the AI revolution, building cutting edge innovative solutions for some of the world’s biggest organisations
* Gain exposure to new and emergent technologies
* Have support from a variety of experienced team members within the wider Architecture practice, to support you in your independent growth journey into the world of Architecture best practice
* Partner with a variety of highly skilled teams to advise and support our clients through their data architecture related challenges

**As a Data Architecture Manager, you will:**

* Design and build enterprise Microsoft Copilot and AI solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry and Azure AI services.
* Develop AI agents, conversational experiences, workflows and Generative AI solutions.
* Integrate Copilot solutions with Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Dataverse, APIs and enterprise data.
* Implement RAG, AI Search, prompt engineering, connectors and orchestration patterns.
* Apply AI security, governance, responsible AI and performance best practices.
* Lead technical design, development, testing, deployment and production support.
* Manage end-to-end delivery including planning, estimation, scope, risks, dependencies, quality and timelines.
* Lead and mentor AI engineers and development teams.
* Engage with clients and senior stakeholders to translate business needs into AI solutions.
* Drive Agile delivery, technical governance and operational readiness.
* Support solution shaping, proposals and AI transformation initiatives
* Contribute to architectural thought leadership by sharing ideas on innovation, emerging technologies, and modern data and AI architecture patterns across client and internal forums
* Lead and mentor junior architects, providing guidance on architectural patterns, standards, and best practices while supporting their professional development.
* Establish and maintain strong relationships with client architecture and technology stakeholders, acting as a trusted advisor to ensure alignment between client objectives, architectural direction, and delivery outcomes.

  

**We are looking for experience in the following skills:**

* Experience of software/technology experience with strong AI and Microsoft expertise.
* Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI/Microsoft Foundry and Generative AI.
* Experience with AI agents, RAG, Azure AI Search, APIs, Power Platform and Dataverse.
* Strong development experience with Python and/or .NET.
* Understanding of AI security, governance and responsible AI.
* Proven experience managing technical delivery and engineering teams.
* Strong Agile, project governance and stakeholder-management skills.
* Excellent client-facing communication and leadership capabilities.
* Relevant Microsoft AI/Power Platform certifications are desirable
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

**What’s in it for you**

At Accenture in addition to a competitive basic salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package which includes 30 days vacation, gym subsidy, private medical insurance and 3 extra days leave per year for charitable work of your choice!

**Flexibility and mobility are required to deliver this role as there will be requirements to spend time onsite with our clients and partners to enable delivery of the first-class services we are known for.**

**About Accenture**

Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services in strategy and consulting, interactive, technology and operations, with digital capabilities across all of these services. We combine unmatched experience and specialized capabilities across more than 40 industries — powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. With 509,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture brings continuous innovation to help clients improve their performance and create lasting value across their enterprises. Visit us at www.accenture.com

jobs.title: Microsoft Power Platform Senior Developer
jobs.description:
**Microsoft Power Platform Senior Developer**

**Location: London**

**Salary: Competitive salary and package dependant on experience**

**Career Level: Associate Manager (CL8)**

**Please Note: Any offer of employment is subject to satisfactory BPSS and SC security clearance, which requires 5 years continuous UK address history at the point of application.**

**About the team and the**

Accenture's Microsoft Business Group (MBG) UK is seeking a technically exceptional Microsoft Power Platform Senior Developer at Level 8 (Associate Manager) to join our growing delivery capability. This sits at the technical heart of our Power Platform practice — combining deep hands-on development expertise with emerging team leadership responsibility across high-value client engagements.

As a Senior Developer at Level 8, you will be the go-to technical authority on Power Platform delivery teams, driving solution quality, architectural integrity, and developer best practices. You will work alongside Delivery Managers and Solution Architects on complex enterprise programmes, whilst beginning to take on line management and mentoring responsibilities for junior developers.

This is ideal for a highly experienced Power Platform developer who has a proven delivery track record in a consulting or SI environment and is ready to step into a formal leadership and technical governance within one of the world's largest Microsoft practices.

What you will do in the of a Senior Developer:

**Technical Delivery & Development**
------------------------------------

* Design, build, and deliver complex Power Platform solutions across Power Apps (model-driven and canvas), Power Automate, Power Pages, and Dataverse for enterprise clients
* Lead technical delivery across one or more workstreams within large Power Platform programmes, taking end-to-end ownership of solution components
* Develop advanced solutions utilising PCF (PowerApps Component Framework) controls, custom connectors, and complex Dataverse data models
* Architect and implement ALM (Application Lifecycle Management) pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, and Power Platform Build Tools
* Build and maintain integrations with D365 CE, M365, Azure services, and third-party platforms using REST APIs, OData, Azure Service Bus, and Logic Apps
* Ensure all developed solutions adhere to Microsoft Well-Architected Framework principles and Accenture delivery quality standards

**Architecture & Technical Governance**
---------------------------------------

* Contribute to solution architecture design, including data model design, security architecture, and integration patterns
* Conduct and lead technical design reviews, code reviews, and architecture assurance sessions
* Establish and enforce Power Platform coding standards, naming conventions, and development best practices across the team
* Implement and manage Power Platform CoE (Centre of Excellence) Toolkit configurations, including environment strategy, DLP policies, and governance frameworks
* Provide technical risk assessments and mitigation recommendations to Delivery Managers and Solution Architects
* Evaluate and recommend emerging Power Platform capabilities including AI Builder, Copilot Studio, and Microsoft Copilot integrations

**Team Leadership & Mentoring**
-------------------------------

* Line manage 2–5 junior and mid-level Power Platform developers, including objective setting, performance reviews, and career development conversations
* Provide day-to-day technical mentoring and guidance to developers, acting as the first point of escalation for technical blockers
* Onboard new team members and ensure consistent application of delivery standards across the developer community
* Contribute to the MBG UK Power Platform community of practice through knowledge sharing, technical blogs, and internal enablement sessions
* Support the identification and recruitment of Power Platform talent in collaboration with the Talent Acquisition team

**Client & Stakeholder Engagement**
-----------------------------------

* Engage confidently with client technical leads and senior stakeholders to present solution designs, demonstrate prototypes, and manage technical expectations
* Lead technical workshops, requirements discovery sessions, and solution walkthroughs with client teams
* Support pre-sales activities including technical solutioning, effort estimation, and proposal contributions
* Participate in client steering groups and technical governance forums as the senior technical voice for Power Platform delivery

**Quality & Innovation**
------------------------

* Champion test-driven development practices including unit testing, automated UI testing (Test Studio), and performance testing for Power Platform solutions
* Drive continuous improvement in delivery tooling, developer productivity, and reusable component libraries
* Identify and prototype AI-augmented development capabilities including Copilot in Power Apps, AI Builder models, and Copilot Studio agents
* Contribute to Accenture IP development through reusable accelerators, solution templates, and internal tooling

  

**We are looking for significant experience in:**  
**Core Power Platform Development**

* Hands-on Microsoft Power Platform development experience in a consulting or SI delivery environment
* Expert-level proficiency in Power Apps (both model-driven and canvas), Power Automate (cloud flows, desktop flows/RPA), and Dataverse
* Proven experience developing PCF controls using TypeScript/React and deploying via managed solutions
* Strong command of Power Fx, DAX (for Power BI integration), and JavaScript/TypeScript for web resource and PCF development
* Deep experience with Dataverse: complex data modelling, relationships, business rules, calculated fields, rollup fields, and virtual tables
* Hands-on experience with Power Pages (formerly Power Apps Portals) including Liquid templates, web templates, and portal security

**ALM, DevOps & Integration**
-----------------------------

* Expert knowledge of Power Platform ALM: solution management (managed/unmanaged), environment strategy, solution layering, and deployment pipelines
* Hands-on experience building CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions with Power Platform Build Tools and PAC CLI
* Strong integration development experience: REST/OData APIs, Dataverse Web API, custom connectors, Azure API Management, and Azure Service Bus
* Experience with Azure services in a Power Platform context: Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Key Vault, and Azure AD/Entra ID
* Familiarity with Dynamics 365 CE customisation: plugins (C#/.NET), JavaScript web resources, Ribbon Workbench, and XrmToolBox

**Architecture & Governance**
-----------------------------

* Experience designing enterprise-grade Power Platform governance frameworks including DLP policies, CoE Toolkit deployment, and environment tiering
* Understanding of Microsoft security and compliance model: Azure AD Conditional Access, Dataverse RBAC, column-level security, and auditing
* Ability to produce and own technical design documentation including solution architecture documents, data flow diagrams, and integration specifications
* Familiarity with Power Platform licensing models and capacity planning for enterprise deployments

**Consulting & Communication**
------------------------------

* Proven ability to engage and communicate confidently with technical and non-technical client stakeholders
* Experience in a professional services, consulting, or SI environment
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions
* Experience producing client-facing deliverables: technical design documents, solution architecture presentations, and sprint reviews

**What will set you apart:**

* Experience with Copilot Studio (formerly Power Virtual Agents): agent design, topic authoring, and integration with enterprise data sources
* Hands-on experience with AI Builder: document processing models, prediction models, and object detection
* Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, or Power BI Premium in a data platform context
* Experience with Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations or Business Central in a Power Platform integration context
* Familiarity with Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Purview, or Compliance Manager in regulated industry deployments
* Experience delivering Power Platform solutions in Financial Services, Insurance, Energy, or Public Sector verticals in the UK
* Knowledge of Avanade co-delivery models and ATCI offshore development engagement practices
* Experience contributing to Microsoft FastTrack for Power Platform or Microsoft Success by Design programmes

**Essential Certifications**

* **PL-400**: the primary technical developer credential — validates advanced development skills including PCF controls, custom connectors, and Power Automate. Mandatory for this role
* **PL-600**: Solution Architect designation — expected at Level 8 to confirm ability to own solution design and technical governance on complex programmes
* **PL-200**: functional consultant credential that complements PL-400 by validating business process and configuration depth across the Power Platform suite
* **AI-200 / AI-103**: Microsoft's new 2026 developer certifications for AI-integrated cloud apps and Copilot Studio agent development — central to MBG's AI Copilot go-to-market
* **AI-901**: mandatory AI literacy baseline across all MBG UK roles — covers generative AI, Azure AI services, and Copilot platform concepts
* **AZ-400**: validates DevOps engineering skills including CI/CD pipeline design and Power Platform Build Tools — strongly recommended for developers owning ALM

**What’s in it for you**

At Accenture in addition to a competitive basic salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package which includes 25 days’ vacation per year and 3 extra days leave per year for charitable work of your choice!

**Flexibility and mobility are required to deliver this role as there may be requirements to spend time onsite with our clients and partners to enable delivery of the first-class services we are known for.**

**About Accenture**

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Interactive, Technology and Operations services—all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our +700,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities. Visit us at www.accenture.com.

Accenture is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all sections of society and does not discriminate on grounds of race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, or gender identity, or any other basis as protected by applicable law.
