**Trainee White Goods Engineer - Field Based - Full Training Provided - Blackburn**

**Salary: £26,500 to £27,000 - Salary reviewed once signed off training - Up to £50,000+ OTE**

**Permanent, Full-time | 40 hours per week, Mon to Fri | Company van provided - private use optional | Tools & Training Provided**

Candidates will be considered if they live within either the **BB or PR postcode areas**.

**Kickstart a New Career in Appliance Repair**

Whether you're starting fresh or changing careers, we'll provide **full City & Guilds Assured training at our training centre in the north east of England** and pair you with a **dedicated mentor** to help you become a fully qualified **White Goods Engineer - Field Based**. No experience in white goods repair necessary, but we are looking for candidates with previous hands-on mechanical or electrical experience and using tools. Join **Pacifica** as a **Trainee Domestic Appliance Field Service Engineer** and take the first step toward a long-term, rewarding career repairing household appliances.

**What You Will Do**

As a **Trainee White Goods Engineer - Field Based**, your role will involve:

* Learning to **repair and maintain household appliances** including **washing machines, tumble dryers, refrigerators, dishwashers, and electric cookers**
* **Visiting customers' homes** to diagnose issues and carry out repairs safely and efficiently
* Building on your mechanical/electrical experience to troubleshoot and solve problems on-site
* Recording and managing **job details using our in-house engineer software**
* Following guidance from your **mentor** while building your skills and confidence
* Providing **excellent customer service**, explaining repairs clearly and professionally
* Continuously **developing your technical skills** through structured training and on-the-job experience

**What We Offer You**

* **Salary: £26,500 to £27,000** (depending on experience) Salary reviewed once signed off training
* **Up to £50,000+ OTE with our industry leading bonus scheme**
* **City & Guilds Assured Training Programme**
* **Purpose-built training centre** in the North East of England
* Full training on major appliance types: **washing machines, tumble dryers, refrigeration, dishwashers, and electric cookers**
* **Mentorship from experienced engineers** to support your career journey
* **Van, tools, tablet, uniform, and fuel card provided**
* **30 days annual leave** (including 8 bank holidays)
* **Pension scheme & industry-leading bonus scheme**
* **Death-in-service benefit** (3x salary)
* Discounts via **company retail portal**
* Monthly **cash prize draw** & **Costa gift card** recognition scheme
* Complimentary **appliance cover** for your own home appliances

**About Pacifica**

**Pacifica** is one of the UK's largest providers of domestic appliance repairs, carrying out over **350,000 repairs every year**. With over **250 engineers nationwide**, we are a **carbon neutral company** committed to reaching **net-zero by 2035**.

* **Our Purpose**: Keeping households running while protecting the environment
* **Our Vision**: Caring for our customers' appliances for a sustainable future

**What We're Looking For**

This isn't just a job - it's a career path. To succeed, you'll need the right mindset and transferable skills:

* Previous m**echanical or electrical experience** - comfortable using hand tools and solving problems
* **Enthusiasm** - motivated to power through challenges
* **Confidence** - able to work alone in customers' homes and provide great service
* **Communication skills** - clear, friendly, and professional with customers
* A **can-do attitude** - driven to learn and succeed
* Full **UK manual driving licence** (no more than 6 penalty points)

**Extra Perks**

* **Van stock automatically replenished**
* Daily spare parts delivered to local **ByBox lockers**
* **Easy-to-use engineer software**
* **No sales targets** - focus purely on repairs
* Ongoing **specialist training and career progression**

**Why Join Us?**

Working as a **White Goods Engineer - Field Based** offers **variety, challenges, and job security** in a growing industry. You'll never be stuck behind a desk, and you'll always be learning.

**Apply Now**

Start your journey today as a **Trainee White Goods Engineer - Field Based with Pacifica**. Click **Apply Now** to take the first step toward your new career.

jobs.title: Senior Principal Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
* Nuclear
* Permanent /
* Bolton
* United Kingdom
* 06/10/26
* On site

  

About Assystem
--------------

Today, Assystem is among the top three independent nuclear engineering firms worldwide. With over 60 years of experience in highly regulated sectors, the group supports public and industrial stakeholders in the execution of complex and strategic infrastructure projects, subject to high safety and security requirements.

  
  

Assystem mobilizes 8,000 experts in 13 countries and intervenes across the entire project lifecycle, in engineering, project management and digital solutions.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Join the Fusion and Modular Nuclear Business Unit!** Assystem has an exciting opportunity for a Senior Principal MechanicalEngineer to join our expanding Fusion and Modular Nuclear (FMN) business unit. As leaders in the design and development of new technologies, you will have the opportunity to work across multiple cutting-edge projectsdeveloping technical solutions making net-zero power generation a reality.

**Your mission:**

* Lead and support the development of designs for the following systems:
* Personnel Airlocks, Main Equipment Access Hatch, Fuel Transfer Channel, Piping Penetrations, Electrical Penetrations, Specialist Nuclear Doors
* Conduct DFMEA (Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) to identify and mitigate potential failure modes early in the design process.
* Perform HAZID (Hazard Identification Study) to assess and document risks across the system.
* Complete and maintain Human Factors Checklists to ensure ergonomics and usability are considered in design decisions.
* Update and manage the project’s Risk Register to track, evaluate, and mitigate emerging risks.
* Design Package Production in Line with Requirements – Oversee the creation of comprehensive design packages, ensuring alignment with project specifications, technical standards, and operational needs.
* Management of Interfaces – Coordinate effectively between engineering teams, suppliers, and stakeholders to ensure seamless integration of cooling water systems with other reactor components.
* Preparation of Technical Specifications – Develop clear, detailed technical specifications to guide procurement, fabrication, and installation of key cooling water system components.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including both new and existing FTEs and secondees across engineering and project functions.

**Why Join the Community of Switchers?**

* Over 55 years in nuclear engineering.
* Ranked among the top 3 largest nuclear engineering companies.
* Attractive social benefits, including an engaging Employee Committee and holiday bonuses.
* Ongoing training with numerous career opportunities.
* 70% of our managers are promoted internally!
* Hybrid work: 1-2 days remote per week.

**My profile**
--------------

* Multi-Disciplinary Team Leadership – Skilled in managing and coordinating diverse engineering teams.
* Steam Cycle Modelling Oversight – Ability to define modelling outcomes and ensure accurate implementation.
* Project Budget & Lifecycle Planning – Experienced in budgeting and planning for full design lifecycles.
* Cooling Water Equipment Expertise – Strong track record in designing and optimizing cooling water systems.
* Regulatory & Compliance Knowledge – Well-versed in ONR, Environment Agency, and HSE regulations.
* Requirements Capture Experience – Skilled in gathering and defining technical requirements.
* Systems Engineering Awareness – Strong understanding of integrated design principles.
* Subcontractor Management – Experienced in overseeing and coordinating subcontractors.
* Chartered Engineer (CEng) – Professional accreditation in a relevant discipline.
* Security Clearance Eligibility – Capable of obtaining SC clearance for secure projects.

* Excellent communication skills, written and oral
* Strong leadership skills
* Focus on delivering quality output to time and budget
* Act with integrity and instils this in others
* Has an appreciation of wider technical issues beyond own discipline – Understands interdisciplinary challenges and their impact on projects.
* Ability to work with a high degree of independence, using their own initiative and self-motivation – Proactive and capable of managing tasks autonomously.
* Confident in a multi-party, multi-national environment – Comfortable working with global teams and diverse stakeholders.
* Ability to travel to Assystem offices and customer sites within the UK
* To undertake work packages supporting major UK and international Nuclear Clients – Contributes to high-profile nuclear projects with global impact.

**Due to the nature of work to be undertaken applicants will be required to meet certain residency criteria in order to attain a minimum level of UK security clearance if not already security cleared to a minimum SC level.**

**NOTICE TO CANDIDATES ON RECRUITMENT FRAUD – We are committed to safeguarding candidates from fraudulent activity associated with our recruitment process. Please note that we will never offer specialist CV writing services, request payment or ask for sensitive personal information during the recruitment process.**

We are committed to equal treatment of candidates and promote, as well as foster all forms of diversity within our company. We believe that bringing together people with different backgrounds and perspectives is essential for creating innovative and impactful solutions. Skills, talent, and our people’s ability to dare are the only things that matter !. Bring your unique contributions and help us shape the future.

jobs.title: Junior Broadcast Event Engineer, Studios
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**

IMG is a leading global sports marketing agency, specializing in media rights management and sales, multi-channel content production and distribution, brand partnerships, strategic consulting, digital services, and event management. It powers growth of revenues, fanbases and IP for more than 250 federations, associations, events, and teams, including the National Football League, English Premier League, International Olympic Committee, National Hockey League, Major League Soccer, ATP and WTA Tours, the AELTC (Wimbledon), Euroleague Basketball, CONMEBOL, World Rugby, DP World Tour, and The R&A, as well as UFC, WWE, and PBR. IMG is a subsidiary of TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO), a premium sports and entertainment company.

TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.



Cingularity is a highly specialised global fibre network provider, delivering premium live broadcast transmission services for some of the world's leading media and sports organisations.Our commitment to quality, performance, and network resilience enables us to support global broadcasters and rights holders including Amazon Prime, Warner Bros. Discovery, and the WTA, delivering live television content to audiences worldwide.

  

In September 2022, Cingularity was acquired by IMG Media, combining our expertise in fibre-based transmission with IMG's ambition to drive the future of remote production through hybrid fibre, satellite, cloud, and IP-based workflows.

  

**Working Conditions:**

* This is a Permanent position
* This role is based at our facility in Gunthorpe St, London
* **You will be required to spend a considerable amount of time away supporting global events. 70% international travel.**
You must have the ability to work unsociable and extended hours as required to cover sporting events.  

  

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

We are looking for a **Junior Broadcast Event Engineer** to join our growing Events team.

  

This role is ideal for a recent graduate, apprentice, trainee engineer, or someone with up to two years of experience in broadcasting, networking, or live events who is looking to build a career in live sports broadcast transmission. Working alongside experienced Event Engineers, you will gain hands-on exposure to every stage of live event delivery, from equipment preparation and testing through to on-site deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and event support.

  

This is a unique opportunity to work on premium global sporting events while developing specialist knowledge in broadcast transmission, IP networking, fibre technologies, and remote production workflows.

  

The role is primarily based in London at **3 Gunthorpe Street, London, E1 7RL** , with regular visits to **IMG Studios, Stockley Park (Hayes, Uxbridge)** for equipment builds and testing. Extensive UK, European, and international travel will be required to support live events worldwide.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Pre-Event Preparation**

* Assist with the staging, configuration, and testing of event equipment.
* Read and interpret network topology, schematic, and engineering drawings.
* Support the creation and maintenance of technical documentation.
* Participate in customer and project planning meetings.
* Liaise with telecommunications suppliers under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Prepare, label, pack, ship, and track equipment for events.
* Maintain accurate inventory records.

### **On-Site Event Delivery**

* Support the installation, rigging, testing, and commissioning of transmission systems.
* Assist with network connectivity, encoding, decoding, and transmission services.
* Monitor event equipment and associated video, audio, and data services.
* Provide first-line technical support to customers and stakeholders on-site.
* Escalate service issues appropriately to senior engineers.
* Maintain accurate operational logs and documentation throughout events.
* Support equipment de-rig and pack-down activities following event completion.
Ensure all work is completed safely and in line with health and safety requirements.  

  

**Training & Development**
--------------------------

We are committed to developing the next generation of broadcast engineers. You will benefit from:

* Structured training and mentorship from experienced Event Engineers.
* Hands-on experience with industry-leading broadcast and networking technologies.
* Exposure to premium live sports productions and global broadcast operations.
* Opportunities to travel internationally and work on major live events.
* A defined progression path toward a Broadcast Event Engineer position.

**About You**
-------------

### **Essential Skills & Experience**

* A genuine interest in live television broadcasting, transmission, or networking technologies.
* Ability to remain calm and focused in time-critical live event environments.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a practical, hands-on approach.
* Ability to follow engineering schematics, diagrams, and technical instructions.
* Experience making and testing Ethernet (RJ45) and coaxial cables.
* Basic understanding of: Video signals (SD-SDI, HD-SDI, UHD) Audio and video routing systems Microsoft Windows and Microsoft 365 Excel or Google Sheets
* Foundational IP networking knowledge, including: Basic network configuration Troubleshooting network connectivity issues Data and telemetry services
* Full UK Driving Licence.
* Valid passport and ability to travel internationally without restriction.

### **Desirable Skills & Experience**

* Qualification, apprenticeship, or certification in Broadcast Engineering, Electronics, Networking, IT, or a related discipline.
* Experience within a broadcast, networking, media, sports, or live events environment.
* Knowledge of fibre transmission technologies.
* Familiarity with MPEG encoding/decoding technologies (AVC, HEVC) and JPEG2000.
* Understanding of IP video transport technologies such as SRT, Zixi, or SMPTE ST 2110.
* Exposure to Net Insight products, including Nimbra platforms.

**Personal Attributes**
-----------------------

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Customer-focused with a positive, professional attitude.
* High attention to detail.
* Well organised and able to prioritise effectively.
* Comfortable working under pressure in fast-paced environments.
* Eager to learn and develop technical expertise.
Collaborative team player with a proactive approach.  

  

**What to Expect**
------------------

This role offers an exciting opportunity to work at the heart of live sports broadcasting. Successful candidates should be comfortable with:

* Frequent international travel and time away from home.
* Working flexible, unsociable, or extended hours, including weekends and public holidays.
* Supporting major sporting and live broadcast events in fast-paced environments.
Taking ownership of tasks while learning from experienced engineers.  

In addition, success at IMG is driven by four **core competencies** that apply to all employees:

  

**Business Acumen** – Understanding financial drivers, interpreting business data, aligning decisions to strategic outcomes

**Operational Excellence** – Driving efficiency, governance, and continuous improvement in delivery & operations

**Innovation Mindset** – Cultivating curiosity, experimentation, and forward-looking capability development

**Leadership & Collaboration** – Inspiring others, building trust, and enabling collaboration across teams

jobs.title: Process Safety Engineer
jobs.description:
Why Work at Clarke

Our work is guided by our purpose: creating an energy-resilient world for a better future. This purpose embodies the legacy we bring, with more than 100 years as the global leader in energy resilience, delivering solutions critical to sustain and improve life.

Our teams have the opportunity to provide a critical resource – energy – that ensures safety, security, and independence for people around the world. Our team members are focused on pushing boundaries, continuing to innovate in an ever-changing landscape, and keeping up with the pace required to create solutions for today’s world demands.

Our product range includes engines, generators, power conversion, UPS systems, EV components and electrification solutions, microgrid controls and management, and clean energy solutions that serve a broad spectrum of OEM, residential, industrial, and commercial customers. At Rehlko, you have the freedom to identify, create, and deliver solutions – large and small – that help people and communities thrive in the moments that matter.

At Rehlko, our team members are the essential energy that powers our organization’s success. We are committed to fostering a safe and sustainable work environment where safety is everyone’s responsibility. We empower every team member to actively participate in our Zero Is Possible safety culture by encouraging open communication, proactively reporting hazards, following protocols, and suggesting improvements. Join us in creating an energy resilient world for a better future!

**What We Offer**

At Rehlko, our Total Rewards programs are designed to accelerate growth, energize performance, and support a culture of inclusion at every stage of life and work. We offer total rewards that are easily understood, recognize results, enable career mobility, and reflect our commitment to valuing diverse needs in a fast-moving world. We provide:

* Competitive compensation and benefits
* Work-life flexibility
* Recognition and rewards
* Development and career opportunities
* A safe and inclusive workplace

**Why You Will Love this Job**

P2 level for the role has been defined.

**Process Safety Engineer**

**Job Purpose**

To provide specialist process safety engineering support across a wide range of sustainable energy projects, including gas-powered generation, CHP, biogas, hydrogen, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and other low-carbon energy technologies. You will play a key role in identifying, assessing and mitigating process safety risks, ensuring compliance with relevant legislation, industry standards and best practice throughout all stages of project delivery.

Working closely with Electrical, Mechanical and Project Engineering teams, you will help ensure that Clarke Energy projects are designed, installed and operated safely, supporting our commitment to operational excellence and the transition to net zero energy.

**Majority of time spent:** Leading and supporting process safety activities across engineering projects, including hazard identification, risk assessments, safety studies and the development of safety documentation.

**We are looking for an experienced and proactive Process Safety Engineer to join our team.**

This is an exciting opportunity to influence the safe design and delivery of innovative energy projects across the UK and internationally. You will work alongside multidisciplinary engineering teams to embed process safety principles throughout the project lifecycle and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the business.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Process Safety Management:** Develop, implement and promote process safety management practices across engineering and operational activities.
* **Hazard Identification & Risk Assessment:** Lead and facilitate HAZOP studies, LOPA reviews, FMEA assessments, SIL assessments and other risk-based safety reviews.
* **Engineering Design Support:** Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure process safety requirements are incorporated into equipment, systems and plant designs.
* **Regulatory Compliance:** Ensure compliance with relevant legislation, industry standards and best practice, including COMAH, ATEX, ISO standards and other applicable regulations.
* **Safety Studies & Documentation:** Produce and review process safety documentation, including risk assessments, safety cases, hazardous area classifications and operating procedures.
* **Incident Investigation:** Support investigations into process safety incidents and near misses, identifying root causes and implementing corrective and preventative actions.
* **Operational Safety:** Assist with the development and maintenance of safe systems of work, operational procedures and emergency response plans.
* **Training & Awareness:** Deliver process safety training and promote awareness across engineering, operations and project teams.
* **Project Support:** Provide process safety engineering support throughout project development, installation, commissioning and operational phases.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Analyse process safety performance data and recommend initiatives to improve safety culture and reduce operational risk.
* **Client & Stakeholder Engagement:** Liaise with clients, suppliers and regulatory bodies as required, providing specialist process safety expertise.

**Technical / Professional Knowledge and Skills**

* Strong knowledge of process safety principles and risk management methodologies, including HAZOP, LOPA, SIL, FMEA and ATEX.
* Understanding of industrial process systems, control systems and safety instrumented systems.
* Knowledge of UK and international process safety legislation and standards, including COMAH and relevant ISO standards.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess complex technical risks.
* Experience preparing technical reports, safety documentation and engineering recommendations.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to communicate complex technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Project management and stakeholder engagement skills.

**Personal Attributes / Skills**

We are looking for someone who is:

* **Trustworthy and professional** in all dealings.
* **Reliable and dependable** , consistently delivering on commitments.
* **Customer-focused** , responsive to internal and external stakeholder needs.
* **Supportive and collaborative** , working effectively across multidisciplinary teams.
* **Self-motivated** , able to manage competing priorities and work independently.
* **Committed to quality and continuous improvement** in all aspects of work.
* **Proactive in driving safety excellence** and promoting best practice.
* **Keen to learn and develop** , keeping up to date with industry developments and regulations.

Additionally, the ideal candidate will demonstrate:

* **Excellent analytical and risk assessment skills** .
* Strong planning, organisation and attention to detail.
* **Adaptability** and flexibility in a dynamic project environment.
* Ability to influence and build strong working relationships.
* **Resilience and tenacity** , maintaining a positive approach under pressure.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.

**Essential Qualifications and Experience**

* Degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
* Proven experience in a Process Safety Engineering role within power generation, energy, oil & gas, petrochemical, chemical manufacturing or a similar industrial sector.
* Experience leading or facilitating HAZOP, LOPA and other formal process safety assessments.
* Strong understanding of process safety regulations, standards and best practice.
* Full UK/EU Driving Licence.
* Eligible to work in the UK.

**Desirable Qualifications and Experience**

* Professional registration or working towards Chartered Engineer status.
* Process Safety qualification such as IChemE Process Safety, NEBOSH Process Safety Management or equivalent.
* Experience within hydrogen, renewable energy, CHP, biogas or gas-powered generation projects.
* Experience working within COMAH-regulated environments.
* Knowledge of Functional Safety and Safety Instrumented Systems (IEC 61511).

**The Benefits**

* Competitive salary.
* Generous car allowance.
* 25 days holiday, plus additional days based on service length.
* Holiday buy and sell scheme.
* Company pension contribution.
* Health care cash plan.
* Life assurance and Employee Assistance Programme.
* Hybrid working options where applicable.
* Support for professional development and certification.
* Reward and recognition schemes.

**About Clarke Energy**

Clarke Energy is a leading multinational specialist in the engineering, installation and maintenance of sustainable energy solutions. As the largest authorised distributor and service provider for INNIO's hydrogen-ready reciprocating engines, we are at the forefront of the transition to net-zero energy.

Our commitment to quality, innovation and ethical business practices drives everything we do. We offer our employees the opportunity to work on industry-leading technologies whilst developing their careers in a collaborative and supportive environment.

**Ready to Join Us?**

If you're a Process Safety Engineer passionate about creating safer, more sustainable energy solutions and want to be part of a forward-thinking engineering team, we'd love to hear from you.

**About Us**

Clarke proudly offers a rich history steeped in creativity and commitment to our associates and communities, along with competitive benefits and compensation. Our Purpose—Creating an energy resilient world for a better future—and Values: Curiosity, Trust, Pace, and Excellence, are important cultural components that shape the way we work and relate to one another. Learn more about Clarke at https://www.rehlko.com/who-we-are. In addition to the investment in your development, Clarke offers a comprehensive package with competitive salaries and a range of additional benefits.Clarke is an equal opportunity employer that prohibits discrimination and will make decisions regarding employment opportunities, including, but not limited to, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, discipline, and termination, promote equal opportunities in every aspect of our process.

**Our Values**

**Curiosity** – Seek, learn, share
  
**Trust** – Go farther together
  
**Pace** – Focus to go faster
  
**Excellence** – Find the win every day

Posting End Date:

Due to the sensitive nature of this role, you will be required to undergo DV (Developed Vetting) level Security Clearance ( https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels) . An allowance of £5k per annum may be payable monthly while you hold this DV and continue to work in a role that requires that level of security clearance. The terms of this allowance will be made available if you are successful in being recruited into this role.

Security isn’t always the first thing that comes to mind when you think of BT, but when it comes to keeping everyone safely connected, We Are The Protectors. We deal with thousands of cyber-attacks every day, so that millions of people can safely go about their daily lives and run their businesses. We deliver vital work at scale, with real breadth and impact. We connect for good.
  
You'll be joining a specialist security team that is a trusted partner to governments worldwide, protecting critical national infrastructure and committed to the safety and security of our nation and global communities. Our mission focused work is innovative, inspiring and technologically challenging in a way that makes every day different and stimulating. We provide the opportunity to work on rare projects, with exciting tools and brilliant people. Everyone has access to unparalleled professional and personal development opportunities and your contribution is always valued.

**About the role**
------------------

Our Engineering mantra is “Technical Excellence in Engineering” and we deliver some amazing technical capabilities for our customers which can only happen if we recruit, train and support our people.

This is an exciting opportunity to join one of our software delivery teams, working alongside our customers and partners to work on key customer services.

The team develop and maintain bespoke, highly complex, specialist capabilities that are critical to the success of our customers, who we work very closely with. We work across a wide variety of platforms and technology stacks and we utilise a range of programming languages.

This job role is based in Manchester. Onsite (Office based 5 days per week). Monday-Friday 37.5 hours per week. You will need to be eligible to obtain DV Security Clearance before starting this role. You will need to have lived in the UK for 10+ years to be eligible.

**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

* Delivers on the engineering strategy through delivery of high quality, and well-tested, software solutions, on time and on budget.
* Has defined authority and responsibility for a significant area of work covering technical responsibilities.
* Works closely with customers to identify and resolve complex technical issues.
* Establishes technical objectives, defines technical roadmaps and delegates responsibilities.
* Influences a significant part of own organisation and influences customers/suppliers and industry at a senior management level (e.g. around resourcing of delivery teams and technical
* direction of work).
* Line managing a team of software developers

**Essential Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* Agile development
* Programming
* Software testing
* Application development
* Software development lifecycle
* Coaching and mentoring software developers
* Line management and inspiring leadership

**Desirable Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* Evidence of creatively applying a wide range of technical and/management principles.
* Performance of highly complex work activities covering technical, financial and quality aspects.
* Object-oriented programming experience, and supporting technologies, including: C#, Python, C++, low-level mobile development (Objective-C, C++), elastic, ansible, docker, Jenkins, git, MEAN stack.

**Our Package**
---------------

When you join our team, you'll play a role in delivering work that makes a real difference across the UK. In return, you'll be rewarded with a market-leading Total Reward package that reflects the value of your skills and expertise. From structured technical progression and industry-recognised training to generous family support and flexible benefits, we're committed to helping our people succeed at every stage of their career journey.

* A structured Technical Progression Pathway to recognise and reward appropriate technical people.
* Competitive DV market aligned salaries
* Tiered role based DV allowance of up to £5k per annum paid annually
* World-class training and development opportunities
* 10% on target bonus
* Equal family leave: receive 18 weeks at full pay, 8 weeks at half pay and 26 weeks at the statutory rate. It’s for all parents, no matter how your family is made up.
* Enhanced women’s health support: including help with menopause symptoms, cancer screenings, period care and more.
* BT Pension scheme, minimum 5% Employee contribution, BT contribution 10%
* New BT Better Workplace working environments at strategic locations across the UK
* Huge range of flexible benefits including an EV salary sacrifice, cycle to work, healthcare, season ticket loan, additional annual leave
* On-call allowance (Depending on role requirements)
* Access to 100’s of retail discounts including the BT shop
* 24/7 private virtual GP appointments for UK colleagues
* Option to join BT Shares Saving schemes
* 25 days annual leave (not including bank holidays), increasing with service
* 2 weeks paid carer’s leave
* Discounted broadband, mobile and TV packages
* Enhanced life assurance of up to ten times base salary

Security is one of the fastest growing parts of our global organisation. We are protecting our networks from more than 6,500 cyber attacks each day, investing over £40m in research each year - and in employing nearly 3,000 people, we’re also the largest private cyber employer in the UK. With incredible opportunities to learn, develop and grow your skills, we’ll invest in you, nurture your potential and shape your future – whatever your background or experience.
  
  
In today’s world, safe and secure digital connections have never been more vital. You’ll be joining a global company operating at the forefront of the information age: BT employs 90,000 people in 180 countries. With huge scale, we’re capable of achieving great things, striving to be personal, simple, and brilliant for our customers whilst creating an inclusive working environment where people from all backgrounds can succeed. Play your part. Make a difference. We are the Protectors.

A FEW POINTS TO NOTE:

Although these roles are listed as full-time, if you’re a job share partnership, work reduced hours, or any other way of working flexibly, please still get in touch.

We will also offer reasonable adjustments for the selection process if required, so please do not hesitate to inform us.

DON'T MEET EVERY SINGLE REQUIREMENT?

Studies have shown that women and people who are disabled, LGBTQ+, neurodiverse or from ethnic minority backgrounds are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every single qualification and criteria. We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace where everyone can be their best, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every requirement on the Job Description, please apply anyway - you may just be the right candidate for this or other roles in our wider team.

jobs.description:
**Base Location:** For this role, we require successful applicants to be based from one of our Scottish locations and you'll be expected to spend 50% of your working week in the office - Perth, Glasgow, Inverness or Aberdeen.

**Salary:** £59,800 - £89,800 depending on skills and experience + car / allowance + performance-related bonus + a range of benefits to support your family, finances and wellbeing.

**Working Pattern:** Permanent | Full Time | Flexible First options available

**The role**

SSEN Transmission Onshore AC are currently recruiting for an experienced Senior Building Services (Mechanical) Project Engineer to support our growing portfolio of projects throughout the delivery of high profile, high value and technically complex projects on the Electricity Transmission network in Scotland. Projects range from operational depots, office spaces, training facilities to large substations and upgrades of existing substations.

The role is responsible for supporting the core design teams through initial development and design, into delivery, commissioning and hand over to operations.

**You will**

* Lead the development, review and approval of mechanical building services designs, specifications and scopes of work across a range of infrastructure projects.
* Provide technical assurance throughout project delivery, validating designs and supporting construction, installation and commissioning activities.
* Identify opportunities to improve engineering solutions, manage technical risks and implement innovative technologies and best practice.
* Support and mentor engineers within the wider team, sharing technical expertise and contributing to capability development.
* Work closely with consultants, contractors and internal stakeholders to deliver high-quality engineering outcomes and ensure compliance with project requirements.

**You have**

* Significant experience in mechanical building services engineering, including the design, specification and delivery of complex construction or infrastructure projects.
* Strong knowledge of relevant engineering standards, legislation and regulations, including CDM and their practical application.
* The ability to assess technical challenges, evaluate engineering solutions and make informed recommendations.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience working collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams.
* A degree in Building Services Engineering or a related engineering discipline. Chartered Engineer status, or progress towards professional registration, would be advantageous.

**About SSE**

SSE’s purpose is to provide energy needed today while building a better world of energy for tomorrow. We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. Our Transforming for Growth investment plan sees us investing £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure across the five years to 2030.

SSEN Transmission own and operate the electricity transmission network across the north of Scotland. We transport energy from where it is generated to where it is needed, ensuring a safe and reliable electricity supply for the communities we serve. But that's not all – we're upgrading the grid to deliver cleaner, homegrown energy for the future and building a network for net zero to create secure power for generations to come.

**Flexible benefits to fit your life**

Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Consultant Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM, Power Platform & Copilot
jobs.description:
**Our Story**

BearingPoint is one of Europe's leading independent, partner-led business and technology consultancies. We are recognised as a strategic partner to our clients and operate as a boutique-style community of inspired and passionate experts, focused on innovation, collaboration and customer success.

Our UK Microsoft practice helps organisations turn business needs into tangible technology outcomes using Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Microsoft Copilot, Azure and the wider Microsoft ecosystem. The practice works across advisory, implementation, modernisation, governance, managed services and continuous optimisation.

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for an experienced Senior Technical Consultant to join our growing UK Microsoft team. This is a hands-on, client-facing role focused on the design, development, integration, deployment and support of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement, Power Platform and Copilot solutions.

The successful candidate will combine strong engineering capability with consulting skills and disciplined software delivery. They will work alongside functional consultants, architects, project managers and client teams to build scalable solutions and establish robust tooling, Application Lifecycle Management and release practices.

**Role Summary**

The Senior Technical Consultant will translate functional designs and business requirements into secure, maintainable technical solutions. The role covers the full delivery lifecycle, from discovery and technical design through development, testing, deployment, transition and production support.

The consultant will provide technical leadership within project teams, mentor colleagues, contribute to client workshops and presales, and help evolve BearingPoint's reusable methods, accelerators and engineering standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

Dynamics 365 CRM Engineering

* Design, configure and extend Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement solutions across Sales, Customer Service and Customer Insights Journeys.

* Develop plugins, custom workflow activities, custom APIs, JavaScript or TypeScript extensions, business rules and process automation.

* Configure Dataverse tables, relationships, security roles, teams, business units and field-level security.

* Apply supported extension patterns and minimise unnecessary customisation.

* Review existing estates, including managed and unmanaged layers, custom components, integrations and technical debt.

Power Platform Delivery

* Build model-driven and canvas applications, Power Automate cloud flows, Power Pages solutions and Dataverse components.

* Create reusable components, custom connectors, PCF controls and solution accelerators where appropriate.

* Implement error handling, telemetry and operational support patterns across applications and flows.

* Support governance, environment strategy, Managed Environments and platform administration.

**Copilot & Agent Solutions**

* Design and implement Copilot Studio agents and conversational experiences grounded in approved enterprise data.

* Extend Copilot for Sales, Copilot for Service and embedded Dynamics 365 Copilot capabilities.

* Connect agents to Dataverse, Power Automate, APIs and line-of-business systems.

* Implement authentication, access control, data loss prevention and responsible AI guardrails.

* Contribute to testing, evaluation, monitoring and continuous improvement of AI-enabled solutions.

**Integration, Data & Azure Services**

* Design and build integrations using Dataverse APIs, REST services, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus and event-driven patterns.

* Create data migration and integration mappings and support reconciliation and cutover.

* Design for security, resilience, retry, monitoring and failure handling.

* Collaborate with architects on target-state integration and data designs.

**Supporting Tooling & Engineering Enablement**

* Configure and maintain development tooling, source control, build automation and deployment tooling.

* Use the Power Platform CLI, Solution Packager, PowerShell and relevant administration tools to automate repeatable tasks.

* Establish coding standards, pull-request controls, code-review practices and quality gates.

* Support automated testing, static analysis, environment configuration and deployment validation.

* Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, asset inventories and knowledge articles.

**ALM & Release Management**

* Define and operate ALM processes across development, test, UAT, pre-production and production environments.

* Build and maintain Azure DevOps or Power Platform deployment pipelines for solutions and configuration.

* Manage solution packaging, dependencies, environment variables, connection references and managed solution promotion.

* Plan releases, coordinate deployment windows, manage approvals and communicate release scope, risks and readiness.

* Maintain versioning, release notes, deployment records, rollback and recovery procedures.

* Support release rehearsals, production cutover, hypercare and post-implementation review.

* Troubleshoot failed deployments, layer conflicts, missing dependencies and configuration drift.

**Technical Leadership & Client Engagement**

* Work with clients to understand business processes, non-functional requirements and operational constraints.

* Translate functional specifications into technical designs, estimates, tasks and acceptance criteria.

* Present technical options, risks and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

* Mentor consultants and developers and provide constructive review and guidance.

* Support demonstrations, discovery workshops, proposals, bids and delivery estimates.

* Contribute to BearingPoint knowledge sharing, communities, propositions and reusable delivery assets.

**Required Experience & Skills**

Dynamics 365 & Dataverse

* Strong hands-on experience delivering Dynamics CRM or Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement solutions.

* Technical experience with Sales and Customer Service; experience with Customer Insights Journeys is desirable.

* Strong understanding of Dataverse security, solution architecture, customisation and extension patterns.

**Development**

* Practical experience with C#, .NET, JavaScript or TypeScript, JSON, REST APIs and PowerShell.

* Experience with the Dataverse SDK, custom APIs, plugins and client-side scripting.

* Working knowledge of SQL and Azure integration components.

**Power Platform**

* Hands-on delivery experience with Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Power Pages and custom connectors.

* Knowledge of Power Platform governance, DLP, environment strategy and Managed Environments.

**Copilot & AI**

* Experience building with Copilot Studio or implementing Microsoft Copilot capabilities.

* Understanding of agent actions, knowledge sources, orchestration, authentication and testing.

* Awareness of responsible AI, privacy, security and human oversight requirements.

**Tooling, ALM & Releases**

* Demonstrable experience with Azure DevOps, Git and CI/CD pipelines.

* Experience promoting managed solutions across multiple environments.

* Strong understanding of version control, branching, configuration management, deployment automation and release governance.

* Experience planning production releases, cutovers, rollback and hypercare.

* Ability to diagnose and resolve deployment and environment issues.

**Consulting & Delivery**

* Experience working in client-facing delivery teams, ideally within consulting or professional services.

* Strong problem-solving, communication and documentation skills.

* Ability to balance delivery quality, maintainability, risk and deadlines.

* Experience mentoring colleagues and reviewing technical deliverables.

**Technical Toolkit**

**Core**

* Dynamics 365 Sales and Customer Service
* Dataverse
* Power Apps and Power Automate
* C#, .NET and JavaScript/TypeScript
* Azure DevOps and Git
* CI/CD and managed solutions
* Power Platform CLI and PowerShell
* Copilot Studio

**Valuable additional experience**

* Customer Insights Journeys
* Power Pages and PCF controls
* Azure Functions and Logic Apps
* Service Bus and API Management
* Automated testing frameworks
* Application Insights and monitoring
* Microsoft Fabric or Power BI
* Managed-service and support tooling

**Preferred Qualifications & Certifications**

* Degree-level education or equivalent professional experience.

* Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400).

* Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect Expert (PL-600).

* Relevant Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service or Power Platform certifications.

* Microsoft Applied Skills or recognised credentials relating to Copilot Studio, agents or Azure development.

**Personal Attributes**

* A pragmatic engineer who cares about maintainability and production quality.

* Client-focused and able to explain complex technical topics clearly.

* Structured, dependable and comfortable owning deployments and releases.

* Collaborative, curious and willing to coach others.

* Commercially aware and able to connect engineering decisions to business outcomes.

* Committed to secure delivery, responsible AI and continuous learning.

**Success Measures**

* High-quality Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Copilot solutions delivered to agreed outcomes.

* Reliable, repeatable and auditable build and release processes.

* Reduced deployment risk and faster recovery from release issues.

* Stable production services supported by clear monitoring, documentation and handover.

* Positive client feedback and trusted-advisor relationships.

* Strong contribution to team capability, reusable assets and BearingPoint practice growth.

**Why work for us?**

BearingPoint provides a highly competitive and flexible benefits package designed to support employee well-being, career development, and work-life balance. This includes private health and dental insurance, pension contributions, annual bonuses, gym membership support, professional subscriptions, paid maternity and paternity leave, income protection, nursery workplace benefits and many more.

Plus, we offer:

* Professional development: In order to aid career progression, you will be provided with the opportunity to attend exclusive business courses to help accelerate professional and network growth.

* Being part of a team with an entrepreneurial spirit that values stewardship and developing both our people and future generations. We want someone to seize the opportunity to drive us forward in directions that are meaningful to them and our clients

* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

For further information, please see BearingPoint’s careers website.

jobs.title: Senior Civil / Structural Engineer (Substations)
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

You might know us for the great work we do across our wide variety of projects. We're proud to say it's thanks to our people's diversity of thought, expertise and knowledge. And when you join us, you'll be a part of this genuinely collaborative environment, where everyone's voice is valued and treated equally.

Engineers at AtkinsRéalis are at the heart of delivering transformative projects that are lowering carbon emissions whilst achieving future energy security. Our Powergrids team is actively involved in projects spanning in electricity transmission and distribution, gas storage, battery storage, green hydrogen, power and industrial assets and other design and assessment work. You'll be part of multidisciplinary team with key expertise in the electrical transmission and distribution sector, but with goals and in an excellent location to provide project delivery capability into the other parts of the Net Zero Energy Practice.

Our practice offers a stimulating variety of work, from feasibility studies (optioneering and front-end engineering design) through to detailed design, site surveys, condition assessment and design verification.

**Your role**
-------------

* Do you enjoy a wide variety of tasks and projects? We are looking for someone versatile; you could be working on a small individual assignment or as part of a larger, multi-disciplinary team. You will enjoy working closely with clients on a range of demanding issues whilst helping to mentor and train more junior colleagues. We are looking for someone motivated and with a positive attitude. We are building our capability and would like someone to work with our civil and structural team lead to deliver technical work and support junior engineers.
* Overall, you get satisfaction from building relationships, with clients and with colleagues. You enjoy getting to know people, and working out how you can have a positive impact on them – whether that's delivering something that a client needs or helping someone to progress within the organisation.

Examples of the types of work you will be involved in:

* Supervising, developing, and mentoring others.
* Managing technical aspects of civil / structural engineering projects. This may be over a range of design phases, from optioneering through to detailed design.
* Pricing works and preparing technical proposals.
* Condition and Structural Assessment of existing structures to identify suitability for reuse.
* Design coordination across multidisciplinary teams.
* Preparing specifications/ scoping documents.
* Design lead leading our design capability in GTC, India.

**About you**
-------------

In addition to having strong communication and supervision skills, key attributes include the following:

* Master's degree (MEng/MSc) qualified Civil or Structural Engineer.
* Chartered Engineer and a Member of ICE or IStructE is desirable.
* Strong technical background, with experience of steel and reinforced concrete design using relevant UK and international codes/standards.
* Experience of working in the electricity supply industry, preferably HV substations, is desirable but not mandatory.

**Reward & benefits**
---------------------

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.

Be rewarded.

----------------------

We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

This role may require security clearance and offers of employment will be dependent on obtaining the relevant level of clearance. If this is necessary, it will be discussed with you at interview. The vetting process is delivered by United Kingdom Security Vetting (UKSV) and may require candidates to provide proof of residency in the UK of 5 years or longer. If applying to this role please do not make reference to (in conversation) or include in your application or CV, details of any current or previously held security clearance.

So, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements and employee resource groups to support all employees. As an Equal Opportunities Employer, we value applications from all backgrounds, cultures and ability.

**About the role**

**Location:** Aberdeen

Designed to strengthen the UK’s ability to transport renewable electricity from the north of Scotland to high‑demand centres nationwide, the hub will incorporate a new High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) converter station, a 400 kV substation, a 132 kV substation, and associated operational facilities. Once complete, it will enable efficient long‑distance transmission of offshore and onshore renewable energy, supporting both UK and Scottish Government net‑zero targets while delivering significant economic benefits, job creation, and local supply‑chain opportunities.

 **What you'll be doing**

The Materials Engineer will provide technical expertise and support across civil engineering projects, mainly a large earth moving project near Peterhead, ensuring compliance with specifications, standards, and regulatory requirements. This role is critical to maintaining quality assurance in materials testing and advising on material selection on the project.

* **Materials Testing & Analysis**
* + Conduct laboratory and site-based testing of aggregates, soils, concrete, and asphalt in accordance with UKAS and project specifications.
  + Interpret test results and provide technical reports to project teams.
* **Compliance & Standards**
* + Ensure adherence to Balfour Beatty’s quality management systems and relevant British Standards.
  + Support compliance with environmental and safety regulations, including IRR17 and Dangerous Goods Safety requirements.
* **Technical Support**
* + Advise project teams on material suitability, grading, and performance.
  + Assist in troubleshooting and assist with materials issues
* **Documentation & Reporting**
* + Prepare accurate records of tests, calibrations, and inspections.
  + Contribute to risk assessments and method statements for laboratory and site operations.
* **Collaboration**
* + Work closely with Senior Materials Technician, and site engineers.
  + Participate in weekly project review meetings and provide updates on material performance.

  
**Who we're looking for**  

#### **Skills & Qualifications**

* Experience in materials testing within a construction or infrastructure environment.
* Knowledge of UKAS accreditation processes and relevant standards.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and report-writing abilities.
* Confident leading audits and developing staff
* Full driving licence
* Health and safety conscientious on site and the laboratory

#### **Desirable**

* Membership of a professional body (e.g., ICE).
* Familiarity with environmental authorisations and radiation safety (advantageous for certain projects).
* Ability to manage workload across multiple projects.
* SSSTS qualified.

  
**Why work for us**

* Be part of a major energy infrastructure investment that’s shaping the UK’s low-carbon future.

* Work on challenging, high-profile projects with the support of a skilled, multi-disciplinary team.

* Join a culture of learning, improvement, and excellence—where your voice makes a difference.

* Enjoy a competitive salary, development opportunities, and a flexible, inclusive working environment.

Professional and personal development

The size and scale of Balfour Beatty coupled with our strong pipeline of work provides incredible opportunities, regardless of what stage you are at in your career.

We encourage and empower our employees to take control of their career and explore which part of the business they want to work in and what role is right for them. We actively encourage our managers and employees to have open communication throughout the year about wellbeing, development and career opportunities.

We're proud of the Balfour Beatty Academy. Whether it’s sharpening your technical expertise, improving your personal skills or seeking support to become professionally qualified, our 70:20:10\* approach to development means we have a learning approach that suits everyone.

* 70% learning on the job, 20% learning from those around you, and 10% formal training courses and learning events.

For further information about Balfour Beatty Regional Scotland please go to www.balfourbeatty.com/careers/Scotland - You can also check out further job opportunities in the careers section

 **About us**

From Dunfermline’s tramways in 1909 to highland hospitals today, Balfour Beatty has been trusted for over a century to deliver the complex and critical infrastructure and iconic buildings Scotland relies on.

We have the people, knowledge and experience to safely deliver projects right first time, maximising value for money and ensuring a positive social impact and inclusive economic growth for local communities.

Our award-winning sustainable projects, including active travel, Passivhaus and retrofit, demonstrate our commitment to supporting Scotland’s transition towards net zero in the built environment.

Diversity and inclusion

At Balfour Beatty we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential components of any successful, happy workplace. Through our Value Everyone Diversity and Inclusion Strategy and Action Plan, we are growing our diverse workforce and developing our inclusive culture where everyone is able to thrive and reach their full potential, regardless of their identity or background. To find out how we are making this a reality, visit www.balfourbeatty.com/diversityandinclusion

To help and support us with our desired commitment to create an inclusive culture we are members of WISE, enei, Business Disability Forum and the Association for Black and Minority Ethnic Engineers (AFBE). In 2020, we signed the Audeliss and Involve Open Letter to demonstrate our commitment to taking key long term and sustainable actions on Black Inclusion. Balfour Beatty is also a Gold Award holder in the Ministry of Defence 'Employer Recognition Scheme' and actively encourage applications from Armed Forces personnel, veterans and reservists.

As a Disability Confident Employer, we are committed to working with people who have disabilities and long-term health conditions to remove barriers for them in obtaining employment. We are also committed to offering applicants with a disability an interview if they meet the minimum requirements for the role. For more info, visit: https://disabilityconfident.campaign.gov.uk/

We are looking to continually improve our resourcing process and ensure that it is fair and inclusive for all. If you have any feedback on the process, please share this with us at: candidaterecruitmentqueries@balfourbeatty.com

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

Progressive Building Society is a leading local financial institution with a proud reputation for customer service excellence. Our purpose is to encourage local people to save and become homeowners, through our personal, caring & common-sense approach, essentially nurturing financial well being for current and future generations.

The Society is continuing to modernise and improve through its operational resilience processes, strong customer experience including self-services capabilities, integration between platforms, automation of processes, supporting our community and caring about our environmental impact.

**What you will be doing**

Developing, supporting and continuously improving software solutions that enhance the Society’s systems and business processes, working under supervision as part of the IT team and in line with Progressive’s development standards, security controls and regulatory requirements.

The role contributes to the Society’s strategic plan by analysing requirements, building and integrating applications, and promoting best practices such as CI/CD and test-driven development to improve user experience, automation and operational efficiency.

**About The Role**

**The Software Developer will be required to:**

* Analyse business needs with stakeholders to gather requirements for new and existing projects.
* Work with the in-house subject matter experts and IT teams to support the business and improve automation of key processes.
* Develop and maintain .NET solutions (e.g., C#, ASP.NET Core, APIs and background services) or SaaS platform changes, in line with agreed architecture and the Society’s coding standards and to deliver improved customer experience.
* Implement best practices such as continuous integration, continuous delivery and test-driven development.
* Write and maintain automated tests (unit/integration) using appropriate .NET testing frameworks and support test execution within the CI pipeline.
* Use source control and follow branching, pull request and code review practices; address review feedback and share learning with the team.
* Support data-related development including SQL query writing, stored procedure changes where applicable, and safe use of ORM/data access patterns.
* Assist with troubleshooting and resolution of defects and incidents across development, test and production environments, under supervision, including root-cause analysis and fix validation.
* Produce clear technical documentation (e.g., configuration notes, support guides and release notes) to support maintainability and knowledge sharing.
* Support build and release processes for .NET applications (e.g., Azure DevOps pipelines), including deployment steps, environment configuration and post-release verification.
* Use AI-assisted development tools appropriately to support software design, coding, testing, troubleshooting, documentation and knowledge discovery, while applying professional judgement, security requirements and coding standards.
* Evaluate and validate outputs generated by AI tools to ensure accuracy, maintainability, security and compliance with the Society's policies and regulatory obligations.
* Contribute to the adoption of emerging development practices, including responsible use of AI technologies to improve team productivity and software quality.

  *Progressive Building Society is committed to providing equal opportunities for all. As part of our recruitment process, successful applicants will be subject to our pre-employment checks. These include credit checks and criminal record checks (Access NI basic check through a responsible body).*

**Required Criteria**

* Degree in Computer Science related discipline.
* A minimum of one year’s experience developing applications in a professional work environment.
* Experience of .NET ecosystem and C#.
* Awareness of programming best practices and ability to apply them under guidance
* Good understanding of current and emerging technologies and their potential to deliver business benefits.
* Good analytical approach to problem solving.
* API integration to core platforms (e.g. banking systems).
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to adapt style and explanations to support others’ understanding.
* Understanding of AI-assisted software development tools and the ability to apply them effectively to support coding, testing, debugging, documentation and problem solving.
* Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure solutions meet security, quality and business requirements.

**Desired Criteria**

* A scripting language, such as Python or Powershell.
* Development and design skills with MS SQL or Oracle.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT or similar technologies.

**About The Company**

Careers at Progressive

We know that looking for a career means so much more than just finding a job. At Progressive, we want to help you find your happy place to work.

We firmly believe in encouraging our employees to achieve the right balance between their work and personal lives, delivering access to and promoting family-friendly policies.

This not only increases employee satisfaction but also enables Progressive to meet the needs of our Members and supports the Society in being positioned as one of the most successful financial institutions in Northern Ireland.

**Company Culture**

To work for Progressive is to be part of something special. We strive to nurture and develop our employees in the evolving and fast paced financial services industry. Outlined below are a list of the reasons why we feel Progressive is a great place to work:

We aim to provide an inclusive and respectful working environment, where everyone recognises the importance and impact of teamwork.

We celebrate staff diversity and work hard to ensure that our staff members feel valued as individuals and respected for their contribution to our success.

We offer opportunities for our staff to work at the heart of our communities and make real differences to our Members’ lives.

We do not subscribe to a long-hours culture, instead valuing family life and supporting our staff to balance work and family commitments.

**Company Benefits**

With over 60 years of experience in highly regulated sectors, the group supports public and industrial stakeholders in the execution of complex and strategic infrastructure projects, subject to high safety and security requirements.

 **Job Description**

**Join the Fusion and Modular Nuclear Business Unit!** Assystem has an exciting opportunity for a Senior Principal MechanicalEngineer to join our expanding Fusion and Modular Nuclear (FMN) business unit. As leaders in the design and development of new technologies, you will have the opportunity to work across multiple cutting-edge projectsdeveloping technical solutions making net-zero power generation a reality.

* Lead and support the development of designs for the following systems:

* Complete and maintain Human Factors Checklists to ensure ergonomics and usability are considered in design decisions.
* Update and manage the project’s Risk Register to track, evaluate, and mitigate emerging risks.
* Design Package Production in Line with Requirements – Oversee the creation of comprehensive design packages, ensuring alignment with project specifications, technical standards, and operational needs.
* Management of Interfaces – Coordinate effectively between engineering teams, suppliers, and stakeholders to ensure seamless integration of cooling water systems with other reactor components.
* Preparation of Technical Specifications – Develop clear, detailed technical specifications to guide procurement, fabrication, and installation of key cooling water system components.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including both new and existing FTEs and secondees across engineering and project functions.

**Why Join the Community of Switchers?**

* Over 55 years in nuclear engineering.
* Ranked among the top 3 largest nuclear engineering companies.
* Attractive social benefits, including an engaging Employee Committee and holiday bonuses.
* Ongoing training with numerous career opportunities.
* 70% of our managers are promoted internally!
* Hybrid work: 1-2 days remote per week.

* Multi-Disciplinary Team Leadership – Skilled in managing and coordinating diverse engineering teams.
* Steam Cycle Modelling Oversight – Ability to define modelling outcomes and ensure accurate implementation.
* Project Budget & Lifecycle Planning – Experienced in budgeting and planning for full design lifecycles.
* Cooling Water Equipment Expertise – Strong track record in designing and optimizing cooling water systems.
* Regulatory & Compliance Knowledge – Well-versed in ONR, Environment Agency, and HSE regulations.
* Requirements Capture Experience – Skilled in gathering and defining technical requirements.
* Systems Engineering Awareness – Strong understanding of integrated design principles.
* Subcontractor Management – Experienced in overseeing and coordinating subcontractors.
* Chartered Engineer (CEng) – Professional accreditation in a relevant discipline.
* Security Clearance Eligibility – Capable of obtaining SC clearance for secure projects.

  
**Additional Information**  

* Excellent communication skills, written and oral
* Strong leadership skills
* Focus on delivering quality output to time and budget
* Act with integrity and instils this in others
* Has an appreciation of wider technical issues beyond own discipline – Understands interdisciplinary challenges and their impact on projects.
* Ability to work with a high degree of independence, using their own initiative and self-motivation – Proactive and capable of managing tasks autonomously.
* Confident in a multi-party, multi-national environment – Comfortable working with global teams and diverse stakeholders.
* Ability to travel to Assystem offices and customer sites within the UK
* To undertake work packages supporting major UK and international Nuclear Clients – Contributes to high-profile nuclear projects with global impact.
