jobs.title: Graduate Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Watt Laser**

Watt Laser designs and builds high-performance laser systems. Our machines combine precision optics, motion control, electronics, and the software that drives them is at the heart of every product we ship. Our products span multiple industries including electronics and automotive.

**The Position**

We are looking for a university graduate to join our engineering team. You will work alongside experienced engineers writing the software that controls our laser machines and the systems around them, from low-level hardware control to the interfaces operators use every day.

This is a hands-on role with real responsibility. The code you write will run on machines we sell to customers, and you will see your work go from idea to operating hardware.

What you’ll do

* Develop and test software that controls laser machines, motion stages and related hardware.
* Work with control systems reading from sensors, driving actuators and keeping processes running reliably and safely.
* Build and improve tools, interfaces and dashboards used to operate, monitor and calibrate our machines.
* Help diagnose and fix issues across software, electronics and hardware, often working hands-on.
* Contribute to design discussions, code reviews and documentation as a full member of the team.

**What we’re looking for**

* Attained a degree in Software/Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electronics, Mechatronics or a related subject.
* Solid programming fundamentals – experience with C# or similar language.
* An interest in how software meets the physical world: control systems, hardware, electronics or robotics.
* A practical, methodical approach to problem-solving and a willingness to get hands-on in the lab.
* Good communication skills and the enthusiasm to learn quickly in a small, collaborative team.

**Nice to have**

* Exposure to embedded systems, microcontrollers or real-time programming.
* Experience with motion control, instrumentation, signal processing or test automation.
* Any personal, academic or hobby projects involving hardware or control.

**What you’ll get**

* A genuine engineering role with mentoring, ownership of real projects and a clear view of how a product is built end to end.
* Experience across the full stack of a physical product – software, control, electronics and optics.
* A competitive salary.

**Location: Glasgow - On Site**

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Glasgow G73: reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (preferred)

Application question(s):

* Will you now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status?

Education:

* Bachelor's (preferred)

Work authorisation:

* United Kingdom (required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

This is an exciting opportunity for a Full Stack Engineer to grow their career at AJ Bell, helping us to develop the future of our services that power Feel Good Investing. You will be joining a cross functional development team which has a philosophy of continuous improvement, and a strong focus on engineering excellence.

This role is part of a growing team focussed on providing the core services that underpin our apps and websites, ensuring our customers are provided with world-class innovative investment solutions and services.

We are on the lookout for an experienced Full Stack Engineer who can help architect, build and deploy apis, web apps, data layers, and 3rd party integrations across the stack, from NodeJS (Typescript), MongoDB, React, and cloud-native solutions in AWS.

**What to expect:**

* Hands-on with full stack feature development, working with other engineers across different disciplines in a dedicated product-aligned squad
* A dynamic, cross-functional Agile squad with a continuous improvement mindset, and autonomy to do the right thing
* Working closely with Product, UX and Business colleagues, as well as mobile and web engineers, to propose new solutions and pilot ideas that help customers Feel Good Investing
* Embrace a ‘build it, run it, own it’ DevOps mentality, nurturing code from idea all the way to production

**Tech Competency**

* 5+ years commercial experience developing web applications and APIs with some of the following; Node (Typescript), React, PHP, .NET core, MongoDB and/or SQL.
* Experience in developing HTTP-based APIs and implementation of RESTful services, as well as GraphQL
* Thorough understanding of CI/CD pipelines with experience of Jenkins and/or CodePipeline
* Practices Test Driven Development and is comfortable with various test frameworks and concepts.
* Familiarisation with containerisation and tools like Docker, ECS or Kubernetes
* Experience of developing, deploying, and maintaining Cloud-Based solutions on AWS
* Strong technical background in web development with Javascript frameworks would be ideal
* Understand the principles behind what makes a high performing web page

**Other required skills:**

* Demonstrable experience working with stakeholders from product management and other business areas to design and deliver a solution
* An interest in user experience and an appreciation for helping to solve the problem customers have
* A keen eye for detail and ability to articulate and digest technical and non-technical requirements to others

**About AJ Bell**

AJ Bell is one of the UK’s fastest-growing investment platform businesses, providing award-winning solutions for everyone, from professional financial advisers to first-time investors.

Today, over 762,000 customers trust us to manage more than £121.5 billion of assets. By continually striving to make investing simpler and more accessible, we’re helping more people take control of their financial futures.

We’re proud to be recognised as one of the UK’s Best 100 Companies to Work For for six consecutive years, and a Great Place to Work® in 2025 and 2026 a reflection of our supportive and collaborative culture.

**What we offer**

* 25 days holiday, increasing with service + buy/sell scheme + bank holidays
* 6% Pension with matched contributions
* Share schemes (including free shares and BAYE)
* Health Cash Plan and discounted private healthcare
* Free onsite gym
* Enhanced family leave (subject to qualifying criteria)
* Travel and bike loan schemes Employee Assistance Programme

**Life at AJ Bell**

* Regular social events including summer and Christmas parties
* Learning and development opportunities tailored to you
* Casual dress code
* Friendly, supportive team environment

**Our ways of working**

We offer hybrid working, with a minimum of 50% of your working time per month spent in the office.

For new starters, there’s an initial period of full-time office working to help you settle in and build relationships.

**Inclusion & diversity**

We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and able to be themselves at work.

We welcome applications from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential.

jobs.title: AI & Software Development Apprentice
jobs.description:
**Hands-On AI & Software Development Apprentice**

**Full-time apprenticeship | Northampton | On site**

**Cybist has an exceptional opportunity for a bright, creative and ambitious aspiring software developer to take steps towards turning a passion for AI into a career, in a real world practical environment helping build intelligent applications and integrations that make a real difference to a growing business.**

**About Cybist**

We are a rapidly growing **eco tech business**, giving high-quality computers and IT equipment a second life, reducing electronic waste and making technology more accessible. Visit cybist.com or visit our Amazon webstore.

Our small, friendly, professional team has big ambitions. We are rapidly integrating AI into our software and business systems, developing tools for product identification, listing creation, app integration and commercial decision-making.

Our commitment to creating opportunities for young people has been recognised with a Department for Work and Pensions (DWP) Kickstart award. We are also engaging with Amazon’s US team on advanced listing and multichannel selling tools, contributing practical feedback from our own development and commercial experience.

You will learn how AI and software can support our work streams - and you will be hands-on and carry out work with the hardware itself, equipment and processes.

As your skills develop, the role can evolve around your strengths, interests and the needs of the business.

**What you will work on**

* Building and testing AI-assisted applications for real business use.
* Connecting apps and services through APIs and tools such as Zapier, Make and n8n.
* Developing software that supports product listings, ecommerce and our internal operational systems.
* Supporting practical production and stock workflows, using our mobile app to capture product information and photographs, and helping organise equipment in the correct stock areas.
* Working with code, databases and AI tools to solve practical problems.
* Exploring new ideas and helping turn the best ones into reliable, useful applications.

**Who we are looking for**

Someone with a fantastic enthusiasm for AI and software, strong technical curiosity and an ability to solve problems and the determination to work things out. Someone not afraid to work hard and to put in what it takes to achieve success.

You should already be experimenting with coding, AI tools or automation. Personal projects, college work, a useful script, an app integration or something you have built for fun can all demonstrate your potential.

Familiarity with coding would be useful, whether in Python, JavaScript or another language. We also value creativity, clear thinking, attention to detail and the ability to work well with others. Our current system being developed is PostgressSQL/.NET/React and Tailwind using ChatGPT Pro/Codex.

**What you will gain**

* Structured apprenticeship training, a recognised qualification and paid time for learning.
* Practical support and mentoring within a small team.
* Experience developing software and AI integrations used in a real business.
* The chance to contribute ideas and take increasing responsibility as your skills grow.
* A foundation for a career in software development, AI and automation.

**How to apply**

To help your application stand out, please send your CV with a short cover letter explaining:

**Are you good at spinning plates?**

It’s not something you see very often on TV these days, but figuratively, it is a very useful skill, one which is vital if your goal is to keep nuclear power stations operating safely, contributing to the UK’s Net Zero carbon target, or to help prepare them for decommissioning.

  

The UK’s five operating stations deliver 16% of the UK’s power, and it takes a large team delivering 100’s of projects to enable these stations to continue generating as well as defuel the three stations that have ceased operation - and that’s a lot of plates.

* Marshall projects through an investment delivery process, from FEED to solution delivery
* Act as Architect Engineer on projects, taking ownership of technical challenges, developing strategies, and managing stakeholders and interfaces in order to implement technical solutions
* Development and delivery of clear engineering strategies
* Manage significant number of varied stakeholders
* Deliver projects across a typical project lifecycle, including bidding, definition of requirements, design and implementation, into delivery of commissioned systems ready to support the needs of our clients

* Support the Project Manager with respect to resourcing and financial elements, such as costs and schedule, and supporting change control and identification and control of technical risks

* Nuclear industry, and/or equivalent safety case, experience
* Demonstrable experience in leading and managing multidiscipline teams
* Proven experience of engineering delivery within a nuclear or highly regulated environment

* Ability to produce a project strategy to solve technical problems and take ownership of all the interfaces to implement the solution

* Knowledge of Project Management principles and experience of handling change control and making informed judgements to control or mitigate project risks
* Committed to Continuous Professional Development of self and others
* Previous experience working on the UK’s fleet of operational or decommissioning nuclear power plants is highly desirable

Our values are built on a strong foundation of safety, integrity, and respect for every individual. People are at the heart of our mission, and we believe in supporting one another through a culture of care and collaboration.

* Demonstrate knowledge of the practical aspects of implementing engineering designs and understand the use of standards and compliance with regulatory requirements in an engineering environment

* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to less experienced engineers
* Interface with clients, regulators, and project stakeholders on technical matters

* Produce high-quality technical reports

If you're passionate about making a real impact and want to be part of a community that values ethical excellence, this is the place where your ambition can thrive.

Here, we believe that success comes from continuously pushing boundaries and working together to deliver on our promises. We embrace challenges with confidence and are dedicated to creating a secure and vibrant future for all.

We’ll inspire and empower you to deliver your best work so you can evolve, grow and succeed – today and into tomorrow. We offer an exciting range of opportunities to develop your career within a supportive team who always strive to do the right thing for our people, clients and communities.

People are our greatest asset, and we offer a competitive package to retain and attract the best talent.

In addition to the benefits you’d expect, UK employees also receive free single medical cover and digital GP service, family-friendly benefits such as enhanced parental leave pay and free membership of employee assistance and parental programmes, plus reimbursement towards relevant professional development and memberships.

**Work-life balance and flexibility is a key focus area** for us. We’re happy to discuss **hybrid, part-time and flexible working hours**, patterns and locations to suit you and our business.

**About the Opportunity**

Amentum is currently recruiting for an Architect Engineer - Engineering Manager to join our Engineering & Technical Services (ETS) business. jobs.title: Interim Software Development Manager
jobs.description:
**About The Role**
------------------

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Interim Software Development Manager to lead our Software Development function in a 12-month fixed term contract. This is a key leadership role responsible for ensuring the successful delivery, support and continuous improvement of secure, resilient and high-quality software solutions that underpin critical business services.

Leading teams across a diverse technology landscape including RPG, Visualfiles, .NET and Java, you will provide technical leadership, operational oversight and people management while working closely with our Architecture, Security, Solution Delivery and Governance teams.

You will be responsible for driving engineering excellence, embedding effective development practices and ensuring delivery remains aligned with business priorities. Alongside supporting day-to-day development and application support activities, you will play a vital role in modernising approaches, improving delivery processes and strengthening the overall capability of the function.

As an interim leader, you will quickly assess the current environment, identify opportunities for improvement and implement practical solutions that deliver lasting value. By the end of the assignment, you will leave behind clear processes, documented ways of working and a roadmap for future success.

Key responsibilities include:

* Leading and developing Software Development Team Leaders across multiple technology stacks.
* Driving a high-performing, collaborative and customer-focused engineering culture.
* Overseeing end-to-end software delivery across a broad application portfolio.
* Championing Agile delivery practices, Azure DevOps governance and CI/CD maturity.
* Managing application support, incident triage and continuous service improvement.
* Collaborating with Architecture, Security, Solution Delivery and Governance teams to ensure solutions are secure, compliant and aligned with strategic objectives.
* Supporting application stability, resilience and operational performance.
* Managing third-party suppliers, technical dependencies and delivery risks.
* Identifying opportunities to modernise legacy platforms and improve engineering capability.

**About You**
-------------

You will be an experienced software development leader who can quickly establish credibility, provide direction and drive meaningful improvements within a complex technology environment.

You will have a strong technical background and be comfortable engaging in discussions around software engineering, architecture, security and application support. You will combine strategic thinking with a pragmatic, hands-on approach and be confident leading multiple teams through change and improvement initiatives.

You will also bring:

* Proven experience in a Software Development Manager, Head of Development or similar leadership role.
* Experience leading multiple development teams across a range of technology platforms and software stacks.
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies, DevOps principles and modern software engineering practices.
* Experience overseeing Azure DevOps, including Boards, Repositories and Pipelines.
* A track record of improving delivery performance, operational resilience and engineering standards.
* Experience managing application support functions, incident resolution and continual service improvement.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
* Experience working alongside Architecture, Security, Governance and Delivery functions within a structured technology environment.
* Excellent communication, leadership and people development skills.
* The ability to quickly assess challenges, establish priorities and deliver results within an interim assignment.

**About The Company**
---------------------

ARAG UK has been helping businesses and individuals gain access to justice for over 40 years. It’s our founding principle to enable everybody, not just those who can afford it, to assert their legal rights.

Thousands of businesses and individuals defend or pursue legal action each year safe in the knowledge that ARAG are paying their legal bills. Our businesses include a legal expenses insurance company and a law firm with many opportunities in both areas.

We have always been aware that it’s the people that really make it happen; the quality of our people defines the quality of the company, the service we offer and the good outcomes for our customers, so we’re committed to creating a great place to work for our employees.

We believe it is an exciting time to join ARAG. You can expect an organisation that will challenge and develop you to progress your career.

By giving you every opportunity to develop yourself professionally and personally, we also pride ourselves on having an open, inclusive and high energy culture that encourages a fun working environment and places our customers at the very heart of everything we do.

If you are keen to become part of our exciting future then we would love to hear from you. In addition to the very genuine development opportunities we provide we also offer a generous reward and benefits package.

Scientific Software Engineer Intern (3 months) - Starting Summer 2027

*Project Title: Development of a Boundary Element Method Solver for Porous Media Flow*

**About SLB:**

We are a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet.

  

At SLB we create amazing technology that unlocks access to energy for the benefit of all. That is our purpose. As innovators, that has been our mission for 100 years. **Location:**

Abingdon, Oxofrdshire

**Description & Scope:**

The internship project focuses on developing a 2D solver for fluid flow in porous media as a simplified reservoir model. The solver will be based on the boundary element method (BEM), offering an efficient approach for simulating flow without the need for full volumetric discretization.

An important aspect of the project is enabling the solver to handle embedded elements, such as wells and fractures, which play a critical role in controlling flow behavior. The scope includes implementing the core solver, extending it to represent these embedded features, and validating the results on simplified test cases. This work will provide the intern with hands-on experience in scientific computing, numerical methods, and reservoir modeling, while contributing a practical tool for exploring innovative simulation techniques.

* Contribute to the extension of an existing 2D boundary element solver for fluid flow in porous media.
* The main task will be to add support for embedded elements such as wells and fractures, ensuring that these features are correctly represented in the simulation.
* Implementing the new functionality, testing it on simple cases, and documenting the results.
* Deliverables will be an extended solver prototype, validation of results,
* Create a technical report.

  

Through this project, the student will gain valuable experience in numerical modeling, scientific programming, and applied mathematics. They will also learn how to incorporate physical features like wells and fractures into simulation tools, and how simplified reservoir models can be used to study complex subsurface behavior. By the end of the internship, the student will have hands-on experience enhancing a solver that connects theory, coding, and reservoir applications.

**Qualifications****:**

* Studying a Bachelors or Masters in Applied Mathematics, Numerical Analysis, Software Engineering or a related discipline
* Partial Differental Equations
* Numerical Analysis
Software Engineering

Solution operates a software division (ProcessVue) offering applications to Alarm Management and IoT Analytics market. With offices in both UK and Europe, M.A.C. Solutions continues to grow nationally and internationally, offering customers the experience to Connect, Secure & Analyse their assets and data.

To keep up with demands from global growth, M.A.C. Solutions is looking to recruit a talented Backend & AI Software Developer who is passionate about software development, is willing to learn on the job and wants to work in a very diverse work environment.

Based in our software development centre in Chesterfield (hybrid/ remote), you will work on the AI and data side of our software as part of the development team, taking care of the following:

* Design and build secure, scalable backend services, APIs and integrations in C# / .NET

jobs.title: Engineering Manager (Core)
jobs.description:
At **Ocean Infinity**, we're on a bold mission to subsea data using innovative technology.

Using cutting-edge robotics, autonomous technology and world-class software, we're transforming how complex operations are carried out at sea. Our uncrewed systems are making ocean exploration and operations **safer, smarter and more sustainable**, helping unlock the vast potential of our oceans while reducing environmental impact.

This isn't a vision for the future. **It's happening right now.**

As we continue to push the boundaries of innovation and redefine what's possible in the maritime industry, we're looking for exceptional talent to join our fast-growing team.

Ocean Infinity is looking for an Engineering Manager to own the people, organisational capability and engineering capacity of a group of engineers within our Core Engineering team ( C#/.NET **or** Node/TypeScript). This is a senior people-leadership role: rather than owning the technical architecture or product priority, your role is to make sure the engineers in your group are well managed, performing to the best of their abilities, and developed and deployed against the organisation’s priorities.

You’ll work closely with team leads to keep technical leadership and people management aligned as the engineering group grows, and hold responsibility for building a scalable engineering team.

 **Requirements**

**What you will do!**

* Line-manage a group of engineers: run regular 1:1s, give feedback, and own their career development.
* Own performance management, recognition and reward for your engineers.
* Lead recruitment, onboarding and retention across your group.
* Own capacity and resource planning – decide where engineering resource is deployed and flag constraints early.
* Work with engineers to allocate them to projects, and manage workload to ensure projects can be delivered on time and with a high level of quality.
* Work with the product team and other team leads to resolve resource constraints and balance competing demands for capacity.
* Build the succession and technical leadership pipeline within your group, and identify capability gaps before they affect the team.
* Protect team health, engagement and working environment, and escalate organisational, staffing or performance issues that threaten delivery.

**What we look for!**

* Several years’ experience managing and developing software engineers, ideally within a scaling engineering organisation.
* A track record of hiring, retaining and developing engineering talent, including into more senior or lead roles.
* Comfortable balancing competing demands for engineering capacity across multiple concurrent projects or squads.
* Strong 1:1, coaching and feedback skills, with the judgement to handle performance issues fairly and directly.
* Enough technical credibility in engineering to earn the trust of the engineers you manage – you don’t need to own the technology, but you need to know how it works.
* Comfortable with capacity/resource planning and making trade-off calls under constraint.
* Genuine care for people’s development, combined with the willingness to have hard conversations about performance.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
**About us**

We're a Manchester-based FinTech building a smarter way for tenants to pay rent. Our platform pays landlords the full rent on time and collects smaller instalments from tenants via Open Banking Variable Recurring Payments (VRP). We're a small, high-trust engineering team solving genuinely hard problems in payments, credit, and financial correctness — where getting the maths and the money movement exactly right matters.

**The role**

We're looking for a **Senior Full Stack Developer** to own features end-to-end across our .NET backend and React Native mobile client. You'll work close to the domain — instalment maths, double-entry ledgers, scheduled money movement, and third-party integrations with banking and identity providers. This is a hands-on senior role with real ownership and influence over architecture.

**What you'll work with**

* **Backend:** .NET 10 / C#, EF Core (SQL Server), a service-oriented solution with clean domain boundaries
* **Async & messaging:** MassTransit, background workers, durable/idempotent scheduled jobs
* **Cloud & platform:** Azure, .NET Aspire, containerised services
* **Mobile:** Expo / React Native (TypeScript)
* **Integrations:** Open Banking, VRP, BaaS, identity verification, credit decisioning
* **Practices:** ADR-driven architecture, EF Core migrations, automated testing (MSTest, NSubstitute, FluentAssertions)

**What you'll do**

* Design and ship features spanning the C# backend and the React Native app
* Model financial domains carefully — money, fees, timing differences, ledgers — where precision is non-negotiable
* Build resilient, idempotent background processing for payment execution and scheduling
* Integrate with external banking, payments, and identity providers
* Contribute to architectural decisions

**What we are looking for**

* Strong commercial experience with **C# / .NET** and modern **TypeScript**
* **Solid EF Core** / relational database skills (SQL Server ideal)
* Experience building and consuming APIs, and working with asynchronous/message-based systems
* **React Native (Expo)** experience, or strong React skills and appetite to work across mobile
* A pragmatic, quality-first mindset — you care about correctness, testing, and clear design
* Bonus: FinTech / payments / Open Banking experience, cloud (Azure), event-driven architecture

**Benefits**

* £65k–£85k salary depending on experience
* Hybrid working from our Manchester office
* 25 days holiday + bank holidays
* Pension, and the chance to shape a product (and a team) from an early stage
* Meaningful ownership and a direct line to the impact of your work
* **Sound like you?** Apply with your CV and a short note on something you've built that you're proud of.

Pay: £65,000.00-£85,000.00 per year

* Do you now or in the future require sponsorship for a work visa?
* What are your base salary expectations?

Experience:

* C#: 5 years (required)
* React Native: 2 years (required)

Work authorisation:

* United Kingdom (required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Manchester

jobs.title: Front End Developer
jobs.description:

We are bringing those services into a clearer, connected digital experience. Our client-facing estate includes public websites, account and service tools, checkout, help centre, and embedded experiences. The products serve new founders, established businesses, MYCO clients, and the teams supporting them.

**About the role**

We are looking for a product-focused Frontend Developer with strong UI craft. You will take hands-on ownership across MYCO's client-facing surfaces, from public marketing journeys to authenticated tools and checkout.

This is a broad role for someone comfortable moving between visual detail and application complexity. You might build a polished landing page, improve a multi-step form, shape an account workflow, or strengthen a shared component used across several products.

You will work with product, design, marketing, operations, and backend engineering. Some work will begin with detailed designs. Other work will start with a customer problem, a rough concept, or an existing journey needing improvement. You should enjoy turning each into accessible, maintainable software.

Our frontend applications use React, Next.js, and TypeScript. They share UI foundations, CMS content, catalogue data, and analytics. Frontends are hosted on Vercel and integrate with a .NET backend backed by Microsoft SQL Server on Azure.

**What you will do**

* Build and improve MYCO's websites, client tools, checkout, help centre, and embedded experiences.
* Turn designs and early concepts into responsive, accessible production interfaces.
* Own customer journeys across marketing, account creation, purchase, and service management.
* Develop shared components and patterns that improve consistency across products.
* Work with Payload CMS content while protecting performance, usability, and design quality.
* Integrate frontend applications with .NET APIs and third-party services.
* Use customer behaviour, analytics, and team feedback to improve shipped work.
* Test your work and help strengthen practical frontend quality standards.
* Use AI-assisted development tools to explore, build, and iterate efficiently.
* Review generated work carefully and remain accountable for every shipped change.

**What we are looking for**

* Strong production experience with React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
* Evidence of owning meaningful frontend work from problem to release.
* Sound knowledge of semantic HTML, modern CSS, responsive design, and browser behaviour.
* A strong eye for composition, hierarchy, typography, interaction, and visual detail.
* Experience building accessible interfaces and applying WCAG guidance in practice.
* Confidence working with forms, validation, API data, loading states, and error handling.
* An understanding of frontend performance, maintainability, and reusable component design.
* Experience testing frontend behaviour with suitable automated and manual techniques.
* Confidence with Git, GitHub pull requests, code review, and CI/CD workflows.
* A practical AI-assisted workflow using tools such as Cursor, Codex, Claude, or equivalent.
* Good judgement about when to move quickly and when a customer journey needs deeper care.
* Clear communication with both technical and non-technical colleagues.

We are hiring at mid-to-senior level, but we do not use years of experience as a rigid filter. We care more about the scope you have owned, the decisions you can explain, and the quality of what you have shipped.

**Nice to watch**

* Experience with Tailwind CSS and Radix or shadcn component patterns.
* Experience contributing to a shared component library or design system.
* Familiarity with Payload CMS or another headless content platform.
* Experience integrating with .NET APIs.
* Familiarity with Stripe and customer-facing commerce journeys.
* Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, or similar planning and documentation tools.
* Experience improving accessibility, performance, analytics, or conversion.
* Familiarity with regulated or identity-sensitive customer journeys.

Please share a portfolio, shipped product, code sample, or another example that shows how you approach frontend work. Tell us what you owned, the problem you addressed, and the decisions you made.

You do not need to meet every item to apply. If the role fits your strengths and direction, we would like to hear from you. We welcome applicants from different backgrounds and will make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process.

Must be eligible to work in the U.K.

Employees may be subject to a DBS check.

Pay: £42,000.00-£45,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Computer Vision Engineer
jobs.description:
### **Description**

As a Computer Vision Engineer, you'll join a collaborative team developing SLAM, perception and sensor-fusion capabilities for real-world navigation and mapping products. The role sits at the intersection of computer vision, navigation, geospatial data and embedded systems.

With the support from experienced colleagues, you'll contribute to products and technologies used across automotive testing, autonomous systems, surveying and mobile mapping applications.

If you've worked on projects that combine LIDAR, Cameras, GPS, accelerometers or gyroscopes on a moving platform, we'd love to hear from you!

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

We’re looking for someone who can:

* Apply software engineering, mathematical and analytical skills to solve interesting technical problems and support the continued development of OXTS products.
* Help us developing software that combines LIDAR, cameras, Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS), inertial sensors and advanced mathematical techniques to deliver highly accurate positioning, orientation, motion and mapping data.
* Contribute to technical investigations, algorithm evaluation, experimental analysis and innovation activities that support future product development and technical roadmaps.
* Take responsibility for technical deliverables, have autonomy over your day-to-day engineering work, and keep growing your expertise while collaborating with colleagues on shared team and project goals.

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

Essentials

* Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, related Degree or equivalent experience.
* A genuine interest in continued learning and professional development
* Experience in at least one of: computer vision, SLAM, robotics, mapping, perception and/or sensor-fusion systems.
* Experience delivering production-quality engineering software.
* Understanding of software architecture, code quality, testing and CI/CD.

Nice to have

* Experience with LiDAR and camera data processing.
* Experience with IMU/GNSS-aided sensor fusion.
* Experience with C++, C# or Python in engineering software.
* Familiarity with Linux, Docker, CUDA or GPU acceleration.
* Understanding of navigation, localisation or mapping products.
* Familiarity with React or web-based visualisation tools.
* Experience using AI coding assistants to improve engineering productivity.

  

### **Benefits**

  

* Discretionary annual profit share bonus
* 27 days annual leave plus bank holidays
* 5% employee and 5% employer contributions through our via our salary sacrifice workplace pension scheme
* Group Income Protection Insurance Scheme
* Private Medical Insurance
* Death In Service Scheme
* Electric Vehicle Scheme
* Smart casual dress code

  

### **About OXTS**

At OXTS we’re passionate about inertial navigation and how we can help our customers with our technology. With two decades of experience in combining the best of high precision GNSS receivers and world-class inertial navigation expertise, OXTS’ products have become the industry standard for automotive testing and are widely used in other industries.  
  
The highly accurate RT3000 products are the equipment of choice for vehicle dynamics testing. Our products are used by major car manufacturers and automotive test facilities around the world for applications such as handling and dynamics evaluation, brake testing, steering robot guidance and many more. With the RT-Range S products, OXTS also offers a complete solution for validating advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) to Euro and global NCAP standards and for developing the self-driving cars of the future.  
  
Away from the automotive world, our range of combined, compact GNSS/INS systems are also used for airborne and vehicle-based survey and mobile mapping applications, where continuous position and high accuracy orientation information is essential for georeferencing sensor data.  
  
OXTS’ GNSS/INS products are supplied with a comprehensive software suite including powerful data analysis and post-processing applications. We also provide a full technical support service, plus a bespoke technology integration consultancy via our Application Engineering department. Our products are sold and supported globally through a network of channel partners in more than 20 countries worldwide, to provide customers with a local point of contact and support.

About Assystem
--------------

Today, Assystem is among the top three independent nuclear engineering firms worldwide. With over 60 years of experience in highly regulated sectors, the group supports public and industrial stakeholders in the execution of complex and strategic infrastructure projects, subject to high safety and security requirements.

  
  

Assystem mobilizes 8,000 experts in 13 countries and intervenes across the entire project lifecycle, in engineering, project management and digital solutions.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Join the Fusion and Modular Nuclear Business Unit!** Assystem has an exciting opportunity for a Senior Principal MechanicalEngineer to join our expanding Fusion and Modular Nuclear (FMN) business unit. As leaders in the design and development of new technologies, you will have the opportunity to work across multiple cutting-edge projectsdeveloping technical solutions making net-zero power generation a reality.

**Your mission:**

* Lead and support the development of designs for the following systems:
* Personnel Airlocks, Main Equipment Access Hatch, Fuel Transfer Channel, Piping Penetrations, Electrical Penetrations, Specialist Nuclear Doors
* Conduct DFMEA (Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) to identify and mitigate potential failure modes early in the design process.
* Perform HAZID (Hazard Identification Study) to assess and document risks across the system.
* Complete and maintain Human Factors Checklists to ensure ergonomics and usability are considered in design decisions.
* Update and manage the project’s Risk Register to track, evaluate, and mitigate emerging risks.
* Design Package Production in Line with Requirements – Oversee the creation of comprehensive design packages, ensuring alignment with project specifications, technical standards, and operational needs.
* Management of Interfaces – Coordinate effectively between engineering teams, suppliers, and stakeholders to ensure seamless integration of cooling water systems with other reactor components.
* Preparation of Technical Specifications – Develop clear, detailed technical specifications to guide procurement, fabrication, and installation of key cooling water system components.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including both new and existing FTEs and secondees across engineering and project functions.

**Why Join the Community of Switchers?**

* Over 55 years in nuclear engineering.
* Ranked among the top 3 largest nuclear engineering companies.
* Attractive social benefits, including an engaging Employee Committee and holiday bonuses.
* Ongoing training with numerous career opportunities.
* 70% of our managers are promoted internally!
* Hybrid work: 1-2 days remote per week.

**My profile**
--------------

* Multi-Disciplinary Team Leadership – Skilled in managing and coordinating diverse engineering teams.
* Steam Cycle Modelling Oversight – Ability to define modelling outcomes and ensure accurate implementation.
* Project Budget & Lifecycle Planning – Experienced in budgeting and planning for full design lifecycles.
* Cooling Water Equipment Expertise – Strong track record in designing and optimizing cooling water systems.
* Regulatory & Compliance Knowledge – Well-versed in ONR, Environment Agency, and HSE regulations.
* Requirements Capture Experience – Skilled in gathering and defining technical requirements.
* Systems Engineering Awareness – Strong understanding of integrated design principles.
* Subcontractor Management – Experienced in overseeing and coordinating subcontractors.
* Chartered Engineer (CEng) – Professional accreditation in a relevant discipline.
* Security Clearance Eligibility – Capable of obtaining SC clearance for secure projects.

* Excellent communication skills, written and oral
* Strong leadership skills
* Focus on delivering quality output to time and budget
* Act with integrity and instils this in others
* Has an appreciation of wider technical issues beyond own discipline – Understands interdisciplinary challenges and their impact on projects.
* Ability to work with a high degree of independence, using their own initiative and self-motivation – Proactive and capable of managing tasks autonomously.
* Confident in a multi-party, multi-national environment – Comfortable working with global teams and diverse stakeholders.
* Ability to travel to Assystem offices and customer sites within the UK
* To undertake work packages supporting major UK and international Nuclear Clients – Contributes to high-profile nuclear projects with global impact.

**Due to the nature of work to be undertaken applicants will be required to meet certain residency criteria in order to attain a minimum level of UK security clearance if not already security cleared to a minimum SC level.**

**NOTICE TO CANDIDATES ON RECRUITMENT FRAUD – We are committed to safeguarding candidates from fraudulent activity associated with our recruitment process. Please note that we will never offer specialist CV writing services, request payment or ask for sensitive personal information during the recruitment process.**

We are committed to equal treatment of candidates and promote, as well as foster all forms of diversity within our company. We believe that bringing together people with different backgrounds and perspectives is essential for creating innovative and impactful solutions. Skills, talent, and our people’s ability to dare are the only things that matter !. Bring your unique contributions and help us shape the future.

jobs.description:

**Warwick, GB, CV34 6DA**

Date posted

**5 October 2026**

**HVDC Converter Station Engineer**
===================================

### **About the role**

Are you an ambitious electrical engineer looking to work on some of the most innovative energy infrastructure projects in Europe?

At **National Grid Ventures (NGV)**, we're delivering the next generation of interconnectors and offshore hybrid assets that will help connect renewable energy, strengthen energy security and support the transition to net zero. As an **HVDC Converter Station Engineer**, you'll play a key role in shaping the technology at the heart of these projects, including **LionLink** – a pioneering development connecting the UK to offshore wind generation in the Netherlands and onward to the Dutch onshore grid.

This is an exciting opportunity to develop specialist expertise in **High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC)** technology while working alongside industry-leading engineers, international partners and global technology suppliers.

### **What you'll do**

As a Converter Station Engineer, you'll support the design, development and delivery of HVDC converter station systems across major strategic projects. You'll gain exposure to real engineering challenges and play a key part in ensuring projects are delivered safely, efficiently and to the highest technical standards.

Key responsibilities include:

* Supporting the development and assurance of converter station requirements from concept through to delivery.
* Providing technical support during the Development Consent Order (DCO) process, including the preparation of responses to technical queries.
* Working with OEMs, consultants and project partners to demonstrate compliance with GB Grid Code requirements, National Grid standards and project specifications.
* Reviewing designs, studies, reports and technical proposals, helping to resolve engineering challenges throughout project delivery.
* Supporting critical interfaces across converter technology, grid connection, cable, civil, control and wider project teams.
* Participating in design reviews, factory acceptance testing, site testing and commissioning activities.
* Supporting the integration of protection and control systems, communications, auxiliary systems and third-party interfaces.
* Contributing technical expertise to tender evaluations and future technology selections.

### **What you'll need**

We're looking for engineers who are curious, collaborative and excited by the opportunity to develop expertise in a specialist area that is central to the energy transition.

You'll ideally have:

* A degree, or equivalent experience, in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, HVDC, Control Systems, Substations or a related discipline.
* A genuine interest in power transmission, renewable energy integration or major infrastructure projects.
* Knowledge of HVDC technology, converter stations, substations, electrical systems or protection and control systems (desirable but not essential).
* The ability to analyse technical information and communicate effectively with a variety of stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to learning.
* A collaborative mindset and the confidence to contribute within a supportive engineering team.

### **What you'll get**

A competitive salary between £54,000 - £63,000 per annum– dependent on capability.

As well as your base salary, you will receive a bonus based on personal and company performance and a competitive contributory pension scheme where we will double match your contribution to a maximum company contribution of 12%. You will also have access to a number of flexible benefits such as a share incentive plan, salary sacrifice car and technology schemes, support via employee assistance lines and matched charity giving to name a few.

###

**This role closes on Tuesday 20th October at 23:59**, however we encourage candidates to submit their application as early as possible and not wait until the published closing date as this can vary.

We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace for all. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates – we make appointments purely on merit, assessed against objective selection criteria. We support flexible working and will make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process should you have any physical or mental impairment which may affect your ability to participate in the process.

Please note that in most cases, National Grid is unable to offer sponsorship for employment under the UK points-based immigration system. As such, applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK without requiring sponsorship now or in the future under the UK points-based immigration system. However, in exceptional circumstances where there is a clear and demonstrable need for specialist skills that cannot be sourced from the local labour market, National Grid may consider offering sponsorship. All applications are welcome from candidates who meet these requirements, regardless of race, nationality, or ethnic origin.

**Associate Software Developer - Hybrid, Glasgow, UK**

We’re a leader in data and AI. Through our software and services, we inspire customers around the world to transform data into intelligence - and questions into answers.

If you're looking for a dynamic, fulfilling career with flexibility and a world-class employee experience, you'll find it here. We're recognized around the world for our inclusive, meaningful culture and innovative technologies by organizations like Fast Company, Forbes, Newsweek and more.

**About the job**

The Research and Development Risk team is looking for an Associate Software Developer. We build and support a cloud-native platform for SAS's financial-risk solutions, used by banks and insurers around the world. The platform runs on Kubernetes and is built from backend services, a SAS programming layer, a web UI, and tooling for deployment and testing.

We're a collaborative team that works on new features and customer support, and ships updates regularly. We value careful investigation, clear communication and sharing knowledge.

**As an Associate Software Developer, you will:**

* Fix defects and make small improvements across the platform.
* Write and maintain code and unit tests, following the team's existing patterns.
* Add and maintain automated tests to keep the product reliable.
* Help investigate reported issues and learn to find their root cause.
* Track your work in Jira. Keep tickets up to date with progress, findings and fix details, and link each ticket to its pull request.
* Open pull requests and take part in code reviews (yours and others').
* Use AI-assisted development tools in your daily work and learn to check their output.
* Ensure all applicable security policies and processes are followed to support the organization's secure software development goals.
* Embrace curiosity, passion, authenticity and accountability. These are our values and influence everything we do.

**Required qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree, or one in progress, in computer science, engineering, mathematics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Internships, coursework and personal projects count.
* Programming experience in at least one language, such as Python, Go, Java or C#.
* Basic SQL, such as writing SELECT queries with joins and filters.
* Basic understanding of REST APIs and HTTP.
* Basic familiarity with Git and the command line.
* Curiosity and patience when debugging, and willingness to ask questions.
* Clear written English.
* Proof of Right to work in the UK

**Additional competencies, knowledge and skills**

* Collaboration - Working cooperatively with others to help a team or work group achieve its goals.

* Some experience with Docker, Kubernetes or a cloud platform.
* Some experience with JavaScript or React.
* Interest in finance, banking or risk management.

**You are welcome here.**

At SAS, it’s not about fitting into our culture – it’s about adding to it. We believe our people make the difference. Our inclusive workforce brings together unique talents and inspires teams to create amazing software that reflects the diversity of our users and customers.

*SAS only sends emails from verified “sas.com” email addresses and never asks for sensitive, personal information or money. If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any type of communication from, or on behalf of SAS, please contact* *Recruitingsupport@sas.com.*

jobs.description:
Title: Inspection Engineer

Hours: 37.5 hours per week (Mon to Fri)

Location: Grangemouth (100% on site

Salary: Dependent on skills, qualifications and experience

Contract type: Perm

**ABOUT US**
============

A truly global company, INEOS comprises of numerous businesses with sites in countries throughout the world. We also encompass a wide range of consumer brands and sports interests.

Grangemouth remains one of INEOS’ key sites in the UK and is home to world scale manufacturing plants – offering a unique environment in which to grow your skills, knowledge and competencies within the petrochemical sector.

We are engineering a strong future for our site, based on a highly skilled, experienced workforce and a portfolio of essential products that underpin a sustainable, low carbon future for all. We are entrepreneurial. We love to find new ways of doing things. Whether that’s through improving the energy efficiency of our plants, developing new ways of working or delivering on our net zero promises. And we’re proud to be doing this in Scotland.

We believe in offering our employees true autonomy and empowerment with a working environment that creates the opportunities for all of us to achieve our potential and to have a fulfilling professional career. We’re looking for committed and talented people to join our teams, to realise our ambitions and shape the future.

**ABOUT OUR OPPORTUNITY**
=========================

The UKAS accredited in-house inspection body requires a CAT 2 Inspection Engineer to support the existing team in carrying out in-service examinations of a wide range of pressurised and non-pressurised cross-complex process piping systems, pressure vessels, storage tanks and other critical plant equipment.

**Key accountabilities**

* Prepare and review Written Schemes of Examination for all types of process pipework, pressure vessels, storage tanks and other plant equipment.
* Carry out examinations in accordance with the Written Schemes of Examination.
* Understand the appropriate application and limitations of available NDT techniques including the review and acceptance of NDT results.
* Write clear and accurate technical reports in a timely manner that fully detail the results of all examination activities carried out.
* Assess as found deterioration and calculate degradation rates to support decisions on continued operation.
* Identify repairs and raise appropriate recommendations for remedial action.
* Participation in risk based inspection studies.

**ABOUT YOU**
=============

**Required:**
-------------

* Hold a relevant degree in mechanical or materials engineering or, as a minimum, an HNC in mechanical engineering or an equivalent qualification.
* A minimum of five years’ experience conducting in-service statutory and non-statutory examinations of process pipework, pressure vessels and storage tanks within a high hazard petrochemical manufacturing site.
* Clear working knowledge of PSSR and other relevant legislation, including COMAH, PUWER & PE(S)R.
* Extensive practical experience in the application and interpretation of relevant national and international design codes and standards, typically ASME, API, British Standards & EEMUA.
* Proactive and self-motivated, with the ability to manage time and priorities effectively, work diligently and maintain clear lines of communication with all relevant stakeholders.
* IT literate, with excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong attention to detail and the ability to produce high-quality, accurate inspection reports that clearly reflect the examinations undertaken and findings observed in a timely manner.

**Desired:**
------------

* Hold relevant inspection certifications for storage tanks, such as EEMUA 159 or API 653. Other relevant qualifications, such as ASME Plant Inspector, API 510 or API 570 also desirable.
* Proficient in the use of Credo and Maximo.

**WHAT WE OFFER**
=================

* 34 days holiday (optional salary sacrifice to purchase up to 5 extra days)
* Benefits Platform – access to discounts on high street stores etc., Discounted Private Medical Insurance, Travel Insurance etc.
* Employee Referral Bonus Opportunity
* Scottish Widows Contributory Pension including employer contributions
* Free On-site Gym
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Enhanced Maternity Leave
* Salary Sacrifice Car and Cycle to Work Scheme
* Ongoing Career Development

**HOW TO APPLY**
================

Application Process

Interested candidates should submit their CV via our **website**.

Pre-screen (If applicable)

Applicants with a successful CV may be invited to an online MS Teams or telephone call to further discuss the role, the organisation and your suitability.

Formal Interview

Successful applicants will then be invited to interview which will consist of behavioural and technical questions. For some roles the recruitment process may also include technical testing, behaviour questionnaires and/ or a delivering a presentation.

Provisional Offer

If you are selected as the preferred candidate you will receive a provisional offer which will be subject to a medical assessment and reference checks. Some roles may also require a criminality check.

If you would like to discuss any adjustments you may require throughout the recruitment and selection process please contact **opportunities.uk@ineos.com**.

As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applicants from all protected characteristics and commit to providing any reasonable adjustments required during application, assessment and on-boarding stages.

**ADDITIONAL INFORMATION**
==========================

If you were referred by a permanent member of staff that currently works at INEOS O&P UK Grangemouth please email **opportunities.uk@ineos.com** confirming the position you applied for and the name of the employee that referred you. Please note the employee referral scheme is only applicable for permanent vacancies.

Stonehouse, Gloucestershire

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a highly skilled Modeling and Simulation Engineer with strong physics-based system modelling expertise in Matlab/SimuLink/SimScape to support Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) development. This role sits within a multidisciplinary embedded software team and is responsible for developing real-time models, virtual prototypes, and simulation techniques used to design, integrate, validate, and deploy complex control systems to simulate virtual environments to our products.

  

The successful candidate will contribute to modelling power electronics, motor drives, and sensor networks, while supporting product development through simulation-driven design, validation, and hardware deployment. The role also involves advancing modelling methodologies, supporting commercialization efforts, and collaborating across engineering teams.

**Typical Responsibilities and Duties:**

  

**HIL Development & Real-Time Modeling**

* Compile and deploy models for execution on NI hardware targets ensuring robust integration and performance. Our existing toolchain enables easy compilation with single click functionality.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support seamless hardware-software interaction.
* Engage with our partners in MathWorks/National Instruments to improve our modelling capabilities
* Engage with the central team to produce highly reusable models to build our library of models within the business.

  

**Modeling, Simulation & Virtual Prototyping**

* Develop and maintain physics-based models of systems, subsystems, and components.
* Create virtual prototypes of new products and optimize designs using computational tools.
* Apply modeling and simulation technologies to product development needs.
* Integrate and evaluate system, subsystem, and component designs.
* Validate and improve product robustness and performance through simulation.
* Conduct research and recommend improvements to modeling techniques and criteria.
* Use version control tools to manage model revisions according to internal processes

  

**Product Development & Engineering Support**

* Analyze, design, develop, and maintain products and assist in commercialization.
* Scope new products, evaluate feasibility, and support engineering specification definition.
* Estimate development, validation, and documentation effort with project leadership.
* Define testing procedures for models, algorithms, workflows, and products.
* Conduct tests, document results, and provide corrective actions for defects.
* Support implementation, testing, and sustaining of products.

  

**Technical Leadership & Innovation**

* Investigate new development areas within modeling and simulation engineering.
* Maintain awareness of emerging technologies and industry practices.
* Participate in technical reviews, audits, and design evaluations.
* Contribute to modeling standards, best practices, and design reuse initiatives.
* Support innovation activities including patents, technical papers, and research collaboration.
* Mentor team members and share expertise across the organization.

  

**Documentation, Communication & Collaboration**

* Create and maintain project and technical documentation.
* Contribute technical content for product documentation and training materials.
* Provide training and support to other collaborators.
* Deliver presentations to technical and management audiences.
* Participate in internal seminars, industry forums, and conferences.

  

**Qualifications:**

* Degree in Electrical Engineering, Control Systems, or related discipline.
* Hands-on experience with NI FPGA and VeriStand FMU platforms. Familiarity with dSPACE, Speedgoat, or similar real-time environments is considered.
* Model architecting and Simulink toolchain – Systems Composer, Requirements manager, Test Manager.
* Experience with model validation and computational optimization techniques.
* Familiarity with LabVIEW is desirable.
  

*Required Technical Skills*

* Advanced proficiency in Simulink and Simscape for control system modelling.
* Experience with real-time system modelling in HIL environments.
* Strong understanding of power electronics, motor drives, and sensor modelling.
* Experience developing physics-based models and virtual prototypes.
* Experience compiling models for hardware targets and integrating with physical systems.
  

*Desirable Skills*

* Strong system-level thinking and technical curiosity.
* Proactive approach to problem-solving and innovation.
* Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
* Adaptability to evolving technologies and project requirements.
* Interest in mentoring and knowledge sharing.

  

**Career Advancement:**

SLB Eureka Technical Career (SETC) provides proven technical contributors with a career path that offers them recognition, reward, and influence that parallels an equivalent management progression. We are leaders in Technology Domain Knowledge – Our Eureka Community of practice has over 28,500 members, in 30 communities, with 123 Special Interest Groups (SIGs). **Job Description**
-------------------

**Materials Capability Acquisition Engineer**

**Solihull**

**Permanent Full-Time**

**Hybrid**

**Staff 7 - 10**

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Materials Capability Acquisition Engineer to join our Materials Engineering Team in Solihull. This is an excellent opportunity for a technically skilled engineer to take on a key role in a major development programme, helping shape production readiness in advanced metallic materials, heat treatment processes, and joining technologies. You’ll be at the forefront of innovation, turning cutting-edge materials capability into real-world manufacturing success.

  

**Why join Rolls-Royce?**

At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.

  

By joining Rolls-Royce, you'll have the opportunity to work on world-class solutions, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high-performance culture.

  

**What you will be doing:**

As Rolls-Royce accelerates towards its Net Zero ambitions, developing the next generation of low-emission combustion technologies is a critical priority. This role sits at the heart of that journey.

  

You’ll take ownership of delivering complex materials characterisation work packages through the full technology development lifecycle — leveraging/collaborating with expert contributors, coordinating technical inputs, and ensuring milestones are achieved on time and within budget. "This is a position offering opportunities for technical contribution and involvement in strategic initiatives, with scope for collaboration and moderate influence.

  

* Responsible for defined technical packages of work within Materials Capability Acquisition, providing leadership and delivery against program milestones within agreed costs, timescales and quality requirements.
* Manage the inputs from a team of metallurgical experts, to compile reports and project review packs to a high standard for review at technical committees, to the requirements of the technology development process.
* Plan, develop and run metallic materials characterisation testing programs at external test houses to de-risk and address knowledge gaps.
* Resolve problems through evaluative judgements.
* Become a point of contact within Materials Capability Acquisition and to share subject matter knowledge across the function.
* Acting as advisor / coach on matters where they are technically authoritative.
* Understand company business objectives and ensure that the work they do supports this; to act in accordance with both the company values and those associated with being a professional engineer.
* Actively promote, encourage and support the identification and implementation of continuous improvement both within and outside their immediate sphere and prompt action across the wider team.
* Maintain and develop an external network to deliver relevant technology and maintain awareness of competitive position and emerging technologies.
* Identify appropriate internal and / or external funding opportunities and exploit as appropriate.
  

**Who we are looking for:**

You will be a technically credible leader driving key development programmes and ensuring production readiness across advanced metallic materials, heat treatment processes, and joining technologies. This is a chance to influence cutting-edge engineering that will shape future aerospace capability.

  

* Bachelor's degree, Master's degree or PhD in Engineering or equivalent technical capability, based on practical knowledge and experience.
* Proven technical leadership and a team player, with ability to manage multiple projects concurrently, on time and to budget.
* Excellent communication, presentation and technical report writing skills.
* Sound understanding of metallurgy. Knowledge in the field of high temperature nickel alloys considered advantageous.
* Structured, goal-oriented, resilient work attitude and high motivation to solve challenges in a strong team.
* An ability to apply logical, analytical and innovative thinking on a range of technical problems.
* Knowledge and experience of product integrity / liability and certification frameworks.
* Membership in a relevant professional body and attained / working towards Chartered status is preferred.
  

**Regional Benefits:**

* Work in a safety-first environment were doing the right thing and keeping it simple are core principles.
* Join a culture that values making a real difference through your work.
* Develop your career as a mid-career professional blending technical expertise with strong personal qualities.
* Thrive in a role that encourages integrity, accountability, resilience, and curiosity.
* Collaborate and build relationships in a team-focused environment while also working independently.
* Take initiative, lead, and make smart decisions with confidence and support.
* Grow through continuous learning, openness to improvement, and exposure to challenging opportunities.
  

Our vision is to ensure that the excellence and ingenuity that shaped our history continues into our future. Our multi-year transformation programme aims to turn Rolls-Royce into a high-performing, competitive, resilient and growing company. Join us, and it can be your future vision too.

  

Rolls-Royce are committed to being a respectful, inclusive, and non-discriminatory workplace where individuality is valued, diverse perspectives fuel innovation, and everyone can thrive.

As part of our selection process, candidates in certain locations may be asked to complete an online assessment, which can include cognitive and behavioural aptitude testing relevant to the role. If required, full instructions for the next steps will be provided.

As an Account Executive on our UK Public Sector team, you will own the Defence territory: selling the Snowflake AI Data Cloud to the Ministry of Defence, defence primes, system integrators, and allied national security organisations. This is a mission-driven, field-based role for someone who understands how data transforms Defence outcomes and can navigate the sensitivities of secure and sovereign environments.

* Prospect, win, and onboard net-new Defence logos across the UK, breaking into MOD commands, defence primes, and strategic SIs that are not yet Snowflake customers
* Run complex, consultative sales cycles that align the Snowflake AI Data Cloud to mission priorities such as readiness, logistics, intelligence, and command and control
* Position Snowflake Cortex AI, Snowpark, and secure data sharing for sovereign, air-gapped, and high-assurance workloads
* Partner with Solution Engineers to design architectures that meet Defence security, residency, and accreditation requirements
* Navigate UK public sector procurement, including G-Cloud, Digital Outcomes, and framework and direct-award routes
* Build trusted relationships with mission owners, programme leads, and procurement, from technical practitioners to senior leadership
* Collaborate with partners, resellers, and cleared delivery teams to land and expand mission-critical data programmes
* Forecast accurately and manage pipeline through the full sales cycle, from qualification to close and expansion

**Our Ideal Account Executive Will Have:**

* 5+ years of enterprise software, SaaS, or data platform sales experience, with consistent quota overachievement
* A proven track record selling into UK Defence
* Experience with complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and long-horizon programme engagements
* Working knowledge of UK public sector procurement frameworks and the realities of secure or classified environments
* Fluency in articulating the value of data, analytics, and AI to mission outcomes
* Strong commercial discipline across territory planning, forecasting, and negotiation
* The ability to hold or obtain UK security clearance (SC or above) as required by the territory

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

* Experience selling cloud data platforms, data warehousing, or AI and machine learning solutions
* An existing network across MOD, defence primes, or allied agencies
* Familiarity with secure data sharing, data sovereignty, and high-assurance deployment patterns
* Experience working alongside system integrators and cleared delivery partners

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?
