jobs.title: Senior Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview:

**About Certara**

Certara accelerates the potential of bringing medicines to market and to patients using biosimulation software, technology, and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development. Our clients include more than 2,400 biopharmaceutical companies, academic institutions, and regulatory agencies across 70 countries.

Our goal is to enable the life sciences industry’s use of data, modeling, and analytics to make better decisions across the various phases of discovery and drug development. Our software and scientists incorporate modern advances in scientific understanding, drug development experience, data analysis, and AI resulting in significant opportunities to decrease the cost and increase the probability of success for new drug approval and commercialization.

This is a great opportunity for an ambitious test automation engineer who wants to be involved in a greenfield software project that supports faster and cheaper development of new medicines.

You’ll own the test automation strategy and architecture for our web products and drive the wider team to adopt testing best practice. It’s a hands-on role: you’ll be in the code daily, building and owning the automation frameworks yourself and using AI to amplify how much you and the team can deliver, while setting direction for testing, raising engineering quality across the team, and mentoring others.

AI-assisted engineering is core to how we work. We use tools such as Cursor and Claude every day to design, write and review code and tests, and we expect this role to push that further, pioneering how AI accelerates test automation, raises coverage and quality, and helps the team move faster. You should be fluent with AI development tools and excited to set the standard for using them well.

Our web testing spans:

* **Web UI****s**: automated with Playwright, for React frontends
* **APIs**: .NET services hosted on Azure
* **Azure cloud services and messaging**: event- and queue-driven integrations such as Azure Service Bus (queues and topics), Event Grid and Event Hubs, Queue Storage, and asynchronous/batch processing (e.g. Azure Functions, Azure Batch)

The role requires close liaison with Engineers, Scientists and other staff on an ongoing basis, so strong communication and influencing skills are essential. The candidate must be eligible to work in the UK.

**About the project**

We’re building the next generation of cloud-based workflow tools for our Simcyp products, the modelling and simulation software that pharmaceutical companies and regulators rely on to understand how drugs behave in the body long before they reach a patient. Today, modelling teams set up and run that work in many different ways, and results aren’t always easy to reproduce or share. Our goal is to change that: to make sophisticated simulation workflows straightforward to build, share and run reliably at scale, with AI woven through the experience. This is greenfield work, and it’s the future of our business: high-profile, technically ambitious, and genuinely meaningful, because the faster and more reliably our customers can run their science, the sooner they can develop and deliver new medicines.

**What** **you’ll** **achieve (first 6–12 months)**

* A clear, documented test automation strategy for the platform that the team understands and follows.

* Reliable pipelines and broad coverage across the whole test pyramid (unit, integration, API and UI), with faster feedback and clearer failure diagnostics.
* A maintainable, well-adopted automation framework (patterns, helpers, examples) that engineers use every day.
* Testing shifted earlier in the lifecycle, with quality built in rather than inspected at the end.
* Regular coaching and upskilling of software engineering teams in testing practice, growing into a trusted advisor who raises quality across the wider group, not just within QA.

Responsibilities:

* **Own the automation architecture** for web UI, API and cloud-service testing, including event-driven and queue-based Azure architecture (Service Bus, Event Grid/Hubs, queues, batch processing): frameworks, patterns, standards, and tooling choices.
* **Lead the use of AI in test automation**: use AI and agentic tooling to accelerate test design and creation, drawing on requirements and the implemented code to produce well-targeted test sets at the right levels of the pyramid, with the team reviewing, refining and owning the results. Set the standard for how we apply AI to testing well.
* **Drive best practice across the team**: set testing standards, review approaches, and coach engineers to raise the overall bar. You drive from within the codebase, building the frameworks and reference examples others follow.
* Design and maintain robust automated suites focused on reliability, maintainability and clear failure diagnostics.
* Improve CI execution, reporting and diagnostics, and broaden automated coverage across the test pyramid.
* Integrate testing into CI/CD with sensible quality gates; partner with engineers on testability by design.
* Work with engineers and stakeholders to reproduce issues, support triage, and improve quality earlier in the lifecycle.
* Contribute to the Testing Chapter: standards, learning paths, and technical direction.

Qualifications:

**Essential**

* **Strong hands-on test automation skills**: building automation frameworks / shared components (libraries, utilities, patterns, CI integration), and the drive to deepen your design skills further.
* **Strong web UI automation with Playwright**: we use Playwright with C# against modern React frontends, with JavaScript and/or TypeScript also valuable.
* **Strong API test automation (REST)**: reusable clients/helpers, schema checks, auth flows, test data setup/teardown.
* **Fluency with AI-assisted development tools** (e.g. Cursor, Claude) as part of everyday engineering, using them to accelerate test automation, and able to lead the team in applying them well.
* **An appetite for raising standards and influencing others**: keen to share good testing practice, mentor peers and grow into a team-wide leadership role, with strong communication skills.
* **Experience improving CI execution and test reliability**: better diagnostics and reporting, and broader automated coverage across the test pyramid.

**Desired**

* Experience in an Agile environment and with delivery tooling such as Azure DevOps and/or Jira.
* **Performance and load testing**: designing and running tests to validate responsiveness and scalability under load (e.g. k6, JMeter, Gatling, Azure Load Testing), and interpreting the results.
* **Security testing**: incorporating security checks into automated suites and CI (e.g. OWASP ZAP, dependency/vulnerability scanning, basic penetration-testing awareness).
* Experience in life sciences, pharma, or other regulated environments, with awareness of traceability/auditability and disciplined change control.

*Certara bases all employment-related decision on merit, taking into consideration qualifications, skills, achievement, and performance. We treat all applicants and employees without regard to personal characteristics such as race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, nationality, marital status, pregnancy, physical or mental condition, genetic information, military service, or other characteristic protected by law.*

jobs.title: Senior Optical Measurement Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Azure Fiber is looking for a Senior Optical Measurement Systems Engineer to join our Metrology team. You will apply fundamental science to develop advanced measurement capabilities for optical fibre products, with particular relevance to hollow-core fibre and, where applicable, fibre-cable characterisation.

In this role, you will own significant measurement-system challenges from first principles through deployment. You will use fundamental physics and measurement science to explain the underlying optical behaviour, define what must be measured and establish methods that are both scientifically rigorous and practically useful. You will connect theoretical modelling with bench-top characterisation, then translate successful methods into robust, automated and fully productionised test systems. You will create clarity in technically ambiguous areas, make data-driven engineering decisions, and influence partners across research, product engineering, manufacturing and quality.  
  
This is a hands-on laboratory role requiring regular on-site work in our state-of-the-art Romsey facilities. You will build, align, automate, troubleshoot and validate optical systems while helping others adopt rigorous measurement practices.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Lead the architecture, development and validation of optical measurement systems for fibre and related products, with emphasis on hollow-core fibre and occasionally cable-level measurements.
* Apply fundamental science—including optics, materials science and measurement physics—to identify observable signatures, derive measurement principles and develop new characterisation methods for complex fibre systems.
* Translate physical models and measurement theory into test requirements, measurement methods, uncertainty budgets, calibration strategies, traceability plans and acceptance criteria.
* Bridge early theoretical and bench-top characterisation work to repeatable production test solutions, including optical and electronic hardware, instrument control, automation software, data pipelines, fixtures, safety controls and maintainability.
* Design experiments and interpret observations relevant to fibre characterisation, including attenuation, mode coupling and modal content, polarisation effects, interference and other light–matter interactions.
* Establish and maintain measurement-system-analysis practices, including gauge repeatability and reproducibility studies, correlation studies, reference artefacts, calibration controls, statistical process control and capability assessment.
* Apply control-systems fundamentals to sensing, actuation, feedback, stabilisation and automation, improving the performance and robustness of laboratory and production equipment.
* Drive technical investigations and root-cause analysis across relevant areas; communicate decisions and risks clearly, influence cross-functional partners, mentor engineers and improve shared engineering standards.

  
**Qualifications**

Required Qualifications:

* Degree in Optical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field AND technical engineering experience OR equivalent experience.
* Understanding of optical-fibre characterisation, light-scattering and related optical phenomena, together with control-systems fundamentals and the ability to lead complex technical work across teams.
* Demonstrated ability to develop hands-on optical measurement or characterisation systems, including laboratory instrumentation, experiment design, automation and data analysis.

Other Requirements:

* Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role.
* These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
  + Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience in characterising optical fibres (hollow-core fibres would be a plus), fibre components or optical cable, using techniques such as cutback, OTDR or backscatter, modal, polarisation, interferometric or imaging measurements.
* Experience in converting research or prototype test methods into production equipment with appropriate throughput, reliability, serviceability, safety, data integrity and operational controls.
* Programming and test-automation experience using tools such as Python, C# or equivalent, including instrument communications, data pipelines, analysis and visualisation.
* Evidence of technical leadership at senior individual-contributor level: creating clarity in ambiguous problems, setting technical direction, influencing stakeholders, reviewing designs and mentoring other engineers.

You will develop and maintain technical test suites, use appropriate tooling and engineering approaches to design and execute tests, and support the team in identifying and reducing delivery risk.

You will take direction from the Test Lead and wider delivery leadership, but you will be expected to work independently on assigned test activities, challenge constructively where appropriate, and bring practical suggestions to improve test coverage, automation quality, continuous feedback and release confidence.

jobs.title: Senior Ruby on Rails Developer
jobs.description:
**Type**
--------

Full-time

**Location**
------------

Wrocław/remote

**Salary**
----------

15 000 - 20 000 PLN/MONTH [B2B NET]

12 500 - 16 700 GROSS [EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT]

**Employment Type**
-------------------

B2B / EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT

**About Momentum:**
-------------------

At Momentum, we accelerate digital innovation in **healthcare**. Our mission is to empower HealthTech startups and scaleups by transforming ideas into cutting-edge digital products. We combine deep industry expertise, strategic consulting, and full-stack development to create solutions that drive growth, compliance, and patient impact.

We work **AI-first**. AI is part of our everyday work, in development and in delivery. We keep testing new tools, agents and workflows, and when we find a better way to build, we change how we work.

But in healthcare, AI output is a starting point, not a final answer. **Verification and ownership stay with us.** We believe in technology that makes healthcare more accessible, efficient, and human-centered.

**Role overview:**
------------------

We are looking for a Senior Ruby on Rails Developer to help build robust, scalable web applications for clients around the world, mainly in HealthTech but not only.

You'll write and review code, contribute to architecture decisions, optimize performance and care about code quality, working closely with PMs, designers and other developers. You'll use AI every day to move faster, and you'll be the one who makes sure the code is actually correct, secure and maintainable before it gets merged. "AI generated it" isn't done. In healthcare, a subtle bug or a missed edge case costs more than time.

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* 5+ years of commercial experience with Ruby and Ruby on Rails,
* Strong knowledge of relational database design (e.g. PostgreSQL),
* Ability to implement various ways of communication with the client (e.g. REST API, WebSockets),
* Ability to implement various ways of authentication (e.g. JWT, cookie-based auth, OAuth),
* Experience with CI/CD, deployment tools, Docker and Git,
* Practical knowledge of design patterns and SOLID principles,
* Practical experience in writing and maintaining automated tests using RSpec or similar frameworks,
* Practical knowledge of non-relational databases, caching and message brokers,
* Experience in diagnosing and solving performance and optimization problems,
* Ability to contribute to project architecture based on business, functional and non-functional requirements, with an understanding of scalability concepts,
* Love for code review, both giving and receiving it,
* Willingness to help other developers and share knowledge,
* Using AI tools in your daily work and the ability to critically review AI-generated code before it reaches the codebase,
* Fluent written and spoken English, and confidence in talking directly with clients, e.g. during calls, demos or technical discussions
* Fluent written and spoken Polish, as it's our main language of internal communication,
* Interest in HealthTech and readiness to work on projects where quality, security and compliance really matter.

**Nice to have:**
-----------------

* Knowledge of JavaScript framework like Vue or React
* Experience with AWS or similar platform
* Experience with Web Server (e.g. Nginx)
* Degree in Computer Science or relevant field
* Healthtech or pharmacy experience: HIPAA, e-prescribing, insurance, FHIR.
* You've worked embedded with a client, in consulting, as an FDE or in a startup where you wore several hats.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Designing and building web applications using Ruby on Rails,
* Designing and implementing relational databases,
* Collaborating with cross-functional teams to define, design and ship new features,
* Writing automated tests for your code, including edge cases, usability and general reliability,
* Fixing bugs and improving performance,
* Reviewing code, including AI-generated code, with the same standards as any other,
* Helping define and improve internal standards for maintainability and style,
* Using AI tools (e.g. Claude) to speed up development work,
* Communicating directly with clients when needed: clarifying requirements, discussing technical solutions and presenting your work,
* Continuously discovering, testing and implementing new technologies and workflows, and sharing what works with the team.

**This role probably isn't for you if:**
----------------------------------------

* you prefer to treat a ticket as finished once the code runs, rather than when it's tested, reviewed and something you'd be comfortable maintaining a year from now,
* you prefer a stack and workflow that stay the same for years. We regularly test new tools and approaches, and when we find a better way to build, we adopt it,
* you'd rather someone else took responsibility for what gets merged. Here, AI can write a first draft, but you're the one who signs it off.

**What We Value:**
------------------

* Clarity in focus and dedication to building digital products that elevate healthcare and improve quality of life.
* Flair to face challenges with boldness, creativity, and a proactive mindset.
* Grit to take ownership, stay ambitious, and deliver refined, high-quality solutions.
* Impact through meaningful innovation that makes pioneering medical discoveries accessible and human-centered.
* Ability to collaborate efficiently in teams of technical and non-technical individuals, and comfortable working in a dynamic environment with evolving objectives and iteration with users.

**What we offer:**
------------------

* Modern Workspace: We provide a modern and comfortable office environment, right in the heart of Wrocław.
* Work-Life Harmony: Enjoy **flexible working hours**, allowing you to find the perfect balance between work and life.
* Stay Active: Our company **Multisport** benefit encourages you to stay fit and take care of your well-being.
* Your Health Matters: Access to **private healthcare** ensures you're taken care of when you need it most.
* Remote Support: For our remote team members, we **reimburse office visits**, both required and optional.
* Freedom of choice: We understand that we all have different lifestyles and needs, that's why the **Worksmile Cafeteria System** gives you access to hundreds of non-wage benefits to choose from.
* Security and peace of mind: We provide the option to join our comprehensive **insurance** plan, for your and your loved one's security.
* Team Building & Development Fun(d): We believe in the power of fun and development, and **microfunds** are here to bring some excitement into your work-life or you can access them to develop your skills and gain knowledge.
* AI-powered work: Access to AI tools like Claude and Gemini, plus real influence on how we use AI in development and space to test new tools and workflows.

**Thinking of applying? Awesome! Here’s what happens next:**
------------------------------------------------------------

As a standard, we keep our recruitment processes short and to the point.

* Initial phone interview (20 min): We'll have a quick chat to get to know each other and discuss your experience. It's a great opportunity for us both to see if there's a good fit.
* Recruitment task: Following the interview, we will send you a short task to complete. You will have three working days to complete and return it.
* Technical interview (45-60 min): If your task is successful, you'll be invited to a technical interview. You will meet with a senior team member to dive deeper into your technical knowledge and discuss your solution.
* Meeting with the CTO (15 min): If you successfully pass the previous stages, we will invite you to meet with our CTO. This is a unique chance to hear firsthand about the company's vision, mission, and long-term goals, and to ask questions about the direction we are heading
* ‍Decision and feedback: After all the stages are complete, we'll get back to you with our final decision and detailed feedback on your application.

If you have any questions, get in touch with us!

jobs.title: Application Security Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Title**

Application Security Engineer

**Summary**

TRD Professional Services is looking for an Application Security Engineer (development-focused white hat) to identify and reduce risk across our applications and support the secure development of new customer projects. The role works closely with development and QA teams to embed security into the full software lifecycle, covering threat modelling, secure coding, vulnerability management and PCI compliance.

This position sits at the intersection of security, development and QA, making sure security is built in from the start rather than added later.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Review new application designs with architecture and development teams to identify security risks early and flag potential blockers before implementation begins
* Lead threat modelling sessions with dev, QA and business teams to identify risks early in solution design
* Review code and binary scan results, working with developers to fix vulnerabilities during development
* Assess and manage existing vulnerabilities using CVSS, define remediation actions and track progress
* Support PCI-DSS compliance by collecting audit evidence with dev, QA and platform teams
Work with QA to ensure adequate security test coverage across functional and non-functional testing  

  

**About the Ideal Candidate:**

  

* Relevant experience in software development (.NET), application security, or infrastructure security (AWS/Azure);
* Strong knowledge of secure development practices, threat modeling, and vulnerability management;
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills;
Experience with Amadeus LSS and Amadeus Robotics is a plus.  

  

**Our offer**
-------------

  

**A critical mission and purpose** – At Amadeus, you'll power the future of travel with a critical mission and extraordinary purpose.
  
**A truly global DNA** – Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.
  
**Great opportunities to learn** – Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, from on-the-job training to formal activities, and daily interactions.
  
**A caring environment** – Amadeus fosters a caring environment that supports both professional growth and personal well-being.
  
**A flexible working model** – Embrace our flexible working model, enabling you to excel wherever and however you work best.
  
**A diverse and inclusive community** – We are committed to enabling each employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment.
  
**A reliable company** – Trust and reliability are fundamental to shaping our relationships with customers, partners, and employees.

  

**Application Process**
-----------------------

  

The application process is easy and fast. Create your candidate profile manually or upload your CV/Resumé. Are you the one we’re looking for? Apply now!

  

#LI-EMEA

**Diversity & Inclusion**

  

Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience.

  

Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

**Be aware of recruitment scams**

  

Amadeus Group never charges fees, requests payment, or asks for financial information during recruitment. All legitimate opportunities are communicated solely through official Amadeus channels, including our careers website. Any payment request or outreach via unofficial platforms (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram) should be treated as fraudulent.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer – Agentic Systems
jobs.description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**

R&D Team Manager

\_\_

Help shape the next generation of digital services at ABB Electrification Service Division. We are look-ing for a Senior AI Engineer – Agentic Systems to unlock agentic AI capabilities across our digital port-folio and turn them into real customer value. In this role, you will help build intelligent systems that support customers in achieving their most important asset management goals: higher reliability, bet-ter predictability, greater availability, improved sustainability, and smarter lifecycle decisions. You will work at the intersection of AI, backend engineering, and enterprise integration to transform architec-tural designs into secure, scalable, production-ready solutions.

ABB’s digital and service portfolio is increasingly focused on customer experience, comprehensive as-set management, digital enablement, and sustainability outcomes. This role is a key enabler for trans-lating that portfolio direction into intelligent products and workflows that help customers reduce downtime, improve maintenance decisions, optimize operations, and extend asset life.

As a Senior AI Engineer – Agentic Systems, you will build, integrate, and operate production-grade AI agents and agentic workflows across ABB ELSE digital services. You will own the engineering required to move beyond pilots into secure, reliable, enterprise-ready solutions. This includes agent orchestra-tion, enterprise tool integration, evaluation, monitoring, control mechanisms, and operational excel-lence. The role also has an important team uplift dimension: you will mentor colleagues and help raise the internal bar in agentic AI engineering.  
  
The work model for the role is: hybrid #LI-hybrid

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Develop AI agents and multi-step workflows that support ELSE digital service and asset management use cases.
* Turn solution designs into scalable, production-ready implementations across the ELSE landscape.
* Connect agent workflows with enterprise platforms, operational data, APIs, and digital tools used in ELSE services.
* Define effective patterns for tool use, context management, memory, orchestration, and workflow execution.
* Create evaluation and validation approaches to ensure agent quality, safety, accuracy, and performance in real use cases.
* Implement human approval flows, fallback mechanisms, and operational guardrails.
* Ensure production readiness through testing, monitoring, deployment automation, and controlled releases.
* Work closely with architects, product owners, data engineers, and software teams to deliver reliable, business-ready ELSE solutions.

**Qualifications for the role :**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
* 7+ years of experience in software engineering, including designing and delivering enterprise-grade backend and cloud-based solutions.
* 2-3+ years of hands-on experience building AI-powered applications, LLM-integrated systems, or agent-based workflows in production environments.
* Strong backend engineering skills, ideally in C#/.NET, with Python as a strong plus.
* Strong experience with APIs, Git, CI/CD, cloud deployment, and secure enterprise integration.
* Experience with agent evaluation, testing, verification, RAG, memory patterns, context man-agement, and agent control mechanisms.
* Experience monitoring and optimizing AI systems for reliability, performance, and cost.
* Understanding Microsoft enterprise security, compliance, and identity patterns, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams and mentor colleagues.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

jobs.title: Software Engineer 2 - .NET - Allegro Klik/Care
jobs.description:
Location:
Warszawa, PL, 00-841

Company: Allegro Pay sp. z o.o.

Team: Technology

Contract Type: Employee

Allegro Pay is Central Europe's largest and fastest growing fintech - the only place where financial solutions can be created on such a large scale, using state-of-the-art technology. We work on purchase financing and payment methods that are used daily by customers of Allegro, the most popular shopping platform in Poland and one of the largest e-commerce companies in Europe. Due to this scale, we have the opportunity to work on one of the most exciting purchase financing and payment solutions in our country. We are looking for talented people who want to create powerful and stable solutions to support a product with over a dozen million active users.

  

#### **The role**

  

We're looking for a Software Engineer with solid, proven experience in .NET and backend development to join a cross-functional team focused mainly on greenfield projects — building new products and features from the ground up. You'll take ownership of designing and delivering seamless, end-to-end customer journeys — from opening a bank account and activating a fast payment method directly within the Allegro app, through funding the account, to authorizing payments and rewarding customers with cashback, all in just a few taps. Alongside building new features, you'll drive improvements in system performance, scalability, and reliability, and help raise the quality and maintainability of our codebase. You'll work closely with product, design, and business stakeholders, translating ideas into robust technical solutions, and collaborate with and support less experienced teammates as the team grows.

  

Our team builds and scales two products:

  

* **Allegro Klik** - lets Allegro users link an existing bank account or open a new one directly within the Allegro app for instant payments with cashback. We own the full flow: account linking and opening, payment processing, top-ups, cashback calculation and cashback-driven promotional campaigns.
* **Allegro Care** - insurance offered directly in the Allegro shopping experience, letting customers protect their purchases (e.g. against damage, theft, or with extended warranty) right at checkout, with policy management handled seamlessly within the platform.

Both products are growing fast, with new initiatives launched continuously alongside scaling of our existing systems.

  

### **Important things for you:**

  

* Flexible working hours in the hybrid model (4/1) - working hours start between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. We also have 30 days of occasional remote work.
* The salary range for this position depending on the skill set is as follows (contract of employment, tax-deductible cost):

  + PLN gross 14 600 - 20 825
  + Annual bonus based on your annual performance and company results.
* Our team is based in Warsaw and Poznań.

### **Here's why you should join us:**

  

* **AI-Adoption strategy:** we invest a lot of effort to upskill our specialists and equip them with the newest AI coding technologies like Copilot or OpenCode.
* **Big Scale:** immerse yourself in the exciting world of Allegro Pay, where your .NET skills will tackle challenges on a large scale. You'll be contributing to financial solutions that affect over 2.5 million people (handling 60+ million requests daily and managing dozens of terabytes of data).
* **Engineering Maturity:** Join a culture that mirrors the top tech giants. Our commitment to engineering excellence and maturity puts us on par with industry leaders like FAANG companies. (11 of 12 in Pragmatic Engineer Score)
* **Best-in-Class Expertise:** Work alongside the best experts in the field, collaborating to push the boundaries of what's possible in FinTech. Our team includes MVPs and many conference speakers.
* **Impactful Products:** Imagine this – your work at Allegro Pay contributes to creating products that you, your family, and friends might already use daily. See the direct impact of your efforts on the FinTech landscape (with 120+ deployments per month).

### **We are looking for people who:**

  

* Have solid, hands-on experience with **.NET** and backend development, and are ready to apply it on production-grade systems
* Have practical experience with **distributed systems and microservices**; exposure to partner APIs is a plus
* Are comfortable working with cloud infrastructure(preferably **Azure**)
* **Want to be proud of the code they create;** value high-quality code reviews and engage in substantive discussions on software engineering best practices
* Are eager to understand the broader business context and communicate effectively with internal clients
* Demonstrate a high sense of responsibility and resilience, as you will be working with critical financial data
* **Are enthusiastic about AI** and are open to actively incorporating AI coding assistants (such as GitHub Copilot) into their daily work to maximize efficiency and focus on complex problem-solving
* **Can independently design and deliver effective solutions** to the requirements set by business stakeholders, taking full ownership of the features they build from start to finish
* Are committed to continuous learning, open to constructive feedback, and embrace a growth mindset through active participation in code reviews, backlog grooming, team discussions and retrospectives
* Collaborate effectively within a team, share knowledge, and are willing to support less experienced teammates as the team grows
* Speak fluent Polish (essential for daily communication with internal and partner stakeholders) and communicative English (at least B2 level)

### **What's in it for you:**

  

* Well-located offices (with e.g. fully equipped kitchens, bicycle parking, terraces full of greenery) and excellent work tools (e.g., raised desks, ergonomic chairs, interactive conference rooms).
* A 16" or 14" MacBook Pro or corresponding Dell with Windows (if you don't like Macs) and all the necessary accessories.
* A wide selection of fringe benefits in a cafeteria plan - you choose what you like (e.g., medical, sports or lunch packages, insurance, purchase vouchers).
* English classes that we pay for related to the specific nature of your job.
* A training budget, inter-team tourism (see more here), hackathons, and an internal learning platform where you will find multiple trainings.
* An additional day off for volunteering, which you can use alone, with a team, or with a larger group of people connected by a common goal.
* Social events for Allegro people - Spin Kilometers, Family Day, Fat Thursday, Advent of Code, and many other occasions we enjoy.

And that's just the beginning! You can read more about the benefits here.

  

### **#goodtobehere means that:**

  

* You will join a team you can count on - we work with top-class specialists who have knowledge- and experience-sharing in their DNA.
* You will love our level of autonomy in team organization, the space for continuous development, and the opportunity to try new things. You get to choose which technology solves the problem and you are responsible for what you create.
* You will value our Developer Experience and the full platform of tools and technologies that make creating software easier. We rely on an internal ecosystem based on self-service and widely used tools such as Kubernetes, Docker, Consul, GitHub, and GitHub Actions. Thanks to this, you can contribute to Allegro from your very first days on the job.
* You will be equipped with modern AI tools to automate repetitive tasks, allowing you to focus on developing new services and refining existing ones (also leveraging AI support).
* You will create solutions that will be used (and loved!) by your friends, family and millions of our customers.
* You will meet the Allegro Scale, which starts with over 1000 microservices, an open-source data bus (Hermes) with 300k+ rps, a Service Mesh with 1M+ rps, tens of petabytes of data, and production-used machine learning.
* You will become part of Allegro Tech - We speak at industry conferences, cooperate with tech communities, run our own blog (it's been over 10 years!), record podcasts, lead guilds, and we organize our own internal conference - the Allegro Tech Meeting. We create solutions we love (and can) to talk about!

Send us your CV and... see you at Allegro!

**Don’t wait until you join us! Let's meet online!**
----------------------------------------------------

Get to know our team, take a peek at our office life and check out what else we do at Allegro.

jobs.title: Experienced Software Engineer – Java/.NET Platform
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced software engineer to join the team responsible for developing the software platforms underlying COMSOL Multiphysics®. You will work with the runtimes, libraries, build systems, and platform integrations that form the foundation of a large, cross-platform engineering software product. The majority of the development is done in Java and C#, together with build and automation tooling.

**About COMSOL**
----------------

COMSOL develops cutting-edge mathematical modeling software that powers innovations in physics and engineering. Our flagship product, COMSOL Multiphysics®, is widely used across all fields of engineering, manufacturing, and scientific research to model multiphysics systems. Our customers leverage our software to understand, predict, and optimize product designs and processes. Founded in Sweden in 1986, COMSOL has expanded globally with 16 offices employing more than 500 people worldwide.

**Role**
--------

Based in our newly renovated office in central Stockholm, you will join the core group developing the user interface, communication, and data layer functionality of the COMSOL product suite. The group is also responsible for the Application Builder, Model Manager, COMSOL Server, and COMSOL Compiler functionality, which customers use to create, manage, deploy, and run simulation models and apps.

In this role, you will work on several of the software platforms on which our products are built. This includes the Java and .NET runtimes and their ecosystems, third-party libraries, database connectivity and persistence technologies, application launchers, build systems, and integration of vendored software. The work spans multiple operating systems and a large codebase with a long development history.

You will evaluate and integrate new runtime and library versions, investigate compatibility issues, implement or backport APIs and other changes where needed, and develop automation that makes recurring platform and dependency work more efficient and reliable.

The role also provides opportunities to evolve the platforms themselves. Depending on your experience and interests, this can include introducing new platform capabilities and APIs, improving how runtimes and third-party components are integrated, evolving build and development infrastructure, and finding better ways to support development across the product organization. You will have room to identify improvements and contribute to the longer-term technical direction of the areas you work with.

Responsibilities include writing and reviewing code, investigating platform and compatibility issues, contributing to technical specifications and design, developing build and platform infrastructure, and testing changes across the supported product platforms.

**Qualifications**
------------------

For this position, we are looking for an experienced software engineer with the following qualifications:

* M.Sc. or equivalent degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or physics.
* Excellent programming skills with proficiency in at least one object-oriented programming language.
* Several years of professional software development experience.
* An interest in working with complex software systems and improving the technical foundations on which other development depends.

Experience with the following will be highly valued:

* Large software projects and mature codebases.
* Java and/or .NET runtime environments and their library ecosystems.
* Build systems, dependency management, and software packaging.
* Cross-platform development on Windows, Linux, and macOS.
* Integrating or adapting third-party and open-source software.
* Build and development automation.
* Designing or evolving software platforms, frameworks, or developer infrastructure.

No background in physics or simulation is required. At COMSOL, you will be part of a company where software developers, mathematicians, physicists, and engineers work together to develop software for science and engineering.

**Working at COMSOL**
---------------------

At COMSOL, platform engineering is closely connected to product development. You will work on technical foundations used throughout the COMSOL product suite, with opportunities both to ensure that those foundations remain robust and current and to improve how they support future product development. Decisions about runtimes, libraries, build systems, and operating-system support have a direct impact on a complex engineering product with a long lifetime.

New team members quickly become essential contributors to ongoing development projects. As the company continues to expand, there are plenty of opportunities for employees to advance in their roles and become leading experts in their areas of focus. This journey will be accompanied by experienced colleagues and a collaborative working environment.

We also offer:

* A competitive salary
* Individual pension plans
* Sponsored gym membership
* Work-life balance with regular working hours

To ensure a smooth onboarding process, onsite presence is required. Once onboarded, hybrid work options are available.

**To Apply**
------------

Does this sound interesting? Submit your application in English or Swedish Make sure to include:

* Cover letter
* CV
* University diploma with grades

Please include your university diploma with grades, regardless of when the degree was obtained. Kindly note that applications submitted through other channels will not be considered.

To recruiters, please note that the target channels for this position have already been selected.

For more information, contact Mikael Sterner at tel. 08-412 95 00.

We review applications continuously.



**Reference**

REF-10051

  

**Job title**

Experienced Software Engineer – Java/.NET Platform

  

**Location**

Stockholm, Sweden

jobs.title: Application Development Engineer Mechanical segments, MCE Division
jobs.description:
This is an opportunity to join our Metal Consumables and Elements (MCE) Division and play and important role in developing our Mechanical segment. You will help us build and share knowledge about how our metal powders are used in customer applications and how their physical and functional properties contribute to the performance of our customers’ processes and end products.

MCE serves three main application segments: Mechanical, Metallurgical and Chemical. Within the Mechanical segment, we serve a range of application areas where the mechanical properties of our metal powders are utilized to provide specific functionality and performance in our customers’ processes and end products. Examples include friction, abrasives and diamond cutting, filtration, magnetic applications and polymer extrusion. We have high growth ambitions within mechanical. This means growing together with existing customers, identifying new customers and applications, and developing the next generation of products to meet future market needs. To succeed, we need to work closely with our customers, understand their applications and translate their requirements into relevant product and development activities. This is where you come in.

**Your role**

As Application Development Engineer for the Mechanical segment, you will play a key role in shaping the direction and priorities of our application and product development activities.

Working closely with customers, you will develop a deep understanding of their applications, processes and current and future requirements. You will translate these insights into development needs and opportunities, while also considering industry trends, emerging technologies and competitor developments.

You will act as a technical bridge between our customers and Höganäs, bringing customer and application insights into the organization while representing Höganäs’ technical expertise externally. You will support the introduction of new products, help customers optimize the use of existing products and work with colleagues across MCE to identify new applications and future growth opportunities.

**About the position**

Your key responsibilities in this role will include to:

* Develop deep understanding of the way our products are being/can be used, and their impact on the end customers processes and their end products.
* Translate user requirements into features and product solutions. Give input to Portfolio management and Product development on future requirements within the field of responsibility.
* Develop understanding of product that compliment Höganäs products in the customer recipes.
* Attending seminars, exhibitions, and conferences to stay updated. Be genuinely curios about everything happening within this field.
* Create manuals, conduct training sessions to targeted customers and other stakeholders, and maintain technical documentation both for internal and external usage.
* Provide ongoing technical support, resolve issues within the field of expertise.

The key to success in this role is effective collaboration across functions internally and with customer and other partners, to gather relevant insights and inspire to relevant activities. MCE have few dedicated resources, so collaborating with existing organization, mainly within MCE but also sometimes with other divisions, is the only way to success.

In this role you will report to VP Operations & Technology, and you will work close to all functions within MCE division. You should be willing to travel for work in order to meet customers globally as well as colleagues at other locations.

**Your profile**

We are looking for an individual with minimum five years of similar kind of work experience in an industrial goods company. You have an engineering/science educational background with a high level of general understanding of material. If you would have previous experience from the friction industry it would be a strong merit.

You have experience working in assignments which involved collaborating with teams from diverse geographies and functions. You have an analytical bent of mind and love data driven problem solving. It would be great if you have a working knowledge of project management concepts. There should also be experience with customer engagement.

**Does this sound interesting? Get in touch or apply directly!**

Macavoy is handling this recruitment process. Please apply with an updated CV at www.macavoy.se. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. If you have any questions, you are very welcome to contact recruitment consultant Markus Holmgren at +46 735 195 481.

**Who is Macavoy?**

Macavoy AB is a small recruitment agency with extensive expertise. Macavoy specializes in recruiting managers, project managers, and specialists with technical backgrounds. Read more about Macavoy at www.macavoy.se and feel free to follow us on LinkedIn to stay updated on what’s happening; http://linkedin.com/company/macavoy-ab/

**Working at Höganäs**

We aim to offer a great and meaningful place to work where you can fulfil your potential and ambitions. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity. We have a clear management philosophy, and just like us you believe that through collaboration and openness we develop as individuals and as a company. We see all employees, regardless of position, as leaders when we approach the challenges that the world - and we - face. Höganäs ambition is to lead the transformation to better meet the needs of tomorrow and become the preferred partner of sustainable metal powder on a global scale – join us in our journey of sustainable change and towards net-zero climate emissions.

**About the MCE division:**

The Metal Consumables & Elements (MCE) division at Höganäs is a dynamic and growing part of Höganäs and our third-largest division by sales. Committed to quality, reliability, and cost-effective solutions, it partners with customers to optimize their processes using high-quality metal powders and specialized materials. Focused on customized application-specific solutions, the division offers comprehensive technical support and deep industry expertise. The division fosters a collaborative and supportive environment, driving growth for Höganäs and its customers by exploring new opportunities in areas like welding and chemicals.

**More about Höganäs**

Founded in 1797, Höganäs is the world leader in the market for powders, with an annual production capacity of 500,000 tons. Höganäs’ vision is to drive positive change through material innovation, with the ambition of becoming the globally preferred partner for sustainable powder materials. At Höganäs, the company’s strength lies in its diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, and it is committed to gender diversity. Höganäs collaborates with customers to develop solutions for automotive components, electric motors, brazing, surface coating, welding consumables and additive manufacturing. Operating 15 production centers worldwide and employing 2,200 people, Höganäs’ turnover for 2025 was 11,045 MSEK. Höganäs is owned by Lindéngruppen and FAM. www.hoganas.com

jobs.title: Mjukvaruutvecklare Desktop och diagnostikverktyg (C# / .NET)
jobs.description:
Företagsbeskrivning På Bosch Thermoteknik AB i Tranås formar vi framtiden för hållbart boende. Som en nyckelaktör inom divisionen Bosch Home Comfort utvecklar och tillverkar vi värme- och kyllösningar i världsklass. Vi tillhör affärsenheten Electric Solutions (ES), som leder den globala energiomställningen genom utveckling av modern och innovativ värmepumpsteknik. För att våra högeffektiva system ska fungera optimalt förlitar sig vårt nätverk med över 1 000 servicetekniker runtom i Europa – liksom våra utvecklingslaboratorier – på pålitliga och moderna desktopapplikationer och mjukvaruverktyg.
  
  
Vi söker nu en engagerad Mjukvaruutvecklare till vårt team i Tranås. I den här rollen tar du ägarskap över centrala applikationer som vårt fältverktyg SWDL (Software Download) samt utvecklar skräddarsydda verktyg för loggning, datainsamling och diagnostik som underlättar vardagen för våra testingenjörer i labbet vid verifiering av värmepumpar. Om rollen Utveckling av desktopapplikationer: Designa, bygga och underhålla moderna Windowsapplikationer med C# och .NET-ekosystemet (.NET Framework / moderna .NET). Stötta labbingenjörer: Utveckla intuitiva verktyg för dataloggning, monitorering och diagnostik som används av testingenjörer för att fånga och analysera systembeteenden i realtid vid labbtester.
  
  
**Flashing och mjukvaruuppdateringar:** Förvalta och förbättra stabila rutiner för mjukvarunedladdning och flashning av firmware, både för labbmiljöer och för serviceverksamhet i fält. Kommunikation med hårdvara och enheter: Implementera och stödja robusta kommunikationsgränssnitt mellan desktopmjukvaran och inbyggda styrsystem eller testutrustning (till exempel seriell kommunikation och CAN-bus). Tvärfunktionellt samarbete: Arbeta nära utvecklare inom inbyggda system (firmware), hårdvaruspecialister och testingenjörer för att stämma av krav och verifiera nya versioner av verktygen. Användbarhet och ständiga förbättringar: Förbättra UI/UX, automatisera datavisualisering och effektivisera arbetsflöden så att komplexa diagnostik- och testprocesser blir enkla och driftsäkra.
  
  
**Kravspecifikation Utbildning:** Högskole- eller civilingenjörsexamen inom datateknik, elektroteknik, mjukvaruteknik eller motsvarande praktisk erfarenhet. God kompetens inom C#: Gedigen erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling för desktop med C# och .NET. Förståelse för hårdvarukommunikation och diagnostik: Erfarenhet av mjukvara som kommunicerar med hårdvara, enhetskommunikation (t.ex. CAN-bus) samt diagnostik- eller flashrutiner (som UDS och bootloaders).
  
  
**Kunskaper i Python (meriterande):** Erfarenhet av Python är ett stort plus för skriptning, testautomatisering, dataanalys och snabb framtagning av prototyper. Förståelse för inbyggda system (meriterande): Kunskaper i C eller C++ är meriterande och underlättar dialogen och samarbetet med utvecklarna som programmerar mikrokontrollerna. Erfarenhet av labbmiljö och mätverktyg: Praktisk bakgrund inom testverktyg, dataloggers, telemetri eller testautomatisering är starkt meriterande. Analytisk problemlösare: Ett strukturerat och metodiskt arbetssätt vid felsökning av mjukvarans interaktion med hårdvara och analys av kommunikationsloggar.
  
  
**Språkkunskaper:** Mycket goda kunskaper i engelska i tal och skrift är ett krav. Kunskaper i svenska är starkt meriterande för det dagliga samarbetet på plats i Tranås. Ytterligare information Vad vi erbjuder dig Betydelsefull påverkan: Direkt ägarskap över verktyg som är affärskritiska både för den dagliga forskningen och utvecklingen i våra labb och för servicetekniker runtom i Europa. Flexibilitet: Moderna möjligheter till hybridarbete och flexibla arbetstider som främjar en sund balans mellan arbete och fritid.
  
  
**Hållbar teknik:** Möjligheten att vara en del av en organisation dedikerad till grön spetsteknik (elektrifiering, naturliga köldmedier såsom propan, och intelligent klimatstyrning). Utveckling och kultur: Breda utvecklingsmöjligheter för både personlig och professionell tillväxt inom den globala Bosch-koncernen.

jobs.description:
Om Conapto Conapto är en svensk datacenter-operatör med fyra datacenter och huvudkontor i Stockholm. Vi erbjuder säker och hållbar colocation för företag med höga krav på prestanda och tillgänglighet, och skapar lösningar som möter behoven hos allt från avancerade IT-miljöer till high performance computing och den snabbt växande utvecklingen inom artificiell intelligens (AI). Conapto verkar i en snabbväxande bransch och befinner sig i en expansiv fas med fortsatt utveckling av vår kapacitet i Stockholmsregionen. Som operatörsneutral aktör erbjuder vi våra kunder flexibla och framtidssäkra lösningar för deras digitala infrastruktur.
  
  
Hållbarhet är en integrerad del av vår verksamhet. Våra datacenter drivs med 100 % förnybar el och överskottsvärme återvinns till lokala fjärrvärmenät i samarbete med Stockholm Exergi och Sollentuna Energi & Miljö. Vi bidrar även till stabiliteten i det svenska elnätet genom balanstjänster. Kundupplevelsen står i centrum och Conapto har idag ett Net Promoter Score (NPS) på +85, vilket speglar det starka förtroende som kunderna har för Conapto.
  
  
Sedan 2021 ägs Conapto av den europeiska infrastrukturfonden Marguerite. Conapto bildades 2018 genom förvärvet av Sungard Availability Services svenska verksamhet, med en historia inom datacenterbranschen som sträcker sig tillbaka till 1982. Vi söker nu en Data Center Engineer inom Operations Vill du arbeta med kritisk infrastruktur i en modern och växande verksamhet? Conapto söker nu en Data Center Engineer inom Operations till vårt norra datacenter campus i Sollentuna.
  
  
Här får du en central roll i den dagliga driften och utvecklingen av vår datacenterverksamhet, med stort eget ansvar och möjlighet att påverka. Om rollen Som Data Center Engineer blir du en viktig del av Operations teamet och ansvarar för att säkerställa en stabil, säker och högkvalitativ drift av vår kritiska infrastruktur. Rollen är praktisk och teknisk, med en kombination av kundkontakt, installationer, felsökning och löpande underhåll. jobs.description:
*If you’re looking to make the best co-op games in the world, you’ve come to the right place. We're proud to have some of the best game makers and collaborators in the industry working with us. What's more, we're a fun bunch of game developers, who love to indulge in our passion for video games together. Our games are not for everyone. Are they for you?*

**We are now looking for a Backend Developer**
----------------------------------------------

As a Backend Developer, you will play a key role in the design, development, and optimization of our backend systems. You will work closely with a collaborative team of developers and engineers, focusing on technologies such as C#, Microsoft Orleans, ASP.NET Core, Azure, and SQL Server. If you are passionate about building scalable and efficient backend solutions, we want to hear from you.

**Who you are:**

* Proven experience in backend development using C# and ASP.NET Core.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Orleans or other actor model frameworks for distributed and scalable systems.
* Strong expertise in designing and optimizing database structures, preferably with SQL Server.
* Experience with cloud technologies, particularly Azure.
* Understanding of different backend architectural styles and best practices.
* Not required but beneficial if you have experience with Kubernetes and frontend development

**What you'll do:**

* Application Development: Design and develop backend solutions using C#, ASP.NET Core, and Microsoft Orleans, ensuring high performance, scalability, and maintainability.
* Cloud Integration: Utilize Azure services to build and optimize cloud-based backend components, ensuring seamless integration with our applications.
* Database Management: Design and implement efficient database structures using SQL Server, optimizing data storage, and retrieval for optimal system performance.
* Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams to understand requirements, provide technical insights, and ensure the successful delivery of projects.
* Third-party platforms: Build, monitor and maintain integrations with third party platforms.

**Our tech stack**

* NET/C#, Docker, Kubernetes/AKS, Azure, SQL Server, CosmosDB, Redis, Grafana, Angular, TypeScript

##### **How to apply**

If you think that this position matches your background and skills, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV in English as soon as possible. We ask that your application always include relevant work samples or a link to your portfolio.

We interview candidates continuously and hire when we find a good fit.

##### **Practical Information**

**Scope:** Full-time: 40 hours per week with initial 6 month probation period.  
**Location:** Office first, hybrid solution possible. You need to be eligible to work in Sweden.

**We are a pet friendly office! You can expect to find dogs and occasionally some cats around.**

##### **What we offer**

Arrowhead Game Studios is a growing team of about 100+ people, best known for our co-op titles. Despite our size, we remain a friendly and down to earth bunch, who love to indulge in our passion for video games together.

Located in a newly built, custom-tailored offices on the Hammarby Kaj waterfront, we enjoy everything Stockholm has to offer. A thriving game dev scene, along with all types of activities are immediately available on our doorstep.

Our talented developers are crucial to our success, therefore we put a lot of emphasis in creating and maintaining a prosperous culture. We’re committed to open and transparent communication. Your ideas are welcomed, valued, appreciated - the ceiling for creative discussions is high.

We also have numerous work benefits for all our employees. You can read about them here!

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Engineer (R-20005)
jobs.description:
The Quality Assurance Engineer II creates and maintains tests to ensure software meets user and product needs. The role develops project test plans, defines and tracks quality assurance metrics, analyses software-quality data, documents defects, and supports issue resolution and continuous process improvement. The role also adopts AI tools and integrates automated testing within CI/CD pipelines to improve test design, automation, defect analysis, requirements review, release quality and overall QA productivity.

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Work closely with development and product teams to ensure product quality in a fast-paced Agile environment.

* Create and maintain test strategies, test plans, test cases, test data and traceability for new features and defect fixes.

* Write and maintain automated tests for web applications, REST APIs and data-validation workflows.

* Integrate and maintain automated test suites within CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing, quality gates and release validation throughout the software delivery lifecycle.

* Execute manual functional, regression, integration and exploratory testing where automation is not yet appropriate.

* Validate multi-tiered, data-driven applications processing large volumes of records.

* Define and track quality metrics including defect counts, severity, test execution, coverage and release status.

* Identify, document, report, track and verify issues through resolution.

* Perform root-cause analysis and collaborate on preventive quality improvements.

* Support product deployments, release validation and QA sign-off.

* Partner with support teams to reproduce and troubleshoot customer-reported issues.

* Proactively improve quality through collaboration, automation, process improvement and innovative thinking.

### **Key Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

* Typically 5-8 years of relevant experience, including 5+ years in software quality assurance or quality engineering.

* Experience in manual testing across web, API, database and enterprise applications.

* Experience in test automation using Playwright, Selenium, Robot Framework or similar tools.

* Experience integrating automated test frameworks into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI/CD or similar platforms.

* Understanding of continuous integration, continuous delivery, quality gates, automated test reporting and release validation processes.

* Proficiency in Java, Python or C# for test automation and scripting.

* Strong knowledge of API testing using Postman, REST Assured or equivalent tools.

* Experience in SQL and database validation, including complex queries and joins.

* Experience designing and executing functional, integration, system, regression and UAT testing.

* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

* Strong defect management, root-cause analysis and troubleshooting skills.

* Experience with JIRA, Zephyr, Azure DevOps or similar test management tools.

* AI tools adoption: Demonstrated experience using Copilot, Cursor, Gemini, ChatGPT or Claude for test case generation, test automation, defect analysis, requirements review, CI/CD pipeline optimisation and QA productivity improvements.

* Excellent analytical, written and verbal communication, cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.title: Commercial Solar PV Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description:

**Join Us**

Bord Gáis Energy has been powering the nation’s homes and businesses for 50 years. Today we are evolving from a utility supplier to a total energy solutions provider – combining trusted gas and electricity expertise with a growing portfolio of net zero products and services. We are at the forefront of Ireland’s energy transition strengthening energy security and helping customers moves to a low carbon future. Ardrar Ltd, recently acquired by Bord Gáis Energy (part of Centrica plc), is scaling rapidly as a leading provider of solar solutions across Ireland.

This is a unique opportunity to join a high-growth business, leveraging the strength of an established and trusted brand, Bord Gáis Energy, in the Irish market, backed by an international energy group (Centrica Plc).

**Your Team (Ardrar Ltd – A Bord Gáis Energy Company)**

Ardrar Ltd, part of the Bord Gáis Energy family, is one of Ireland’s fastest-growing providers of smart, sustainable energy solutions. We combine the agility of a rapidly scaling, technology-led business with the strength and reach of an established brand and energy leader in the Irish market

**Employment Terms**

This role is employed by Ardrar Ltd, which operates under separate terms and conditions to Bord Gáis Energy. Together we’re helping homes, farms and businesses cut costs, reduce emissions, and transition to cleaner energy.

**The Role**

We are seeking a **Commercial Solar PV Design Engineer** to support the next phase of transformation as we accelerate our transition to a more sustainable energy future. This role is central to our technical delivery, responsible for designing optimised, compliant, and cost-effective solar PV systems for commercial, industrial, and agricultural customers across Ireland.

You will work closely with our sales, project management, and installation teams to translate customer requirements and site conditions into engineered solutions that maximise energy yield, meet grid connection requirements, and align with project budgets and timelines.

**Core Responsibilities**

*System Design & Engineering*

* Design and develop detailed solar PV proposals for rooftop and ground-mounted commercial solar PV systems (typically 50 kWp to 5 MWp).
* Conduct virtual and physical site assessments to evaluate solar resources, perform shading analysis, and determine optimal system configuration.
* Create detailed technical reports including module layouts, string configurations, and array designs that maximise energy production while respecting structural, electrical, and fire safety constraints.

This role will act as the lead engineering authority for the onshore underground section of the export cable system connecting major ESB and JV offshore wind farms in Ireland and the UK to the onshore grid. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Do you want to build and modernize a market-leading SaaS platform that transforms complex transportation data into business value?**

At IMI, we develop a market-leading SaaS platform that helps organizations control transportation costs, automate financial processes, and transform complex operational data into valuable business insights. Processing large volumes of business-critical data, our platform supports customers in improving efficiency, control, and decision-making.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our team. You will work across the entire software development lifecycle and play a key role in the continued evolution of a business-critical SaaS platform.

Combining hands-on development with technical ownership, you will influence architecture, development practices, and technical decisions while helping deliver scalable, high-quality solutions.

#### **About the Role**

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will become an important part of a cross-functional team responsible for developing, maintaining, and modernizing business-critical software solutions. You will work across frontend, backend, databases, integrations, and cloud services while taking responsibility for delivering stable, scalable, and high-quality solutions.

The role involves close collaboration with product stakeholders, developers, customers, and domain experts. Beyond implementation, you will contribute to technical design, support the modernization of existing services, and take ownership of solutions throughout their entire lifecycle, from initial requirements to stable production use.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and enhance software solutions across frontend, backend, and databases
* Translate product requirements into stable, scalable, and user-friendly solutions
* Develop APIs and integrations with external systems
* Contribute to the modernization of existing services and the reduction of technical debt
* Work with data models, SQL, reporting, and analytical datasets
* Ensure quality through testing, code reviews, troubleshooting, and production follow-up
* Contribute to technical decisions, architecture, and development standards while taking ownership of deliveries from design through production

#### **Your Profile**

We believe you are an experienced software engineer with strong technical expertise and a product-oriented mindset. You enjoy solving complex challenges, modernizing existing solutions, and building scalable systems that create lasting business value.

You thrive in an environment that combines ownership, autonomy, and collaboration. Taking responsibility for technical decisions and architecture, you balance technical quality with business needs while contributing to continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.

**We Believe You Have:**

* A degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience
* Solid and documented experience developing and maintaining production-critical software solutions
* Experience developing transaction-intensive systems that process large volumes of business-critical data
* Experience with C#, .NET, SQL, relational databases, and modern frontend development using JavaScript or TypeScript
* Experience working with APIs, integrations, and cloud platforms such as Azure
* Experience with automated testing, code reviews, troubleshooting, CI/CD, and modern software delivery practices
* Experience taking responsibility for complete deliveries from requirements and technical design through deployment and production follow-up
* Strong communication skills in both Norwegian and English

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience modernizing legacy or business-critical systems
* Experience with Azure services, message-based or asynchronous architectures, and scalable cloud solutions
* Experience with reporting, analytics, simulation, or data-intensive B2B products
* Experience integrating with ERP systems or other external platforms
* Experience with technical leadership, mentoring, or professional coaching
* Experience with customer dialogue, requirements gathering, or logistics-related solutions

The position is primarily based in Fredrikstad. We work mainly from the office, with flexibility to work remotely when needed.

#### **Why IMI?**

IMI Supply Chain Solutions is a leading software provider specializing in sustainable logistics and order management. Our solutions are at the core of critical industries such as grocery retail and pharmaceutical supply chains. We are in an exciting phase of growth, offering you the opportunity to influence both our products and the way we work with product development going forward.

We are proud to be Great Place to Work certified and offer a workplace with a strong sense of team spirit, a high degree of autonomy, and excellent opportunities for professional development. In addition, we offer a competitive benefits package including extra vacation days and an attractive pension plan.

Vis flere detaljer

TV productions around the world run on software built in Bergen.

Live every day, from BBC News to Premier League.

Viz Trio is the graphics application used by newsrooms and sports broadcasters to create and put content on air, and we are growing the team that builds it.

We're looking for a senior engineer who is energized by hard systems problems and cares about building the right thing, not just shipping the next thing.

**The challenge**

Viz Trio is a large Delphi and C# application that has run live broadcasts around the world for more than two decades, and we are modernizing it while it stays on air.

That means:

* Re-engineering parts of a mature system built on technologies from different generations
* Improving Delphi/C# interop and carefully migrating selected Delphi code to C#
* Integrating new web-based UI components

This is the kind of problem most engineers never get to touch: deep, real, consequential, and visible on screen.

We want someone who finds that exciting rather than daunting.

**Who you are**

We care most about how you approach problems, but we also want a solid background.

We'd expect:

* You embrace AI-assisted development where it helps you move faster without compromising engineering quality
* A strong background and experience with a high-level object-oriented language like C#
* Experience with Delphi or interest in learning and working with the language
* Experience troubleshooting, maintaining, and safely evolving large long-lived desktop applications with complex legacy codebases
* Genuine care for architecture and system design, and the judgment to know when to modernize and when to leave well enough alone
* You raise the level of the people around you through mentoring, reviews, and sharing your technical experience
* Experience collaborating across teams and contributing to technical decision-making
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent skills and experience

**What you'll do**

* Work hands-on with Viz Trio's Delphi and C# codebase
* Apply AI-assisted tools where they improve speed without compromising quality
* Help determine what gets rewritten, what gets wrapped, and what's left unchanged
* Collaborate with the wider Trio team and stakeholders across Vizrt
* See your work on air, in real broadcasts, in real time

**Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

* Private health insurance, a competitive pension scheme
* Paid Time Off: Generous vacation days, sick leave, and public holidays to support a healthy work-life balance
* Professional Development: Opportunities for ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities
* Innovation Days (three per month) dedicated to experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement
* Modern office located in Media City Bergen
* Small, autonomous teams with shared ownership and fast, flat decisions

Join our team and take advantage of these benefits while working in a dynamic and supportive environment.

**Om bedriften**
----------------

Since 1997, Vizrt has empowered the world’s leading broadcasters and content creators - Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, CNN, BBC, Fox, CBS, Al Jazeera, and 100+ others - with cutting-edge visual storytelling technology.

We’re a global team of 600+ innovators across 17 countries, pushing the boundaries of graphics control, real-time graphics, cloud production, and broadcast automation.

Our office is located in Media City Bergen, Norway.

You will work alongside international colleagues in an environment where team spirit and work-life balance are taken seriously.

We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

We help enhance the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of our customers in the global shipping industry, covering all vessel types and mobile offshore units. As a partner to industry, we offer services in testing, certification, training, and technical advisory through the energy value chain. That means we’re continually investing heavily into R&D for new services and solutions while proactively assessing what the industry needs today and tomorrow.

### **About the role**

**Are you ready to kick-start your career as a Summer Student in Maritime Technical Support next summer?**

With 15,000 employees operating in over 100 countries, DNV is a leading expert in risk management and assurance. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

**DNV Maritime’s AI Centre of Excellence - Smart Use of Data** enable AI in DNV Maritime’s tools and global work processes, strengthening DNV’s leading position in digital innovation.

We are 40+ developers and data scientists developing AI solutions in a professional setup. We are delivering innovation with AI to DNV’s business processes in close collaboration with domain experts and project teams.

You will be part of the AI Platform Engineering team, consisting of 10-15 professional programmers delivering scalable cloud hosting services and data platform to our AI solutions.

**Typical tasks as a summer student in DNV Maritime would be:**

DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion.
