jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
**Etsimme kokeneita Data Engineerejä rakentamaan Netumin tulevaisuutta.**

Haemme muutoksentekijöitä uuteen, tekoälypohjaisiin dataratkaisuihin ja moderniin tietovarastointiin keskittyvään yksikköömme.

Pääset haastamaan nykyiset toimintatavat ja luomaan uutta yhdessä huippuasiantuntijoidemme kanssa. Jos haluat jättää kädenjälkesi siihen, miten modernia dataliiketoimintaa rakennetaan, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö.

Netum on IT-palvelutalo, jolla on yli 20 vuoden kokemus vaativista IT-hankkeista. Autamme asiakkaitamme digitaalisen liiketoiminnan kehityksessä, toteuttamalla juuri heidän tarpeisiinsa sopivia ja kestäviä digiratkaisuja – viisaasti ja vastuullisesti.

**Minkälaisesta tehtävästä on kyse?**

Työssäsi Senior Data Engineerinä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisin teknologiakattauksin erityisesti Microsoftin kuin muidenkin teknologioiden parissa. Sinulla on jo useamman vuoden kokemus data-alustojen, tietovarastojen ja analytiikkaratkaisujen suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta. Hallitset SQL:n, tietomallinnuksen sekä Azure-pohjaiset datapalvelut, ja pystyt viemään ratkaisuja itsenäisesti suunnittelusta tuotantoon. Toimit asiakkaan luotettuna asiantuntijana, osallistut teknisten ratkaisujen määrittelyyn ja autat myös muita kehittymään osaamisessaan. Samalla haluat jatkuvasti syventää osaamistasi ja hyödyntää uusimpia datateknologioita asiakasratkaisuissa.

**Tulet työskentelemään esimerkiksi näiden osa-alueiden parissa:**

* Microsoft Fabric -pohjaisten data- ja analytiikkaratkaisujen toteuttaminen ja vieminen tuotantoon, mukaan lukien Data Factory-, Lakehouse-, Warehouse- ja Power BI -komponenttien käyttäminen
* ELT/ETL-dataputkien kehittäminen (esim. Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Azure Synapse)
* Tietoallasratkaisut esim. Lakehouse tai OneLake
* Raportointiratkaisujen rakentaminen (Power BI tmv.)
* Tietovarastokehityksen automaatio- ja kiihtymistyökalut esim. WhereScape, ADE tai D#
* Data Vault 2.0 / 2.1-tietomallinnus
* Datan käsittelykielet (esim. Python, R, Spark tai C#)

**Lisäksi katsomme eduksesi kokemuksen esimerkiksi:**

* Microsoft Purviewista
* Tekoälyä hyödyntävistä data- ja analytiikkaratkaisuista

Tärkeintä meille on tehtävässä viihtyminen sekä mielenkiintoisten urakokonaisuuksien luominen, joten tehtävää on mahdollista muovata oman kiinnostuksesi mukaisesti. Halutessasi tehtävään voi liittyä esimerkiksi projektinhallinnan tehtäviä tai mentorina toimimista nuoremmille tieteenharjoittajille.

Työotteeltasi olet ratkaisukeskeinen, näet haasteissa mahdollisuuksia ja haluat soveltaa osaamistasi aktiivisesti ratkaisujen löytämiseksi. Työtehtävässä onnistuminen edellyttää hyviä yhteistyötaitoja sekä sujuvaa suomen kielen osaamista.

**Mitä tarjoamme?**

Datayksikössämme pääset vahvistamaan osaamistasi ja rakentamaan ammatillista tulevaisuuttasi osana Netumin menestystarinaa. Projekteissamme pääset mukaan ainutlaatuisiin ja yhteiskunnallisesti merkittäviin projekteihin. Työskentelemme niin julkisen kuin yksityisen sektorin datan parissa. Työtehtävä tarjoaa sopivasti haasteita ja mielenkiintoisia kehittymismahdollisuuksia.

Meillä tekemisen keskiössä on mahdollisimman mielekäs arki ja mahdollisuus vaikuttaa oman uransa suuntaan. Osaamisen kehittäminen on meille tärkeää ja tarjoammekin sinulle mahdollisuuden esimerkiksi erilaisten sertifikaattien suorittamiseen. Lisäksi työajastasi 6% on varattu oman osaamisen kehittämiselle.

Työpaikan sijainnin suhteen olemme joustavia. Voit työskennellä jollain toimipisteellämme Tampereella, Helsingissä, Turussa, Hämeenlinnassa, Jyväskylässä tai Oulussa, mutta työt onnistuvat myös kotikonttorilta käsin.

Työskentelysi tueksi saat modernit työvälineet ja lisäksi käytössäsi on kattavat työsuhde-edut kuten lounasetu, virkistysetu, työmatkaetu, vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutus sekä työkykyvakuutus. Järjestämme säännöllisin väliajoin myös mukavaa virkistystoimintaa ja kokoonnuumme koko porukan voimin myös muutaman kerran vuodessa.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Mahtavaa! Jos mielenkiintosi heräsi, niin lähetäthän vapaamuotoisen hakemuksesi ja CV:si palkkatoiveineen oheisen linkin kautta mahdollisimman pian.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä ja rekrytointiprosessista voit kysyä rekrytoijaltamme Julialta, julia.rasanen@netum.fi / +358 45 783 621 11.

Valitulle hakijalle tehdään tarvittavat turvallisuusselvitykset.

jobs.title: Join BELLA Intelligence as a Software Developer
jobs.description:
BELLA Intelligence is a niche software platform for insolvency case management, and part of Karnov Group. You don’t need to be a legal expert—or an Ace Attorney—to make an impact here. If you’re a Software Developer seeking a place with talented colleagues, meaningful technical challenges, and a supportive culture, this opportunity is for you. Keep reading to learn more about the role and why BELLA could be your next great move.

The Role

We’re looking for a developer with a user-centric mindset and a drive to evolve the product in step with the market, execute our roadmap, and meet client expectations. You’ll work with modern technologies and have a significant opportunity to grow, diversify your skill set, and contribute to an exciting growth journey.

You’ll work across the full stack and the end-to-end development lifecycle—UX/UI, coding, testing, debugging, and more. You’ll also contribute to broader business topics at BELLA, including the product roadmap, IT infrastructure, and domain-specific decisions. Collaboration is central: you’ll partner with the BELLA team to share progress and tackle challenges, and work with developers to refine requirements, design solutions, and deliver new features.

The Stack

* .NET

* Front-end: React with TypeScript

* Database: Microsoft SQL

Must Have

* Minimum 3 years of experience working with .NET. (Preference for .NET Framework however .NET Core will also work)

* Strong English skills in reading, writing and speaking

* Strong communication skills

* Business understanding, enabling you to consult and contribute to BELLA’s product roadmap, IT infrastructure, and other domain-specific topics.

* A curiosity and eagerness to stay up to date with the latest software developments, trends, and technologies

* Strong collaborative skills

Nice to Have

* Entity Framework

* HTML

* CSS

* RxJS

* Redux

* Azure

About BELLA Intelligence

BELLA Intelligence, part of Karnov Group, is a cloud-based SaaS platform that streamlines daily workflows for managing insolvency cases. Our service includes secure hosting of case-related data.

We’re a small, flat, and highly transparent team with a strong professional culture. BELLA Intelligence is the market leader in its niche in Denmark, and we’re on a growth journey—focused on delivering business-critical functionality, reducing time to value, and accelerating our expansion into Sweden.

About Karnov

Karnov Group is a leading provider of critical legal, tax, and compliance information across Denmark, Sweden, Norway, France, Spain, and Portugal. We’re in the midst of an exciting transformation — evolving from a traditional publisher into a modern technology company.

Throughout the entire Karnov Group we work on a foundation of trust and transparency, and psychological safety is a key value in our culture. You’ll work alongside talented colleagues who support each other and share a drive to build the best tools possible for our customers. We’re located right by Nørreport Station in central Copenhagen. We offer great flexibility and expect you to take ownership and responsibility together with your team. We have a common-sense driven hybrid remote policy.

Apply

Interested? Reach out to Kenan Jugo, Commercial Director, Portfolio Companies, at kenan.jugo@karnovgroup.com . We’re reviewing applications on a rolling basis and will hire as soon as we find the right candidate. We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.title: Software developer praktikant
jobs.description:
**Dit praktikophold**
---------------------

Som praktikant hos IT Minds kommer du ikke til at sidde i et hjørne og lave bugfixing eller drift af legacy systemer. Tværtimod kommer du til at arbejde med nye projekter og de nyeste teknologier på markedet.

Som udgangspunkt vil du blive en del af et projekt, hvor du hjælper med at udvikle en skræddersyet, softwareteknologisk løsning til internt brug eller til en af vores kunder. Uanset hvad sørger vi for, at du hele tiden er i tæt dialog og sparring med vores dygtige senior og lead udviklere. Om du ender på et kundeprojekt eller en intern løsning afhænger af de potentielle muligheder, som vi har i forretningen på det givne tidspunkt, men du kommer i hvert fald ikke til at blive alene!

... Men én ting er sikkert: Du kommer til at udvikle dine tekniske skills og dygtiggøre dig med hjælp fra nogle af Danmarks skarpeste Software Developers.

I mere grove træk vil du i et praktikforløb hos IT Minds få:

* 20 ugers lønnet praktik normeret til 37 timer/uge (Er lønnet eller 20 uger ikke muligt grundet krav på dit studie, så lad os tage en dialog om det)
* 14 dages onboardingforløb med en grundig introduktion til vores forretning og koncept, introduktion til professionel softwareudvikling, et kursus i "Mindster Consulting Class" og meget mere...
* 2 x 2 uger onboarding/læringsprojekt, så du kan stå helt skarpt inden din første opgave.
* Et stærkt fællesskab og en særdeles uformel omgangstone, hvor det er helt legalt at spille et slag bordfodbold eller prøve at slå vores sofaudviklere i Tekken, når dit hoved trænger til et break
* Gratis frokostordning, kaffe, Cola og snacks ad libitum
* Vi har en historik for at ansætte vores dygtige praktikanter, sådan så du kan tage næste skridt i dit #Mindsterlife og potentielt overgå fra praktikant til studieprogrammør aka Software Developer på deltid. Muligheden for det kan vi vende, når dit praktikophold lakker mod enden

... Og så er der jo alt det løse - men vigtige, for vi hepper også på, at du har lyst til at spise fredagsrundstykker med dine kollegaer og skåle i en fredagsøl eller sodavand. Måske melder du dig ind i brætspilsklubben eller moviebuddies?

Mulighederne er mange, og det er helt fair, hvis du mister pusten ved at deltage i det hele. Så joiner du bare det, du synes, er fedest - eller opfinder dit eget Mindster-event!

### **Din faglige og personlige profil**

* Du er sandsynligvis i gang med din bachelor på DTU eller Datamatikker fra EK eller en anden lignende uddannelse
* Du er passioneret for software og brænder for at lære mere
* Du har kendskab til .NET-platformen (C#) eller Java og/eller JavaScript, og måske har du endda lidt erfaring med frameworks som eksempelvis ASP.NET, .NET core, Angular, React eller Vue.js samt SQL og NoSQL databaser, fx MongoDB. Interesse for AI er altid et plus.
* Du er flydende på dansk og engelsk i både skrift og tale

### **IT Minds**

Samler unge IT-talenter ét sted, og vi omgås hinanden i et miljø, der bærer præg af en høj grad af fleksibilitet, tillid og en særdeles uformel omgangstone.

På IT Minds kontor i København er vi ca. 50 medarbejdere i en god blanding af erfarne kræfter krydret med studerende og nyuddannede, der befinder sig i begyndelsen af deres karriere.

Som forretning har vi fokus på høj faglighed og kvalitet kombineret med de nyeste teknologier på markedet. Vigtigst er det at levere et stærkt produkt, der skaber værdi og mening, for vores kunder står højest på dagsordenen, og derfor arbejder vi også både agilt og gennemsigtigt. Vores tilgang til arbejdet er derfor ret simpel - vores softwareløsninger optimerer forretningsprocesser og minimerer omkostningerne. Det er fremtidens softwareløsninger udviklet af nutidens unge talenter.

### **Vil du være praktikant hos os?**

Kontakt Abena Kuranchie, Team Lead, på abena.d.kuranchie@it-minds.dk

### **Opfylder du ikke alle kravene?**

Studier har vist, at kvinder og minoriteter er mindre tilbøjelige til at ansøge, hvis de ikke opfylder alle krav. Hvis du er begejstret for rollen, men ikke opfylder alt, så opfordrer vi dig alligevel til at ansøge. Der skal være plads til alle!

**Om jobbet**

Vil du være med til at sikre kvaliteten af en af Danmarks vigtigste digitale platforme til offentlig sagsbehandling? Som Senior QA Engineer bliver du en del af vores udviklingsafdeling i Ballerup, hvor du arbejder tæt sammen med udviklere, arkitekter, Product Owners og domæneeksperter. Du får en tværgående rolle med fokus på kvalitetssikringen af hele WorkZone-platformen og bliver en vigtig sparringspartner for udviklingsteams omkring kvalitet, test og automatisering.

  

**Dine opgaver**

* Planlægge, koordinere og gennemføre testaktiviteter på tværs af WorkZone-platformen
* Udarbejde, vedligeholde og eksekvere testcases og testplaner
* Sikre høj kvalitet gennem systematisk funktionel test og regressionstest
* Identificere, dokumentere og følge op på fejl og kvalitetsforbedringer
* Bidrage til testmanagement og koordinering af testindsatser
* Identificere testscenarier der egner sig til automatisering
* Samarbejde med udviklere om løbende at øge graden af testautomatisering
* Bidrage til udviklingen af QA-processer, metoder og værktøjer

  

**Hvem er du?**

* Har flere års erfaring med softwaretest og kvalitetssikring
* Har erfaring med komplekse softwareløsninger
* Har en struktureret og metodisk tilgang til kvalitetssikring
* Har en pragmatisk tilgang til problemløsning, bl.a. i forhold til at vurdere balancen mellem tid og kvalitet
* Har erfaring med testautomatisering
* Har forståelse for agile udviklingsmetoder og Scrum
* Kommunikerer klart på dansk og engelsk
* Har erfaring med Azure DevOps eller lignende værktøjer

  

Det er en fordel, hvis du erfaring med udvikling af automatiserede tests, det kan f.eks. være ved brug af Playwright, Selenium, C# eller lign., samt erfaring fra offentlig forvaltning, ESDH eller WorkZone.

  

**Som person**

* Er grundig og detaljeorienteret
* Arbejder struktureret og skaber overblik
* Er nysgerrig og opsøgende
* Tager ansvar for kvaliteten i det leverede
* Trives med samarbejde på tværs af teams

  

**Vi tilbyder**

* En central rolle med stor indflydelse på kvaliteten af WorkZone
* Mulighed for at præge og videreudvikle vores QA-praksis
* Et stærkt fagligt miljø med erfarne kolleger

jobs.title: AWS Cloud Security Engineer
jobs.description:
##### **About Peraton**

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

##### **Program Overview**

RDG (Risk Decision Group) provides nationwide background investigations compliant with national government standards to include support of continuous vetting for over 110 government agencies.

##### **About The Role**

Peraton is seeking an experienced **AWS Cloud Security Engineer** to design, build, and operate security controls for a FedRAMP Moderate-authorized AWS cloud infrastructure supporting Peraton's RDG (Risk Decision Group) program. This is a hands-on role with a key part in day-to-day cloud security operations, embedding secure-by-design principles into cloud architecture, and maintaining continuous FedRAMP compliance.

The engineer is responsible for implementing security architecture, hardening cloud environments, maintaining continuous compliance monitoring, and supporting Authorization to Operate (ATO) activities. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience securing AWS environments within a federal compliance framework (FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, NIST 800-171, RMF, or similar).

**This is a 100% remote position.**

**Responsibilities**

* Design and implement security architecture for AWS workloads aligned with FedRAMP Moderate baseline controls
* Build and maintain security guardrails using AWS-native services (IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Config, CloudTrail, KMS, WAF, Macie, Inspector)
* Implement and manage Infrastructure as Code security controls (Terraform/CloudFormation) with policy as code
* Support System Security Plans (SSPs), ATO activities, and POA&M remediation
* Perform continuous monitoring, vulnerability scanning, patch management tracking, and monthly/annual assessment support
* Configure and maintain centralized logging, SIEM integration, and audit trail retention per FedRAMP/NIST requirements
* Implement least-privilege IAM policies, service control policies (SCPs), and cross-account access controls.
* Manage encryption at rest and in transit (KMS, ACM, TLS enforcement) per FIPS 140-2/140-3 requirements where applicable
* Respond to security incidents, perform root cause analysis, and support cloud-specific incident response playbooks
* Collaborate with DevOps/Platform teams to embed security into CI/CD pipelines (DevSecOps)
* Maintain documentation for control implementation statements, architecture diagrams, and audit evidence
* Support boundary definition and system categorization activities (FIPS 199) as required

##### **Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* US citizenship required; ability to obtain and maintain a Top-Secret eligible clearance
* Minimum 8 years work experience with BS/BA in computer science, or 10 years work experience with an AA/AS degree in Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 5+ years of hands-on AWS engineering experience, with 3+ years specifically in cloud security roles
* Demonstrated experience working within a FedRAMP Moderate or FedRAMP High, DoD IL4/IL5, or equivalent federal compliance environment
* Experience supporting or maintaining an SSP and RMF processes
* Experience with AWS GovCloud (US), AWS Commercial, or equivalent federal AWS environments
* Strong hands-on expertise with AWS security services: IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, AWS Config, CloudTrail, KMS, WAF, Macie, Inspector, and Systems Manager
* Solid understanding of NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 control families (AC, AU, CM, IA, SC, SI, etc.) and the ability to map implementations to specific controls
* 3+ years of experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and/or CloudFormation), including security scanning and policy-as-code tools
* Networking security fundamentals: VPC design, security groups, NACLs, PrivateLink, Transit Gateway, and network segmentation for compliance boundaries
* Experience with vulnerability management tools (AWS Inspector or similar) and remediation tracking
* Experience implementing Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) in AWS
* Familiarity with SIEM/log aggregation tools (Splunk, AWS CloudWatch, OpenSearch, or similar) for security event monitoring
* Scripting ability in Python or Bash for automating compliance checks and remediation
* Understanding of encryption standards relevant to federal systems (FIPS 140-2/140-3, TLS 1.2+)
* One of the following certifications: AWS Certified Security – Specialty, or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional (with a security focus), or CISSP, CISM, or Security+ (with strong AWS hands-on experience).

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Direct experience supporting a Peraton program or similar federal integrator (Leidos, Booz Allen, SAIC, General Dynamics IT, etc.)
* Familiarity with server and systems hardening software
* Experience with container security (ECS/EKS), including image scanning (ECR scanning) and runtime protection
* Experience with AWS Control Tower and multi-account landing zone security governance
* Experience automating compliance evidence collection for continuous ATO (cATO)
* Prior experience with change management processes in a regulated/audited environment
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field
* Active security clearance
* Experience with AWS AI services (Amazon Bedrock)
* Experience with hybrid/multi-cloud architecture, including Azure (VNets, Azure AD/Entra ID, Azure Policy, ExpressRoute)
* Experience with Microsoft .NET
* Experience supporting ATO/continuous monitoring processes
* Familiarity with DevSecOps pipelines
* Familiarity with AI security and governance frameworks, national security/defense/critical infrastructure missions, and supporting federal agencies or large GovCon programs

#RDG

##### **Details**

**Target Salary Range:** $104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

**Benefits Statement:** Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

**Application Statements:** The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own.

**EEO:** Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer AI
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

Your role
  
Bring your specialist knowledge and experience to a company managing 50% of the world’s MIPS and play a critical role in our modernization mission. You’ll be in good company among our global community of experts leading the future of mainframe modernization. Experts who share knowledge openly and collaborate freely.
  
  
In this role, you’ll design, build and maintain the high-volume business logic that runs on the mainframe. At the same time you’ll play a key role in refactoring legacy code to enable modern cloud and mobile applications to seamlessly interact with the mainframe’s core data.
  
  
What you will do
  
Maintain Performance
  

* Prevent decay and find efficiencies: Monitor the architecture and identify opportunities to optimize code to maintain and enhance mainframe performance.

  
Debug and Test
  

* Find and fix: Debug, troubleshoot, and analyze complex system interactions to keep mission-critical applications running.

  
Develop for the Future
  

* Bridge the gap: As an instrumental player in modernization, you’ll extract business logic from legacy systems for migration or integration with cloud-based services.

**Who You Are**

Required skills and experience
  
  

* Experience working as a software engineer on complex software projects.
* Excellent coding skills and solid development experience (Java, Python, .Net etc.) with debugging and problem-solving skills.
* Software development methodologies, with demonstrated experience developing scalable and robust software.
* Experienced in relational and NoSQL databases, data mapping, XML/JSON, REST-based web services.
* Knowledge of architecture design - Microservices architecture, containers (Docker & k8s), messaging queues.
* Deep understanding of OOP and design patterns.

  
Preferred skills and experience
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Certification in one or more of the hyperscalers (Azure, AWS, and Google GCP) - otherwise, you can obtain certifications with Kyndryl.
* Experience with DevOps tools and modern engineering practices.

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Equipment Engineer 2 (Analytical QC & Formulation)
jobs.description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.

**Position Summary**

  

As a Manufacturing Equipment Engineer 2, you will provide technical leadership in sustaining smart manufacturing equipment within a high-volume consumables production environment. Your responsibilities include defining and executing preventive maintenance on optical, mechanical, electrical, and fluidics systems to enhance equipment uptime and reliability. You will also deliver training to Technicians and Engineer I team members to improve their understanding of job roles and expectations. Additionally, you will supervise and mentor these team members to ensure consistent performance and ongoing development.

  

**Position Responsibilities:**

  

* Complete required training (e.g. cGMP, safety and work instructions, etc.) within a stipulated time frame.
* Execute tasks strictly following cGMP, Quality, Safety and Work instruction requirements.
* Ensure employees follow safety, quality requirement, and all applicable company policies at all times.
* Ensure proper housekeeping and maintain cleanliness (6S) of the working area.
* Timely report/ escalate any concerns (work-related or personal).
* Meet daily production schedule and performance expectation.
* Able to take on additional tasks or responsibilities when required.
* Competent to perform preventive maintenance activities with broad supervision.
* Implement repair procedures to ensure correct operation of equipment and systems with broad supervision.
* Identify and update critical spare parts in SAP to ensure continuous operation and maintain appropriate safety stock levels.
* Improvement work:
  + Participate and lead improvement initiatives across areas under some direction.
  + Facilitate an organization's systems and processes relating to continuous improvement (e.g. 6S) and coach team members toward continuous improvement.
  + Analyse work practices beyond own scope of work for innovation and improvement opportunities with some supervision
  + Manage the work instructions of each Equipment maintenance process to ensure consistent performance of the equipment.
* Incident investigation and reporting:
  + Lead an investigation team and able to submit a formal report under broad supervision.
  + Provide guidance to team members.
  + Adapt different techniques and concepts in technical writing for effective engagement with individuals and/or teams.
* Lead and mentor a group of team members to meet production KPI and corporate goals & targets:
  + Assist and provide technical support to the shift to meet daily production target and shift KPIs with some guidance.
  + Co-ordinate & prioritize activities based on production, equipment and supply to meet the objectives.
* Learning and Development:
  + Responsible for the skill development of the shift.
  + Able to provide guidance to Technician and Engineer on PLC and automation equipment troubleshooting.
  + Develop On the job (OJT) training programmes for Technician.
* Demonstrates proficiency in performing repair and preventive maintenance on complex smart manufacturing equipment and in developing effective solutions for recurring equipment problems.
* Implement improvements to the existing equipment maintenance processes with some supervision.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and develop solutions together with automation experts to improve product quality, cycle time, and cost.
* Data Collection and Analysis:
  + Transforms simple operational data into meaningful insights that inform decisions aimed at improving equipment efficiency and operational performance.
Be a role model for Technicians and Junior Engineers.  

  

*Listed responsibilities are an essential, but not exhaustive list, of the usual duties associated with the position. Changes to individual responsibilities may occur due to business ne* eds.

  

**Position Requirements:**

  

* Bachelor’s Degree/Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical or Mechatronics or a related field.
* 2+ years of working experience for Bachelor’s degree or 8+ years of working experience for Diploma holders in manufacturing/production environment.
* Experience in GMP controlled manufacturing / production environment.
* Advanced understanding on Electrical / Electronics / Mechanical / Pneumatic.
* Ensure compliance with cGMP, Quality, work safety instructions & practices at all times.
* Good project management skills.
* Experience in troubleshooting analytical instrument(e.g. UPLC, Microplate reader, qPCR), liquid handler automation, lab equipment(e.g. plate centrifuges, thermomixer, biosafety cabinets) and HMI process control automation system.
* Experience in designing automatic control system is highly advantageous.
* Experience in troubleshooting PLC (e.g. Beckhoff or Allen Bradley PLC) is highly advantageous.
* Experience in engineering drawings.
* Complete tasks in a safe and efficient manner.
* High level of discipline and integrity.
* Able to undertake multiple tasks.
* Able to undergo job rotation/ cross training.
* Able to work in noisy environment with appropriate personal protection equipment (PPE).
* Able to work in chemical environment with appropriate personal protection equipment (PPE).
* Must be able to identify different colors for work purposes. In Illumina, we handle components/chemicals with different colors, and it is necessary to be able to differentiate and identify the correct components/chemicals (using visual) during operation.
* Possess a positive attitude and sense of urgency.
* Meticulous, keen attention to details and organized.
* (For Shift Engineer) The candidate must be able to work 12 hours (from 0800 to 2015 for the day shift and from 2000 to 0815 for the night shift) rotating shifts (Monthly rotations from day to night and vice versa) with staggered break times in accordance with the roster.
* Be agreeable to work normal shift when required.
Able to safely lift and handle weights up to 15 kg, with occasional requirements to manage heavier loads.  

  

*All listed requirements are deemed as essential functions to this position; however, business conditions may require reasonable accommodations for additional task and responsibilities.*

  
We are a company deeply rooted in belonging, promoting an inclusive environment where employees feel valued and empowered to contribute to our mission. Built on a strong foundation, Illumina has always prioritized openness, collaboration, and seeking alternative perspectives to propel innovation in genomics. We are proud to confirm a zero-net gap in pay, regardless of gender, ethnicity, or race. We also have several Employee Resource Groups (ERG) that deliver career development experiences, increase cultural awareness, and offer opportunities to engage in social responsibility. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employment opportunity regardless of sex, race, creed, color, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, military or veteran status, citizenship status, and genetic information. Illumina conducts background checks on applicants for whom a conditional offer of employment has been made. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal laws. Background check results may potentially result in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment. The background check process and any decisions made as a result shall be made in accordance with all applicable local, state, and federal laws. Illumina prohibits the use of generative artificial intelligence (AI) in the application and interview process. If you require accommodation to complete the application or interview process, please contact accommodations@illumina.com. To learn more, visit: https://www.dol.gov/ofccp/regs/compliance/posters/pdf/eeopost.pdf. The position will be posted until a final candidate is selected or the requisition has a sufficient number of qualified applicants.

jobs.title: Level 2 Production Support Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**  
Strong background in financial services to support and enhance our business-critical applications.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines deep technical skills with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, and is comfortable working in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  
Provide Level 2 support for production applications in the financial domain, including incident analysis, troubleshooting, and resolution within agreed SLAs.
  
  
Perform detailed root cause analysis and collaborate with Level 3 / development teams for complex issues and long-term fixes.
  
  
Monitor application health and performance using tools such as Splunk, AppDynamics, and other enterprise monitoring solutions, proactively identifying, and addressing issues.
  
  
Develop and maintain automation scripts (preferably in Python) to streamline support activities, monitoring, and incident resolution.
  
  
Write and optimize SQL queries to investigate data-related issues and support application troubleshooting.
  
  
Work closely with business and operations teams to understand issues, communicate status, and minimize impact on end users.
  
  
Contribute to knowledge base articles, runbooks, and standard operating procedures to improve support efficiency and consistency.
  
  
Participate in on-call rotations and support coverage for critical production systems as required.
  
  
Continuously learn and adopt new technologies, tools, and best practices to improve the stability and reliability of supported applications.
  
  
Collaborate with reporting and analytics teams where needed, leveraging tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Business Objects for issue analysis and reporting.
  
  
**Requirements:**

Implement an incremental multimodal reference resolver that fuses speech, gaze, and gesture into a continuously-updated belief distribution over candidate interpretations, meeting real-time latency requirements (less than 200ms end to end).
  
  
Design and implement a library of in-situ visual overlays that render the agent's belief in VR, and integrate them with the communication policy developed by the Co-PI's team.

Other duties as assigned.

Minimum Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or closely related disciplines from a reputable institution of higher learning; with particular focus on Human-Robot Interaction.
  
  
Minimum 1 year of relevant research experience in Human-Robot Interaction as a graduate student, research assistant or research engineer.
  
  
Proficiency in programming software/languages such as C# and Python, and the Unity environment is required.
  
  
Hands-on experience developing for VR head-mounted displays (e.g., Meta Quest, OpenXR), including eye- and hand-tracking input.
  
  
Experience integrating real-time multimodal input pipelines (speech recognition, gaze, gesture) and/or LLM/VLM APIs into interactive systems.
  
  
Proven track record and professional experience in interface prototyping, user experimental design.
  
  
Demonstrated experience and know-how on academic research, literature survey, and academic manuscript preparation.
  
  
Technical skills in designing robotic interaction techniques, driving robotic simulation studies, or robotic prototypes with novel interaction techniques for human-robot interaction.
  
  
Technical skills with respect to user research design, and statistical analysis, and qualitative data analysis.
  
  
Ability to break down complex problems and design effective solutions.
  
  
Innovating new approaches and thinking outside the box.
  
  
Applicants with research publications in the HCI or HRI area will be advantageous.
  
  
Ability to work cooperatively as part of a small, agile academic research team is essential.
  
  
Self-motivated individual who can work independently and collaboratively with team members.

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Office

**Job Description**

**The Position**
================

Thermo Fisher Scientific's Ion Chromatography and Sample Preparation (ICSP) team is seeking a **C#/C++ Engineer** to contribute to the development of next-generation ion chromatography laboratory instruments.

**This role is part of a strategic NPI (New Product Introduction) initiative focused on developing a new generation platform for chromatographic instruments.** This is not about maintaining or incrementally improving existing solutions, but a complete redesign of a system currently built on approximately 15-year-old electronics.

The goal is to create a modern, scalable platform by leveraging new technologies to significantly improve performance, functionality, and overall system architecture. The work involves developing backend components for embedded user interfaces (eUI), enabling robust communication, control, and data handling for high-precision analytical instruments.

This is a **multi-year program**, offering long-term stability and the opportunity to contribute across multiple phases of development—from early architecture through to commercialization.

**What will you do?**
=====================

You will design and develop backend software components for embedded systems, contributing to scalable, secure, and maintainable software architecture.

**Backend Development & Architecture**
--------------------------------------

* Design, develop, and maintain **backend components** for embedded UI systems using modern C# (primary) and/or C++
* Apply object-oriented design principles, design patterns, and strong data structures to build maintainable solutions
* Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decision-making

**System Integration & Collaboration**
--------------------------------------

* Collaborate with architects, firmware, DevOps, and test engineers to deliver integrated software solutions
* Translate complex technical and scientific requirements into robust implementations
* Support integration across embedded, firmware, and higher-level application layers

**Quality, Security & DevOps**
------------------------------

* Implement **automated testing strategies** and practice test-driven development
* Support CI/CD pipelines and follow modern DevOps practices for build, integration, and deployment
* Ensure **secure coding practices** aligned with regulatory and cybersecurity requirements

**Delivery & Continuous Improvement**
-------------------------------------

* Participate in agile development processes (including SAFe where applicable)
* Work independently on complex problems while supporting and mentoring less experienced engineers
* Contribute to continuous improvement of code quality, development processes, and tooling

**Innovation & Productivity**
-----------------------------

* Leverage modern tools, including **AI-assisted development**, to improve speed, quality, and knowledge sharing

**Qualifications & Skills**
===========================

  

* Strong experience in **backend software development** (C# preferred; C++/Python also relevant)
* Solid understanding of **object-oriented design, data structures, and algorithms**
* Experience developing **modular, maintainable, and scalable software systems**
* Experience with **version control systems** (e.g., Git) and modern development workflows
* Familiarity with **CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and DevOps practices**

* Understanding of **distributed systems or embedded environments** is an advantage
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to handle complex requirements
* Strong communication skills in English
* Interest in leveraging **AI-assisted development tools** to improve productivity and quality

If you’re passionate about clean, thoughtful development, enjoy evolving complex and high-traffic applications, and value an **Agile, collaborative, and international environment**, we’d love to meet you.

* Quality-driven — you write clean, testable, and maintainable code.

* Aware of performance, security, and reliability implications.

* Friendly, Agile work environment with cross-functional and international teams.
* Modern tech stack in a dynamic, continuously evolving software environment.
* Clear professional development roadmap within a growing healthcare organization.
* Access to technical & soft skills training, certifications, conferences, and IT events.

* Childbirth support, internal referral program, and annual team-building activities.
* Great office location — right next to a metro station.

jobs.description:
Who we are
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Technical Business Analyst (Technical BA) with strong expertise in .NET applications, database analysis, and business analysis practices. The ideal candidate should be capable of understanding existing applications by analyzing source code, database structures, integrations, and business processes. The individual will work closely with business stakeholders, developers, QA teams, and project managers to translate business requirements into detailed technical user stories, functional specifications, and solution documents.
  
  
This role requires a unique combination of technical depth and business analysis skills to support application enhancements, modernization initiatives, and ongoing support activities.
  
  
What youll be doing
  
  

* Gather and analyse business requirements, translating them into clear functional and technical requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria
* Analyse existing .NET applications, APIs, services, integrations and database structures to understand system functionality and dependencies
* Review C#, .NET and SQL implementations to support reverse engineering of existing application functionality and business rules
* Analyse data flows, database schemas, stored procedures, views, SQL jobs and system dependencies
* Perform impact analysis for change requests, enhancements and defect resolution
* Facilitate requirement gathering sessions and discussions between business stakeholders, Developers, Architects, QA teams and Project Managers
* Document AS-IS and TO-BE processes, workflows, system interactions, data mappings and integration requirements
* Develop functional and technical specifications that provide clear guidance to development teams
* Collaborate with technical teams to identify solution approaches, dependencies, constraints and implementation impacts

* Contribute to backlog refinement, sprint planning, requirement prioritization and delivery activities
* Support QA teams with requirement clarification, test scenario preparation, UAT and defect triage
* Create and maintain project documentation including user stories, process flows, technical specifications, data mappings and design decisions
* Ensure requirements remain clear, traceable and aligned throughout the delivery lifecycle

What youll bring along

* Minimum 5+ years of experience in a Business Analyst, Technical Business Analyst or similar role
* Strong experience analyzing Microsoft .NET Framework / .NET Core applications
* Ability to read and understand C#, ASP.NET MVC / Web API and .NET Core implementations
* Strong SQL knowledge, including queries, stored procedures, database schemas, views and database dependencies

* Well-structured and organised working methodology
* Excellent English verbal and written skills

jobs.title: Sr Software Development Engineer, Buyer Safety Experience
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

“WARNING: Choking Hazard — small parts. Not for children under 3 years.”  
  
“WARNING: This product can expose you to chemicals including antimony trioxide, which are known to cause cancer or birth defects or other reproductive harm.”  
  
Have you ever seen these warning labels on popular and seemingly innocent products, such as fidget spinners or food containers? As the Buyer Safety Experience team for Amazon Retail worldwide, we aim to raise the bar when it comes to educating and empowering consumers about product safety. Our team is responsible for the complete end-to-end safety experience for buyers — from the warnings you see on the product detail pages (and how to turn them into useful, actionable information), to making safer product recommendations targeted to each individual consumer’s needs, to informing consumers of recalled products and preventing them from being delivered to their doorstep.  
  
As the founding engineer of the Buyer Safety Experience - Romania team, you’ll be able to build the groundwork and influence its direction for the years to come. Our work cuts across various disciplines — from delivering an awesome customer and brand experience via great UI/UX, to building massively scalable distributed systems to support the most high-traffic pages on Amazon worldwide, to analytical and feedback systems which give us data-driven customer insights, to using GenAI to enable Selling Partners and brands to keep customers safe and informed. If you have a passion for both consumer and business-facing applications, and are obsessed with customer experience, we want you!  
  
Key job responsibilities  
  
As the first Software Development Engineer of the Buyer Safety Experience team in Romania, you will hire and lead a brand new team, and work closely with cross-functional stakeholders worldwide across Program and Product. Your role will be heavily customer-obsessed, building solutions to ensure Amazon is Earth's safest place to shop.  
  
A day in the life  

* Hiring: Build a new team from scratch
* Deeply understand technical decisions, influence long-term architecture
* Define the team's yearly goals and long-term technical vision and charter, along with product and business stakeholders
* Work closely with international stakeholders across our VP-level Trustworthy Shopping Experience org, in addition to TPM and PM-T

  
Key job responsibilities  
As the first Software Development Engineer of the Buyer Safety Experience team in RO, you will hire and lead a new team, and work closely with cross-functional stakeholders worldwide across Program and Product. Your role will be heavily customer-obsessed, building solutions to ensure Amazon is Earth's safest place to shop.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
* Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
* Experience in professional, non-internship software development
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
* Experience in development in the last 3 years

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

  
Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.title: (Senior) Software Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
**About us**

ebiscon is a software development and IT consulting company with offices in Cologne and Athens. We analyse our customers' business processes and develop tailor-made digital solutions for them – web and mobile applications, cloud services on Microsoft Azure, e-commerce solutions with Shopware and Salesforce solutions.

Most of our customers are mid-size companies in Germany, from industries such as e-commerce, retail, laboratory supply and e-mobility. We support them from the first idea through development to ongoing operation, and often work with them for many years. In addition, we develop our own software platform for the e-mobility market.

**Your role**

You will mainly work for one of our key customers: a leading European group in laboratory supply and wholesale.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you take ownership of your topics: from understanding the requirement to a solution that runs reliably in production. You do not wait for someone to tell you what to do next – you drive your topics forward, make decisions within your area and stand behind the result. From time to time, you will also support our own e-mobility platform.

We work AI-first. Most of our code is no longer written by hand but generated with AI coding agents such as Claude Code – based on clear specifications and verified by you before it goes live. Your value lies less in typing code than in understanding the problem, steering the AI precisely and judging whether the result is correct, secure and maintainable.

**Your responsibilities**

* Take full responsibility for your topics – from the requirement to production and beyond
* Understand the business processes behind a requirement and raise questions or concerns early
* Turn requirements into clear specifications and implement them with AI coding agents
* Review AI-generated code thoroughly – security, authorization, data exposure, error handling – and only merge what you fully understand
* Design backend services, APIs and integrations with C# / .NET, e.g. between e-commerce, ERP and logistics systems
* Estimate and commit to your tasks in grooming and deliver them reliably – and speak up early if a commitment is at risk
* Present your results in the regular reviews with the project team and the customer
* Take part in code reviews and work according to our engineering standards (clean architecture, automated testing, CI/CD, secure development)
* Keep technical documentation up to date and support releases

**Your profile**

* At least 5 years of professional experience in backend development with C# / .NET (ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core)
* Experience in building and operating production systems
* Hands-on experience with AI coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as your primary way of developing – and a clear sense of where not to trust them
* You take ownership: you have driven topics independently and are used to being accountable for the result
* Solid knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL or SQL Server) and REST APIs
* Experience with integrating third-party systems such as ERP, PIM or logistics systems
* Good understanding of automated testing, CI/CD and secure software development
* Experience with Docker and cloud platforms, ideally Microsoft Azure
* Ability to explain technical topics clearly to non-technical people
* Structured, independent way of working and clear written communication
* Fluent English; German is a plus

**Nice to have**

* Experience with B2B e-commerce, wholesale or order management processes
* Shopware experience
* Experience in an IT services or agency environment
* Salesforce integrations
* Azure certifications
* Front-end experience with a modern framework

**Working model**

* Hybrid work in Athens
* Agreed core hours for team and customer meetings
* Occasional travel to Cologne, e.g. for project kick-offs

**What we offer**

* Long-term work for a key customer, with real influence on their systems
* A high degree of responsibility and direct contact with the management
* Flexible working hours
* Monthly meal vouchers
* Annual learning budget for training, certifications and AI tools

**How to apply**

Please apply via Indeed or send your CV together with your salary expectations and notice period to career@ebiscon.de.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: Up to 60,000.00€ per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Αθήνα

You will have the opportunity to work on varied projects to write testable and maintainable code. Being a team player, you will enjoy participating in team design, scoping, and prioritisation discussions. These teams' focus is to assist the business in delivering scaling while also maintaining high quality.

The role will involve the development and maintenance of our real-time systems.

**What you will be doing**

* Develop high quality, high-performing code which meets the business need.
* Optimise our solutions to ensure we support our service levels and minimise cloud costs.
* Automate processes wherever possible.
* Challenge the status quo. Help improve our patterns, standards and procedures across the organisation.

**The Player**

jobs.title: Full-Stack Analist-Developer
jobs.description:
Beschrijving

**Functie**
-----------

De Supporting Services departementen vormen een belangrijke basis voor de verdere groei van de bank. HR, Finance, Risk, Audit, Legal, Compliance, Logistics, Tax/Fiscal en het Transformation Office hebben elk hun eigen ambities, processen en ontwikkelingsnoden.

Als Full-Stack Solution Engineer werk je in een nieuw, compact development team. Op basis van de business requirements die door de Business Analyst worden voorbereid, verfijn je de functionele analyse en ontwikkel je de oplossing. Je werkt rechtstreeks samen met business stakeholders en neemt end-to-end verantwoordelijkheid, van analyse en implementatie tot release, monitoring en support.

**Verantwoordelijkheden**
-------------------------

**Functionele analyse en solution shaping**

* Vertaal business requirements naar duidelijke functionele specificaties, user flows en implementeerbare oplossingscomponenten.
* Verduidelijk noden en edge cases samen met de Business Analyst, Subject Matter Experts en eindgebruikers.
* Draag constructief bij aan scope, haalbaarheid en oplossingskeuzes binnen de architecturale richting van het domein.

**Full-stack development en kwaliteit**

* Ontwikkel onderhoudbare, veilige en schaalbare applicaties met C#, .NET, Angular en TypeScript.
* Pas degelijke engineering practices toe op vlak van coding, review, documentatie en kwaliteitsborging.
* Gebruik GitHub en GitHub Copilot actief om samenwerking, consistentie en AI-ondersteunde development te bevorderen.

**Delivery en operationele ownership**

* Deploy applicaties via de beschikbare standaard release structuren en templates.
* Monitor, ondersteun en verbeter je applicaties na release: you build it, you run it.
* Onderzoek incidenten en feedback, en vertaal ze naar duurzame verbeteringen.

**AI-enabled oplossingen en samenwerking**

* Integreer AI capabilities in business oplossingen door gebruik te maken van het interne AI platform en de herbruikbare services ervan.
* Werk nauw samen met de Senior Full-Stack Developer & Solution Architect, de Business Analyst en de Domain Architect.
* Deel kennis en herbruikbare patterns naarmate de Supporting Services development capability groeit.

**Profiel**
-----------

We zoeken een medior of senior full-stack engineer die functionele analyse combineert met hands-on development en die zich comfortabel voelt bij het opnemen van ownership in een nieuw team.

Je hebt een stevige ervaring met C#, .NET, Angular, TypeScript en GitHub. Affiniteit met AI is essentieel, zowel voor het integreren van AI-functionaliteit als voor het gebruik van tools zoals GitHub Copilot in je dagelijkse engineeringwerk. Ervaring met API's of applicatie-integratie is een troef. Kennis van een of meerdere Supporting Services domeinen is een plus.

**Competenties**
----------------

Je bent een analytische, hands-on professional die het leuk vindt om business noden om te zetten naar betrouwbare software.

* Analyse en communicatie: je structureert complexe noden en communiceert helder met zowel business- als IT-stakeholders.
* Engineering quality: je hecht belang aan onderhoudbaarheid, beveiliging, kwaliteitsborging en operationele stabiliteit.
* Ownership: je werkt zelfstandig, maakt voortgang zichtbaar en blijft verantwoordelijk na go-live.
* Samenwerking: je werkt als één team met je collega-developer en zoekt actief feedback en domeinkennis op.
* Learning mindset: je neemt nieuwe technologie pragmatisch op en gebruikt AI om zowel oplossingen als manieren van werken te verbeteren.

**Positionering binnen de organisatie**
---------------------------------------

De Full-Stack Solution Engineer rapporteert binnen het Supporting Services domein en:

* werkt nauw samen met de Business Analyst om business requirements te verfijnen tot functionele specificaties;
* werkt samen met de Senior Full-Stack Developer & Solution Architect op vlak van solution design en implementatie;
* stemt af met de Domain Architect over architecturale principes en belangrijke technische keuzes;
* werkt rechtstreeks samen met Subject Matter Experts en stakeholders binnen Supporting Services.

jobs.title: Junior Automation Engineer aan boord
jobs.description:
Over je werkomgeving

Stap aan boord van een van onze nieuwste, ultramoderne schepen en ontdek een wereld op zich. Waar een divers team van stuurmannen, deckhands en scheepskoks tot ingenieurs en elektrotechnici elke dag samenwerkt. Ieder met zijn eigen expertise, maar met één gedeelde drijfveer: samen bouwen aan de wereld van morgen. Samen installeren jullie infrastructuur voor hernieuwbare energie, maken jullie transport over water mogelijk, beschermen jullie onze kusten en bouwen jullie de meest geavanceerde havens. En dat allemaal met de meest geavanceerde vloot en moderne apparatuur.

En binnen dat team zorg jij, samen met je collega’s van de technische crew, ervoor dat alle elektrische systemen aan boord blijven draaien zoals het hoort. Van onderhoud en troubleshooting tot software-optimalisatie: jullie zorgen ervoor dat alles blijft werken.

Wat houdt de rol in

Onze schepen worden steeds slimmer, complexer en geavanceerder. En dus hebben we elektrotechnici nodig die mee zijn met hun tijd. Net afgestudeerd in Elektromechanica of Toegepaste Informatica? Perfect. Jij brengt de nieuwste kennis mee, wij zorgen voor de ervaring, de begeleiding en hypermoderne apparatuur om mee aan de slag te gaan. Jouw rol:

* Je bent mee met de nieuwste ontwikkelingen binnen elektromechanica. Nieuwe technologie? Bring it on.
* Je krijgt energie van techniek waarbij je zowel je handen als je hersenen aan het werk zet.
* Elektrische systemen? Daar weet jij raad mee: van onderhoud en storingen opsporen tot testen, meten en herstellen.
* Je leest vlot elektrische schema’s en technische plannen en weet hoe je elektrische installaties, motoren, generatoren en schakelkasten aanpakt. Geen probleem als je dat nog niet allemaal beheerst: als starter krijg je de ruimte om volop bij te leren en ervaring op te bouwen.
* Automatisatie, PLC’s, netwerken en digitale systemen? Daar wil je meer van weten. Met HMI’s (Human-Machine Interface) krijg je een inkijk in wat er aan boord gebeurt: je navigeert door de systemen, analyseert wat er misgaat en vindt sneller de oorzaak én de oplossing.
* Je denkt graag mee over hoe systemen slimmer, efficiënter en betrouwbaarder kunnen werken.
* Veilig werken staat altijd voorop. Je hebt aandacht voor veilige werkprocedures, lockout/tagout en de juiste manier van werken aan elektrische installaties.

Klinkt als een serieuze boterham?

Dat is het ook. Maar gelukkig hoef je dat niet allemaal alleen te doen. Ons team aan boord gaat samen met jou aan de slag, geeft je kansen om te leren en te groeien en staat altijd voor je klaar wanneer je even wilt ventileren.

Kan je niet wachten om ons te ontmoeten? Maak dan alvast even kennis met onze collega’s Simon en Christof.

**Wat heb je nodig?**

* Een (professionele) bachelor of HBO Bachelor in Elektromechanica, Toegepaste Informatica of Scheepswerktuigkunde ETO
* Vlot in het Engels. Dat is nu eenmaal de voertaal aan boord.
* Een eerste werkervaring is niet nodig.
* Organisatieskills, stressbestendigheid, proactieve houding.
* Geen zeevaartschool of vaarbevoegdheid op zak? Geen probleem. Die heb je voor deze functie niet nodig.

Wat mag je verwachten

* Een boeiende en afwisselende job in een no-nonsense internationale werkomgeving.
* Werken op één van onze bagger- en offshore schepen (rotatiesysteem: 6 weken werken / 6 weken verlof).
* De winnende combinatie tot succesvolle projecten: teamspirit en autonomie.
* Blijvende kansen tot persoonlijke groei.
* Een fijne werkomgeving: van sportfaciliteiten en lekker, gezond eten tot een nette en comfortabele leefomgeving met alles wat je nodig hebt om je thuis te voelen aan boord.

Wij zoeken het schip dat bij je past. We breiden onze vloot steeds uit met high-tech schepen die van alle markten thuis zijn. Zowel op grote als kleinere schepen is er plaats op dek of in de machinekamer.

Je komt er terecht in een team van Can-Do mensen. Zij delen graag hun ervaring met jou en helpen je ‘on-the-job’ met het leren kennen van zowel schip als projecten. Daarnaast krijg je een doorgedreven en continue opleiding via onze JDN Academy.

**De wereld is wat jij ervan maakt**

Jan De Nul geeft wereldwijd vorm aan water en land. We drijven de transitie naar hernieuwbare energie met offshore energie-infrastructuur. We focussen op natuur-inclusieve baggeroplossingen om havens te bouwen en onze kustlijn te beschermen. We ontwikkelen innovatieve bouwprojecten voor slimme mobiliteit en duurzame gebouwen. En we herontwikkelen onze planeet door vervuilde sites een nieuwe bestemming te geven. Bij Jan De Nul is de wereld wat jij ervan maakt.

*Jan De Nul stimuleert diversiteit en inclusie op de werkplek. We zijn een werkgever voor gelijke kansen en tegen discriminatie.*

jobs.title: Senior .NET Software Engineer
jobs.description:
### **About Brainsquare**

Brainsquare designs, develops, integrates and manages business-critical applications. We combine technical expertise with a practical understanding of our customers’ operations, helping teams build and maintain reliable software.

### **Your mission**

As a Senior .NET Software Engineer, you will join an experienced development team working on business-critical applications in Antwerp.

You will design and develop backend components and REST APIs using C# and .NET 8. Working within the existing architecture, you will translate requirements into reliable, maintainable solutions and take ownership of your work from technical design through implementation.

This long-term assignment combines hands-on development with close collaboration. You will contribute to technical decisions, share your expertise and help the team deliver high-quality software.

### **Your main tasks**

* Take ownership of the technical design and development of backend components.
* Develop and maintain REST APIs using C# and .NET 8.
* Implement data access with Entity Framework and work with SQL databases.
* Apply SOLID principles, Clean Architecture and dependency injection to deliver maintainable code.
* Investigate technical issues and translate findings into practical solutions.
* Collaborate with the technical lead and other team members on implementation choices and integration requirements.
* Contribute to code quality through reviews, unit testing and automated testing practices.
* Communicate progress, technical decisions and delivery risks clearly.

### **What we are looking for in you**

* Strong hands-on experience in .NET development, preferably as a senior developer or technical lead.
* Proven experience building REST APIs with C# and .NET 8.
* Practical experience with Entity Framework.
* A solid understanding of SOLID principles, Clean Architecture and dependency injection.
* Solid SQL knowledge.
* The ability to take responsibility for both technical design and implementation.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Clear communication and a proactive approach to working with colleagues.
* Fluent English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.
* Availability for a long-term assignment in Antwerp.
* Availability to work on site in Antwerp three days per week, combined with two days of remote work.

Experience with Git, unit testing and automated testing practices, particularly xUnit, is preferred.

Familiarity with microservices architecture and cloud-based solutions, particularly Microsoft Azure, is a plus.

### **What we offer to employees**

As a Brainsquare employee, you will work alongside experienced technical colleagues and have opportunities to develop your expertise. We will discuss the employment arrangement, salary, benefits and mobility options based on your situation and the assignment.

### **What we offer to freelancers**

As a freelancer, you can expect a focused assignment, a clear technical briefing and direct communication throughout the selection process and collaboration. You will join an established team with a concrete need for additional development capacity.

### **Why choose Brainsquare?**

You will contribute to software that supports an industrial business environment, with room to take ownership of backend design and development. The assignment combines hands-on engineering with close collaboration in an existing technical team.

### **Interested?**

Apply with your CV and indicate your earliest availability.

Openings: 2

Employment Type: Payroll, Freelance

Experience level: Senior Professional

jobs.title: Enterprise Architect
jobs.description:
#### **Vos missions**

Great assignments await you with our key account clients in rich and varied environments

The client is looking for a **senior Enterprise Architect** to support the implementation and operationalization of a Group-wide Enterprise Architecture operating model within a complex, federated, multi-entity environment. The consultant will transform an approved target operating model into concrete governance practices, establish architecture decision processes, define standards and review mechanisms, and drive adoption across business and IT stakeholders. The role requires a highly pragmatic architect capable of creating structure, facilitating decisions, delivering quick results, and ensuring that governance translates into tangible implementation outcomes. The mission combines strategic architecture leadership, governance design, stakeholder alignment, architecture coaching, and operational execution.

Your missions:

* Own and drive the implementation of the approved Enterprise Architecture operating model.
* Establish and continuously improve the architecture governance framework across the organization.
* Operationalize the federated Target Operating Model for all architecture roles and entities.
* Provide a unified architecture vision across business and IT domains.
* Implement and facilitate Architecture Review Boards (ARB) and governance processes.
* Embed architecture practices into portfolio management, project delivery, product development, security, data, integration, and vendor selection processes.
* Define and implement architecture decision-making mechanisms and compliance processes.
* Develop reusable architecture practices, standards, principles, and reference architectures.
* Build and animate an Architecture Community and architecture working groups.
* Define KPIs and governance metrics to measure architecture adoption and effectiveness.
* Transfer knowledge and ensure long-term autonomy of internal stakeholders.
* Drive alignment between Group and local entities while maintaining delivery efficiency.
  

Your activities:

Enterprise Architecture Governance

* Translate the approved operating model into practical working methods.
* Create a prioritized implementation backlog.
* Define milestones, dependencies, risks, decision points and pilot initiatives.
* Establish architecture principles, standards, policies and reference architectures.
* Define and maintain governance workflows and decision processes.
* Ensure traceability of architectural decisions and escalation paths.

Architecture Review Board (ARB)

* Define ARB scope, participation model, quorum rules and governance processes.
* Organize and facilitate Architecture Review Board sessions.
* Prepare decision-ready architecture review packages.
* Record, track and communicate architectural decisions.
* Establish escalation mechanisms and governance controls.

Architecture Decision Management

* Implement Architecture Decision Records (ADR).
* Establish delegated decision rights and decision-routing mechanisms.
* Implement waiver and exception management processes.
* Define architecture compliance reviews and compliance levels.
* Create accelerated governance processes for urgent business needs.

Operating Model Implementation

* Clarify responsibilities, mandates and decision rights of:
  + Enterprise Architects
  + Domain Architects
  + Technical Architects
  + Solution Architects
* Define interactions, handovers and escalation paths between architecture roles.
* Support the rollout of the federated architecture model across entities.

Stakeholder Alignment

* Align business, product, delivery, engineering, infrastructure, security and data stakeholders.
* Facilitate architecture-driven decision-making.
* Build consensus around priorities, trade-offs and reusable solutions.
* Promote shared ownership across teams and entities.
* Communicate and defend the architecture vision at senior management level.

Architecture Integration into Delivery

* Integrate architecture within:
  + Portfolio management
  + Funding processes
  + Demand intake processes
  + Project delivery
  + Product delivery
  + Application lifecycle management
  + Security and risk management
  + Data and integration initiatives
  + Technology selection
  + Vendor selection

Architecture Framework & Artefacts

* Define the minimum viable architecture artefact framework.
* Establish ownership and approval processes.
* Define versioning standards.
* Implement review triggers.
* Define retirement and lifecycle management rules.
* Translate platform guardrails into actionable guidance for delivery teams.

Community & Capability Development

* Coach architectural communities and architecture stakeholders.
* Establish Architecture Communities of Practice.
* Lead focused architecture working groups.
* Deliver knowledge transfer activities.
* Enable internal teams to operate the governance model independently.

Measurement & Continuous Improvement

* Define and monitor KPIs related to:
  + Architecture adoption
  + Decision effectiveness
  + Delivery enablement
  + Reuse
  + Compliance
  + Risk reduction
  + Stakeholder value
* Drive continuous improvement of governance practices.
* Foster momentum and accountability across teams.

You have the following skills:

Enterprise Architecture

* Enterprise Architecture (10+ years)
* Enterprise Architecture Governance
* Federated Architecture Operating Models
* Architecture Review Boards (ARB)
* Architecture Governance Frameworks
* Architecture Decision Records (ADR)
* Architecture Compliance Management
* Reference Architectures
* Enterprise Standards & Policies
* Architecture Service Models

Architecture Methodologies & Frameworks

* TOGAF
* ArchiMate
* Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
* ITIL

Governance & Decision Management

* Governance Design and Implementation
* Decision Traceability
* Delegated Decision Rights
* Waiver & Exception Management
* Compliance Reviews
* Risk Management
* Escalation Management

Stakeholder & Leadership Skills

* Executive Stakeholder Management
* Facilitation & Workshop Leadership
* Change Management
* Consensus Building
* Community Leadership
* Coaching & Mentoring
* Organizational Alignment
* Communication & Influencing Skills

Delivery & Transformation

* Agile Delivery Environments
* Portfolio & Demand Management
* Product Delivery
* Project Delivery
* Technology Selection
* Vendor Management
* Organizational Transformation

Technical & Domain Knowledge

* IT Infrastructure
* Security Architecture
* Data Architecture
* Integration Architecture
* Application Lifecycle Management
* Digital Platform Governance

Languages

* Fluent English (mandatory)
* French (nice-to-have)
* Dutch (nice-to-have)
* German (nice-to-have)

Nice-to-Have

* Experience in the Energy & Utilities sector
* Hands-on experience designing and delivering IT solutions in Agile environments
* Experience in multinational and multi-entity organizations
* Experience operating in federated governance environments

#### **Votre profil**

* You have at least 10 years of professional experiences in IT
* If you are at least fluent in FR/ENG or NL/ENG it’s best
* You’re eager to learn, motivated and curious
* Let’s have a chat !

#### **Advantages**

* Hospitalization insurance (partner/children incl.)
* Group insurance
* Dental insurance (partner/children included)
* 20 days statutory paid vacations (legal vacations cumulated for 1 year of work)
* 11 days recovery time work 38/40 per year (= annual average: 1 day per 20 days worked) if the client asks you to work 8h/day
* Representation fee net per month.
* Internet fee of € 40 per month.
* Company car with national fuel card OR Public transport reimbursed OR mobility package.
* Daily fee of 5.50€ net /day provided.
* Subscription GSM unlimited calls for Belgium (ITS subscription)
* Training plan (e-learning - certification at ITS charge)

**Extra advantages:**

* Being a rather small team in BE (6 in back-office), we’re very close to each of our consultants and we differentiate ourselves trying to really take care of you and make you grow with us and within our different clients.
* Regular follow-up (every 3 to 6months depending on your needs/will)
* Regular teambuilding to meet-up and have fun (every 3 months more or less)
* Flexibility and trust
* Benefits of still being part to a bigger group (ITS Group) and having access to resources and of a larger team of Experts
* Co-optation system because sharing is caring!

#### **Processus de recrutement**

* 1st pre-screening on the phone to discuss about your search and conditions and our first potential opportunities matching.
* Job descriptions sent and Teams meeting fixed with us (HR and Sales) to dig into your experience and the role.
* Package proposal so we all agree beforehand.
* Your CV is sent to the different clients you’ve agreed to, to find the best mission for you!
