jobs.title: Design Engineer Infraworks
jobs.description:
**Design Engineer Infraworks**

Antwerpen, Gent, Hasselt of Brussel

  

Als **Design Engineer Infraworks** in onze **afdeling Infrastructures** draag je elke dag bij aan onze missie door een cruciale rol te spelen in het ontwerpen, modelleren en optimaliseren van complexe infrastructuurprojecten. Met behulp van geavanceerde softwaretools zoals Autodesk InfraWorks en Civil 3D creëer je innovatieve oplossingen voor wegen, rioleringssystemen en andere infrastructuren. Je **rapporteert aan** de **Competence Centre Manager BIM /CAD**.

  

Als Design Engineer is het mogelijk om vanuit onze kantoren in Antwerpen, Gent, Hasselt of Brussel te werken.

  

Klaar om het verschil te maken? Dan kijken we ernaar uit je te ontmoeten!

  

**Wat wij bieden**

* Tractebel is meer dan een werkplek. Dit is jouw kans om te groeien aan de zijde van **topexperts** in **impactvolle projecten** wereldwijd. Deze omgeving is gebouwd op **teamgeest** waarin je je hoogste potentieel kunt bereiken. Het management steunt actief de ontwikkeling van zijn mensen en er zijn talloze mogelijkheden tot **groei** binnen de ENGIE Groep.

* Wij bieden een **competitief salarispakket**, inclusief representatievergoedingen, dubbel betaalde vakantiedagen, maaltijdcheques, ecocheques, bonussen, hospitalisatieverzekering, pc-privéplan, ENGIE-aandelenopties en meer.

* Onze **mobiliteitsplannen** kunnen aangepast worden aan jouw behoeften: een bedrijfswagen, treinabonnement, leasefiets of combinaties hiervan ... Je kan je bedrijfswagen ook inruilen voor het flexibele en fiscaal gunstige **Belgische mobiliteitsbudget**!\*\*

* **Flexibele** hybride regelingen maken **telewerken** (2-3 dagen per week), werken op locatie of onderweg mogelijk. Via voordelige aankoopprogramma's en genereuze bijdragen aan je mobiele en internetabonnementen deelt Tractebel in de kosten van je thuiskantoor.

* Vakantie: 32 dagen. Je kunt ook 5 extra dagen kopen voor extra ontspanning.

* Om onze successen te vieren en plezier te maken komen we samen voor teamsporten, afterworks, teambuildingactiviteiten, ons jaarlijkse feest en veel meer.
  

**Je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden**

* Ontwerpen en modelleren van infrastructuurprojecten:
  + Gebruik maken van InfraWorks en Civil 3D om ontwerpconcepten voor infrastructuur te visualiseren, simuleren en optimaliseren (wegen, spoorwegen, rioleringssystemen, etc.).
  + Analyseren van topografische, geospatiale en geotechnische gegevens voor het creëren van realistische en betrouwbare modellen.
  + Uitvoeren van dimensionering en berekeningen voor wegontwerpen, waterbeheer en andere infrastructuurnetwerken.
* Samenwerking met projectteams:
  + Nauw samenwerken met interne teams en externe stakeholders om ervoor te zorgen dat ontwerpen voldoen aan specificaties en lokale normen.
  + Coördineren met de ontwerp-, engineering- en constructieteams om de technische haalbaarheid van projecten te waarborgen.
* Analyseren van projectgegevens en simulaties uitvoeren:
  + Integreren van geografische gegevens en andere informatie uit terreinmetingen in BIM-modellen voor een efficiënter ontwerp- en bouwproces.
  + Gebruik maken van simulaties om de impact van het ontwerp te evalueren op milieu, kosten en tijd.
* Ondersteuning bij documentatie en rapporten:
  + Ondersteunen bij het opstellen van projectdocumentatie, rapporten en presentaties voor klanten en belanghebbenden.

**We horen graag van mensen met**

  

* Minimaal een bachelor in Civiele Techniek, Bouwkunde of een gerelateerd vakgebied.
* Uitgebreide ervaring met **Autodesk InfraWorks** en **Civil 3D.**
  + Autodesk InfraWorks: Gedetailleerd 3D-modelleren van infrastructuurprojecten en het uitvoeren van simulaties van realistische scenario’s.
  + Autodesk Civil 3D: Ontwerpen van wegen, analyse van rioleringssystemen en het beheren van topografische en geotechnische data.
  + BIM (Building Information Modeling): Bekwaamheid in het werken met BIM voor het optimaliseren van ontwerpprocessen en de samenwerking tussen verschillende teams.
* Grondige kennis van infrastructuurontwerp en -modellering.
  + Grondige kennis van **ontwerpprincipes voor hoofdwegen, primaire wegen en andere infrastructuurelementen.**
  + Ervaring in het ontwerpen en modelleren van rioleringssystemen, wegen en andere civiele infrastructuur.
* Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en ervaring met het werken in teamverband.
* Probleemoplossend vermogen en oog voor detail.
  

**Ons rekruteringsproces**

* Pre-screeningsgesprek / diepgaand HR-interview (op locatie of via Teams) met de Talent Acquisition Partner
* 1 of 2 inhoudelijke interviews (bij voorkeur op locatie) met uw toekomstige manager
  

Onderzoek toont aan dat mannen solliciteren wanneer ze aan 60% van de vereisten voldoen, terwijl vrouwen pas solliciteren wanneer ze ervan overtuigd zijn dat ze aan 100% voldoen. Laat je daardoor niet tegenhouden – we horen graag van je!

**Wie je bent**

* **Communicatievaardigheden**: Het vermogen om effectief en duidelijk te communiceren in het Nederlands met projectteams, klanten en andere belanghebbenden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
* **Samenwerken in teamverband**: Ervaring met het werken in een multidisciplinair team en het succesvol bereiken van gezamenlijke ontwerpdoelen.
* **Probleemoplossend vermogen**: Sterk analytisch denkvermogen en het vermogen om technische problemen snel te identificeren en op te lossen.
* **Oog voor detail:** Zorgvuldigheid en precisie in ontwerpwerkzaamheden, waarbij geen enkel detail over het hoofd wordt gezien.
* **Tijdbeheer en organisatie:** Het vermogen om meerdere projecten tegelijkertijd te beheren en prioriteiten te stellen om deadlines te halen
  

**Wie we zijn**

Klaar om je positieve impact vorm te geven? Sluit je dan aan bij Tractebel, onderdeel van de **ENGIE Groep**, en onze 5600 gepassioneerde **experts** wereldwijd die zich iedere dag inzetten om te bouwen aan een **duurzamere wereld**. Draag bij aan koolstofneutraliteit in verschillende sectoren**, zoals kernenergie, hernieuwbare energie, gas en elektriciteit, elektriciteitsnetten, waterkrachtcentrales en stuwdammen, waterbeheer en -voorziening, ontzilting, complexe en hoogtechnologische gebouwen, transportinfrastructuren en havens en waterwegen.**

  

**Mensen, ethiek, veiligheid en duurzaamheid zijn onze topprioriteiten.** Met Tractebel verkeer je in een unieke positie om een positieve impact te maken op de wereldwijde net zero-doelstellingen. Als drijvende kracht achter deze doelstellingen zien we jou als onze grootste troef. **Onze mensen komen op de eerste plaats en diversiteit is onze kracht.** Diversiteit biedt immers nieuwe perspectieven die de drijvende kracht zijn achter prestaties en innovatie. Daarom verwelkomen we alle sollicitanten en blijven we ons inzetten voor een inclusieve werkplek.

  

Bij ENGIE, heeft elk talent een rol te spelen in het versnellen van de energietransitie. Maak het verschil en geniet van een verrijkende professionele ervaring. Ga interessante uitdagingen aan en bouw aan een carrièrepad dat weerspiegelt wie je bent.**Sluit je aan bij ons en maak deel uit van het avontuur van de eeuw!**

#LI-DC1

Naam Organisatie: Tractebel

Minimum salaris:

Inclusie en diversiteit vormen de kern van ons personeelsbeleid. We garanderen gelijke kansen voor alle kandidaten en zetten ons in om een zo toegankelijk mogelijke werkomgeving te creëren.

jobs.description:
**Business Area:**

**Job Description:**

At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.

Here is the updated job description with an expanded focus on **AI/ML, Generative AI, and MLOps capabilities** while preserving all of your original headings and overall structure.

Cloudera is the only hybrid data and AI platform company that large organizations trust to bring AI to their data anywhere it lives. Unlike other providers, Cloudera delivers a consistent cloud experience that converges public clouds, on-prem data centers, and the edge, leveraging a proven open-source foundation. As the pioneer in big data, Cloudera empowers businesses to apply AI and assert control over 100% of their data, in all forms, improving security, governance, and real-time and predictive insights. The world’s largest brands across all industries rely on Cloudera to transform decision-making and ultimately boost bottom lines, safeguard against threats, and save lives.

At Cloudera, our goal is to make everyone feel valued for their contributions to the company’s mission. We are looking for smart people who want to do remarkable things. We strive to build an environment of casual intensity where people enjoy coming to work every single day. We are currently seeking a customer-facing, hands-on technologist with a track record of success to join us in Switzerland.

**As a Senior Solutions Engineer you will:**

* **Own the technical sales process** from introductory meetings (net new sales) through post-sales (customer satisfaction, upselling, and subscription renewals) for enterprise data, machine learning, and AI platform solutions.
* **Support the technical needs of customers** including discovering new use cases for Cloudera’s technology, with a particular focus on Generative AI, predictive analytics, and enterprise MLOps.
* **Design solutions for your customers’ needs** using Cloudera technologies, based on reference architectures and common patterns (e.g., Open Data Lakehouse, Retrieval-Augmented Generation / RAG, and end-to-end ML pipelines).
* **Demonstrate Cloudera products**—including data engineering pipelines, model training/deployment workflows, and Generative AI features—in a way that inspires your customers to say “yes” to Cloudera.
* **Partner with your Account Managers** to show your customers the true business and technical value of a Cloudera solution and drive successful sales.
* **Present product roadmap and vision**—including state-of-the-art AI capabilities, hybrid MLOps, and secure data access—to inspire your customers to think bigger.
* **Interface with other Cloudera teams** to ensure your customers hear one Cloudera voice.
* **Advocate for your customers’ needs** to Product Management and Engineering.
* **Participate in external publicity and evangelism** (conferences, meetups, webinars, blogs) focused on hybrid data platforms, modern data engineering, and enterprise AI.
* **Achieve goals aligned to a team target** with annual sales expectations, as well as actively participate in knowledge exchange with peers and the wider community.

**We’re excited about you if you have:**

* **A passion for using technology to make a difference** to people and organisations. We'll supply some amazing tools to help you with this and you'll provide the connection to use cases (especially around data analytics, AI/ML, and modern automation), which make it real for your customers.
* **A minimum of 8 years experience** in a customer-facing role, ideally in a pre-sales context focused on big data platforms, enterprise software, or advanced analytics platforms.
* **The ability to create and give technical presentations and demonstrations** that clearly translate complex data and AI concepts into strategic business value.
* **Experience with some of the following technologies:**
  + **Big Data, Data Warehousing, or Relational Databases** (e.g., Apache Iceberg, Apache Spark, Hive, Hadoop ecosystem).
  + **AI & Machine Learning Ecosystems:** Hands-on experience building, integrating, and deploying AI solutions using modern frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain/LlamaIndex), vector databases, and MLOps tooling—with a deep understanding of GenAI architectures (RAG, fine-tuning, and model serving).
  + **One or more of the three major cloud service providers** (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Formal cloud or AI/ML certifications are not required, but would be a great thing to have.
  + **Operations, Security, and Data Governance** within the enterprise (including data privacy, compliance, and governance considerations for AI models and data assets).
  + **Unix or Linux** environments and shell scripting.
* **Experience gathering and understanding customer business requirements** across traditional data engineering and modern AI applications.
* **Excellent written and verbal communication** skills.
* **Strong problem-solving skills** and an analytical mindset.
* **A willingness to learn, a curiosity to discover**, and a drive to make your customers successful in their digital and AI transformations.
* **Four-year degree (Bachelor's)** from an accredited university required (Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related quantitative field preferred).
* **Ability to travel** domestically and internationally.

**What you can expect from us:**

* Generous PTO Policy

jobs.title: EME Systems Engineering
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

* **Introduction:** A position as EME System Engineer has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space in Getafe (Madrid).

* **Brief description of the department’s mission** :

  

The selected candidate will join the TADYX1 Team in charge of managing the disciplines of electromagnetic protection for aircraft structures and systems and antenna integration.

The candidate will be part of multicultural and multidisciplinary team working in different military programs under our product portfolio, reinforcing the team in or der to ensure the implementation of complex design solutions within different challenging military projects, covering all the complete development V cycle: from customer/airworthiness requirements capture to aircraft certification, aircraft delivery and in-service aircraft support.

**SKILLS**

  

Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to know you:

  

*-* **Education:**

Degree in Telecommunication Engineering, Aeronautical, Electrical Engineering or Physics

* **Experience:**

At least 5 years in Engineering with strong background in electromagnetism theory, electromagnetic protection measures applied to aircraft structures and systems/equipment and aircraft design.

Knowledge about integration at platform level (complete cycle: specification, validation, verification, certification/qualification).

User of complex and advanced tools for electromagnetic simulation and modelling for EME design and antenna integration (CST, FEKO, etc,..). CAD management, computational tools and postprocessing.

Good Technical skills, familiar with R/T and R&D projects.

Ability to work autonomously as well as being active part of a team.

Ability to overcome difficulties in the development of the projects.

Knowledge of applicable standard and regulation for EME equipment qualification and aircraft certification (e.g. DO-160, MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464, CS/FAR25, etc,…).

* **Soft skills** : High adaptability to work on new topics, new business and in a networking mode.

*-* **Languages:** Advanced level in English.

*-* **Technical knowledge** : programming in C#, advanced level of CATIA, Matlab, …

  

**WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE AS AIRBUS EMPLOYEE?**

At Airbus we are focused on our employees and their welfare. Take a look at some of our social benefits:

* Vacation days and additional days-off along the year (+35 days off in total)
* Attractive salary and compensation package
* Hybrid model of working when possible, promoting the work-life balance
* Collective transport service in some sites
* Benefits such as health insurance, employee stock options, retirement plan...

jobs.title: Azure Backend Engineer – Cloud Native & AI-Assisted Development
jobs.description:
**¿Te unes al reto?**

En BIP – xTech estamos buscando a gente con ganas de crecer, aprender y enfrentarse a proyectos tecnológicos de verdad: cloud, datos, IA, seguridad, automatización, DevSecOps, IoT, Industria 4.0… ¡Aquí no te vas a aburrir!

Somos un equipo diverso y con muchas ganas, donde combinamos tecnología con estrategia para ofrecer soluciones top a nuestros clientes. Si te interesa estar en el centro de la transformación digital y construir soluciones cloud modernas sobre Azure, este es tu sitio.

**¿Qué harás?**

La forma de desarrollar software está cambiando. Herramientas como GitHub Copilot, Claude Code y otros asistentes de IA permiten acelerar enormemente el desarrollo, pero seguimos necesitando buenos ingenieros capaces de diseñar la solución, tomar decisiones técnicas, integrar sistemas y garantizar que el código generado sea mantenible, seguro y esté preparado para producción.

Ahí entras tú.

Buscamos una persona con experiencia sólida en desarrollo backend con .NET y Azure, acostumbrada a construir APIs, microservicios e integraciones cloud-native.

Trabajarás en soluciones donde Azure es una parte fundamental de la arquitectura, utilizando servicios como AKS, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid, Key Vault o Application Insights, entre otros.

Y queremos que la IA forme parte de tu forma habitual de desarrollar: desde generar y refactorizar código hasta crear tests, documentación, revisar implementaciones o acelerar la resolución de problemas.

**✅** **Lo que necesitamos de ti**

Imprescindible tener al menos 3 años de experiencia en desarrollo backend con .NET, con especial foco en:

* Desarrollo .NET / C#: experiencia sólida con .NET moderno, ASP.NET Core, Web APIs, Dependency Injection, configuración, logging y gestión de errores.

* Diseño y desarrollo de APIs REST, incluyendo definición de contratos, versionado, autenticación/autorización, validación y documentación con OpenAPI/Swagger.

* Arquitecturas de microservicios: diseño de servicios desacoplados, comunicación síncrona y asíncrona, resiliencia, observabilidad y gestión de errores.

* Azure Functions: desarrollo de funciones HTTP, event-driven y background processing, incluyendo triggers y bindings.

* Integración en Azure: experiencia trabajando con servicios como Logic Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid y Storage Queues/Blob Storage para construir arquitecturas orientadas a eventos e integración entre sistemas.

* Azure Key Vault y gestión segura de secretos, certificados y configuración sensible.

* Conocimiento de Managed Identities, Entra ID y OAuth2/OIDC para autenticación entre aplicaciones y servicios Azure.

* Experiencia trabajando con SQL Server / Azure SQL y acceso a datos desde .NET, idealmente utilizando Entity Framework Core.

* Conocimientos de Docker y containerización de aplicaciones .NET.

* Experiencia trabajando con Git y procesos de CI/CD, entendiendo cómo una aplicación pasa desde el código hasta los diferentes entornos.

* Experiencia real utilizando asistentes de desarrollo basados en IA, como GitHub Copilot, Claude Code o herramientas similares, no sólo para autocompletar código, sino como parte habitual del ciclo de desarrollo.

Esperamos que seas capaz de utilizar IA para generar, revisar, refactorizar, documentar y testear código, manteniendo siempre criterio técnico sobre lo que genera.

**Nos suma mucho si además:**

* Has trabajado con arquitecturas event-driven y patrones como Pub/Sub, queues, topics o asynchronous processing.

* Experiencia desplegando o desarrollando aplicaciones que se ejecutan sobre Kubernetes, trabajando con containers, configuración, secrets, health checks, scaling y troubleshooting básico.

* Conoces patrones de diseño de microservicios como API Gateway, Circuit Breaker, Retry, Outbox, Saga o CQRS.

* Tienes experiencia con Azure Container Apps además de AKS.

* Has trabajado con Application Insights, Azure Monitor y Log Analytics para observabilidad y troubleshooting.

* Conocimientos de Azure API Management (APIM): publicación y consumo de APIs, policies, seguridad, versionado y gestión del ciclo de vida de las APIs.

* Conoces Redis / Azure Managed Redis y estrategias de caching.

* Has trabajado con Cosmos DB u otras bases de datos NoSQL.

* Entiendes conceptos de Infrastructure as Code, especialmente Terraform, aunque no esperamos que seas especialista.

* Has trabajado con Azure DevOps o GitHub Actions para CI/CD.

* Tienes experiencia escribiendo tests unitarios, de integración y contract tests.

* Has utilizado herramientas como SonarQube, GitHub Advanced Security, Snyk o similares para mejorar la calidad y seguridad del código.

* Has trabajado con Azure OpenAI / Microsoft Foundry, Semantic Kernel o integración de modelos de IA dentro de aplicaciones.

* Has trabajado con MCP, agentes de desarrollo, skills, instrucciones de repositorio o workflows agentic para mejorar el contexto que reciben las herramientas de IA durante el desarrollo.

* Tienes formación técnica (Informática, Telecomunicaciones, etc.).

* Te manejas bien en inglés.

* Tienes alguna certificación oficial de Microsoft Azure.

**¿Qué valoramos?**

* Mentalidad de ingeniería: no buscamos únicamente a alguien que programe historias de usuario, sino que entienda cómo encaja su código dentro de la arquitectura completa.

* Capacidad para diseñar soluciones simples, mantenibles y preparadas para producción.

* Criterio para decidir cuándo utilizar un microservicio, una Function, una Logic App o cualquier otro servicio de Azure.

* Entender que la IA acelera el desarrollo, pero no sustituye el criterio técnico.

* Capacidad para revisar críticamente el código generado por herramientas de IA y detectar problemas de arquitectura, seguridad, rendimiento o mantenibilidad.

* Mentalidad API-first y cloud-native.

* Buenas prácticas de desarrollo: clean code, testing, observabilidad y seguridad desde el diseño.

* Ganas de aportar, trabajar en equipo y seguir aprendiendo.

* Responsabilidad con tu trabajo y compromiso con el equipo.

* Curiosidad por cómo la IA generativa y los agentes están transformando el ciclo de desarrollo de software.

**¿Por qué unirte a BIP?**

* Personas primero: valoramos tu talento y tu equilibrio personal.

* Entorno ágil y flexible: trabajamos en remoto y con horarios que se adaptan a ti.

* Formación continua: tendrás acceso a cursos top en tecnología e innovación.

jobs.title: IT Support Engineer
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

IT systems that work effectively keep Amazon’s operations running at full speed. Our IT Support Engineers work behind the scenes to troubleshoot any issues and improve our systems, so that we can operate at our best. Your focus will be to make sure our IT infrastructure is up to the demands of our global business. At the same time, you’ll get to work with the latest technology and learn from leaders who are creating the warehouse environments of the future.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Support end-user equipment and your building’s IT infrastructure
* Help with key network projects, like the IT setup of new Amazon buildings
* Suggest new processes that improve the way Amazon uses IT in its operational sites
* Train and mentor IT technicians

  
A day in the life  
You’ll be based on site and will travel to other operational sites in your country, and potentially internationally, several times a month. As an IT Support Engineer, you’ll work with remote and on-site colleagues to support them with any issues. You’ll use your expertise to make sure our platforms are working at their best, often implementing projects to maintain or improve our IT infrastructure. In some cases, you may also help design the infrastructure for new buildings and make sure everything is working for the site launch.  
  
About the team  
Ops Tech Solutions (OTS) is the field IT organization responsible for first level troubleshoot of IT issues in our FCs, distribution centers and other sites.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience troubleshooting issues and root cause analysis
* Experience working in complex IT environments or equivalent
* Knowledge of IP networking fundamentals and extensive experience in the application of IP protocols
* Experience in network and operating system support
* Speak, write, and read fluently in Spanish and English at C1 level or above
* Valid EU driver's license

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience working in a fast-paced, rapidly changing operations environment
* Experience working in a customer-facing environment
* Experience in complex problem solving, and working in a tight schedule environment
* certification in an applicable field like A+, Net+, Sec+, CCNA, LPIC, Linux+, AWS certification
* Experience in Network protocols like DNS/DHCP/TCP, or experience in software development and experience in managing and troublshooting network

  
Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. Logoplaste:

Present in 16 countries, Logoplaste is a global value-added service provider and producer of rigid plastic packaging for well-known fast moving consumer goods companies in the food and beverage, cosmetics, personal care and household industries. We are experts in manufacturing sustainable plastic packaging through embedded, just-in-time supply chains. Our Wall to Wall business model eliminates the need for secondary packaging and the logistics associated with transporting empty bottles. We've been reducing CO2 emissions since 1976. Logoplaste goes beyond expectations turning rigid plastic packaging’s impact on the planet into a net positive for the environment and business.

Who we are & What we do  
Logoplaste Innovation Lab (iLAB) team is at the forefront of sustainable packaging, driving projects that shape the future of our industry. iLab supports all phases of packaging development, from research, design and engineering to full industrial implementation, merging groundbreaking Design & Biomimicry Thinking with top class packaging engineering.

The Recycling & Recyclability Engineer is responsible for supporting the development, assessment, and optimization of plastic packaging solutions to meet recyclability, recycled content, circular economy, and regulatory requirements. The role contributes to innovation projects, customer technical support, packaging sustainability assessments, and certification activities by applying engineering, polymer science, and recycling expertises through laboratory testing, material characterization, recycling studies, regulatory assessments, and interactions with external laboratories, customers, certification bodies, recyclers, and industry associations.

* Conduct recyclability evaluations and recyclability protocol testing.
* Identify recyclability risks and improvement opportunities.

Who we are looking for...

Background & Experience:

Technical Skill

* Fluent in English
* MS Office with Advanced Excel
* Interest in plastics, recycling, and sustainable packaging
* Basic understanding of polymer materials and recycling processes
* Laboratory testing and data analysis skills
* Ability to interpret technical results and draw conclusions
* Knowledge of sustainability and circular economy concept

Interpersonal Skills

* Eager to learn and explore new technologies, materials, and sustainability trends.

* Takes a practical approach to identifying issues and finding solutions.
* Able to explain technical topics clearly and build positive working relationships.
* Delivers accurate work and maintains high quality standards.
* Takes initiative, follows through on commitments, and looks for opportunities to contribute.

Logoplaste is committed to creating a workplace where you feel welcomed and cared for. Where you can grow as a professional and as a person. Where you have access to resources and knowledge. Where respect and integrity guide all interactions and behaviors. Where your success depends on your performance, approach and mindset.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager (Core)
jobs.description:
At **Ocean Infinity**, we're on a bold mission to subsea data using innovative technology.

Using cutting-edge robotics, autonomous technology and world-class software, we're transforming how complex operations are carried out at sea. Our uncrewed systems are making ocean exploration and operations **safer, smarter and more sustainable**, helping unlock the vast potential of our oceans while reducing environmental impact.

This isn't a vision for the future. **It's happening right now.**

As we continue to push the boundaries of innovation and redefine what's possible in the maritime industry, we're looking for exceptional talent to join our fast-growing team.

Ocean Infinity is looking for an Engineering Manager to own the people, organisational capability and engineering capacity of a group of engineers within our Core Engineering team ( C#/.NET **or** Node/TypeScript). This is a senior people-leadership role: rather than owning the technical architecture or product priority, your role is to make sure the engineers in your group are well managed, performing to the best of their abilities, and developed and deployed against the organisation’s priorities.

You’ll work closely with team leads to keep technical leadership and people management aligned as the engineering group grows, and hold responsibility for building a scalable engineering team.

 **Requirements**

**What you will do!**

* Line-manage a group of engineers: run regular 1:1s, give feedback, and own their career development.
* Own performance management, recognition and reward for your engineers.
* Lead recruitment, onboarding and retention across your group.
* Own capacity and resource planning – decide where engineering resource is deployed and flag constraints early.
* Work with engineers to allocate them to projects, and manage workload to ensure projects can be delivered on time and with a high level of quality.
* Work with the product team and other team leads to resolve resource constraints and balance competing demands for capacity.
* Build the succession and technical leadership pipeline within your group, and identify capability gaps before they affect the team.
* Protect team health, engagement and working environment, and escalate organisational, staffing or performance issues that threaten delivery.

**What we look for!**

* Several years’ experience managing and developing software engineers, ideally within a scaling engineering organisation.
* A track record of hiring, retaining and developing engineering talent, including into more senior or lead roles.
* Comfortable balancing competing demands for engineering capacity across multiple concurrent projects or squads.
* Strong 1:1, coaching and feedback skills, with the judgement to handle performance issues fairly and directly.
* Enough technical credibility in engineering to earn the trust of the engineers you manage – you don’t need to own the technology, but you need to know how it works.
* Comfortable with capacity/resource planning and making trade-off calls under constraint.
* Genuine care for people’s development, combined with the willingness to have hard conversations about performance.

**Nice to have! ✨**

* Experience managing distributed or multi-location teams.
* Previous experience in marine, defence, or aerospace.

  
**Benefits**

***\*Salary: London up to £135,000 / Porto up to 95,000 EUR Per Annum\****

jobs.title: Domain Engineer
jobs.description:
**Shine is the financial copilot for entrepreneurs and small business owners.**  
  
Founded by serial entrepreneurs Rico Andersen and Martin Hegelund, Shine is a leading European fintech unicorn on a mission to restore the joy of running a business, by ending wasted time on financial admin. Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin.  
  
**Part of something bigger**  
Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants.  
Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe.  
We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, contributing to a wider European network that spans Spain, Portugal.  
  
**Your hiring experience matters**  
Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive.  
If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.

**The ERP Engineering Team at Shine**
-------------------------------------

We're a fast-growing engineering team on a mission to build the best ERP for Small Businesses in Europe. We work in a domain-based structure, where each domain has real ownership over its area — from architecture to quality and technical roadmap.

**Your Role as a Domain Engineer**
----------------------------------

As a Domain Engineer, you're the technical reference for the product: you define architecture direction, ensure engineering standards, and work closely with team managers and Senior Engineers to make sure technical decisions serve the business goals. This is a senior IC role, focused on cross-cutting technical impact, not people management.  
We're modernizing our stack and expanding into new markets, which means real problems around scale, multi-tenancy, and domain complexity — not greenfield, but not paralyzing legacy either.  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own the target architecture of your domain and the realistic path to get there.
* Ensure reliability, scalability, security, and compliance are design constraints from day one, not afterthoughts.
* Maintain living architecture documentation (C4 model diagrams, ADRs) as part of the engineering workflow.
* Set and calibrate design review thresholds, delegating to senior engineers as their judgment grows.
* Spend roughly half your time embedded with engineering teams, and half on cross-engineering work — standards, the Golden Path, and the Architecture Forum.
* Grow the architectural judgment of senior engineers, so fewer decisions need to come through you over time.
* Partner with Engineering Directors, Engineering Managers, and Product to surface technical constraints and trade-offs with clarity.

**Job located in Porto with possibility of two remote working days per week.**

**About you**
-------------

* **Scalable systems experience:** You have significant hands-on experience designing and evolving systems at scale, ideally within multi-tenant SaaS or platform environments.
* **Architectural ownership:** You take end-to-end ownership of architecture decisions. You ensure your reasoning is well-documented so others can easily understand the context and trade-offs later.
* **Influence without authority:** You are comfortable operating with technical authority and guiding direction without needing formal line-management authority.
* **Cross-functional communication:** You can translate complex technical trade-offs into clear, legible concepts for Product managers and business leadership.
* **Empowerment over centralization:** You have a genuine interest in developing other engineers' judgment rather than centralizing decision-making around yourself.
* **Tech stack & domain experience:** You are comfortable with .NET, Angular, SQL Server, Azure, and modern CI/CD practices. Experience with financial, accounting, or ERP systems—as well as European regulatory compliance—is a strong differentiator.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

We follow the principle of equal treatment to consider all job applicants and do not discriminate based on their gender, sexual orientation, color, racial or ethnic origin, religion, disability, etc. as per applicable law.

**Our recruitment process**
---------------------------

1️⃣ A 45' first call with Marc (Talent Acquisition Specialist) to get to know you better and share more about Ageras.

2️⃣ A 90' Technical Interview with one of our Domain Engineers to dive into Architecture and Coding topics

3️⃣ A 45' Manager interview with Rui (Senior Engineering Manager) to dive deeper into our set up.

4️⃣ A 60' Practical Assessment with one of our Domain Engineer.

Partnerünk 1989 óta a hazai piac meghatározó szereplője, a bér- és HR-szoftverek területén piacvezető és trendteremtő vállalat. Megoldásaikkal minden negyedik hazai munkavállaló találkozik a bérpapírján vagy mobilalkalmazásukon keresztül. Termékeik sikere a Kutatás és Fejlesztés csapat munkájának köszönhető, ahol a jövő HR-digitalizációs megoldásait tervezik és hozzák létre.
  
Csatlakozz a csapatukhoz, és légy részese a hazai sikermegoldások nemzetközi piacra történő felkészítésének! Egy olyan ösztönző környezet vár, ahol az innovatív szakmai tudás a korszerű webes és backend technológiákkal találkozik.

**Feladatok**
-------------

* Részvétel az üzleti és fejlesztői betanulási folyamatban, amely megalapozza a termékek és technológiák mély megismerését
* Agilis módszertan mentén, 2-4 fős dedikált fejlesztői csapatokban való hatékony együttműködés

* Megbízható, tiszta kód írása és az üzleti logika lefedése automata tesztekkel
* Meglévő és új generációs modulok integrációja, architektúrális fejlesztése
* Részvétel a hazai piacon már bizonyított bérügyviteli megoldások nemzetközi piacra vitelében

**Elvárások**
-------------

* Legalább 5-10 év releváns szoftverfejlesztői tapasztalat
* Magabiztos C# és .NET háttér (ASP.NET MVC, Web API)
* Kliensoldali / frontend webes tapasztalat (Angular)
* Relációs adatbázisok és ORM rendszerek mély ismerete (pl. NHibernate, Entity Framework)
* IoC / DI containerek készségszintű használata (pl. Autofac vagy beépített .NET DI)
* Automata tesztelési rutin és igényesség a kódminőség iránt (Unit / Integration testing)
* RESTful API-k és szervizarchitektúrák tervezésében, fejlesztésében szerzett gyakorlat
* Eredményorientált, minőségtudatos hozzáállás

**Előnyök**
-----------

* Tapasztalat az alábbi technológiák valamelyikében: Angular 1.x, WebApi, OData, Autofac, NHibernate, SignalR, FluentValidation, EPPlus
* Más modern webes keretrendszerben (modern Angular, React) vagy korszerű .NET Core / .NET 8 környezetben szerzett tapasztalat
* Nagyvállalati üzleti, bérügyviteli vagy ERP rendszerek fejlesztésében szerzett jártasság
* Angol nyelvtudás (nemzetközi projektek és piacra lépés támogatásához)
* Strukturált, tiszta architektúrális szemlélet (Clean Architecture, DDD, mikroszervizek)

**Amit ajánlunk**
-----------------

* Naprakész bérpiaci információkra alapozott versenyképes bér, az átlagnál magasabb cafeteria keret, teljesítménybónusz
* Valódi munka-magánélet egyensúly: rugalmas munkaidő, heti több napos otthoni munkavégzés (hibrid modell)
* Munkába járás támogatása: bérlettámogatás, zárt kerékpártároló, öltöző és zuhanyzó
* Családbarát intézkedések: nyári gyerektáboroztatás támogatása, családi rendezvények, munkatársi segélyezési rendszer
* Prémium munkakörnyezet: „A´ kategóriás, díjnyertes irodaház a Váci úton, tágas személyes terekkel és zöld erkélyekkel
* Feltöltődési lehetőségek az irodában: pihenőszoba, jól felszerelt saját tornaterem, reggeli közös jógaóra, teraszos programok és összetartó közösség

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer in Test (SET) - GenAI Focus
jobs.description:
EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.

We are looking for a **Senior Software Engineer in Test** with a strong technical background in test automation and specialized expertise in Generative AI (GenAI) and AI-driven testing. In this role, you will lead the integration of AI-powered capabilities into our testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and quality workflows to maximize automation coverage, efficiency, and product intelligence.

**Responsibilities**

* AI-Driven Test Automation Strategy: Lead the design and implementation of next-generation test automation frameworks enhanced by Generative AI and agentic workflows
* GenAI Tooling & Utilities: Develop, maintain, and scale custom AI-assisted utilities, agents, and APIs for automated test generation, test data synthesis, self-healing tests, and intelligent root cause analysis
* CI/CD & AI Observability Integration: Integrate GenAI capabilities into CI/CD pipelines for automated regression analysis, test monitoring, and quality gating. Use AI observability tools to monitor the behavior and reliability of AI-assisted test components
* Test Automation & Quality: Build, maintain, and execute robust automated test suites across multiple programming languages and platforms, ensuring high code quality and testability
* Tool Evaluation & Innovation: Conduct evaluations of emerging AI-driven testing tools and GenAI models, recommending and prototyping the best fit for project needs
* Collaboration & Leadership: Collaborate closely with developers, DevOps engineers, and product teams to enforce best coding practices, conduct code reviews, and drive AI adoption across the SDLC
* Client Engagement: Demonstrate AI-based automation prototypes to clients, explaining their value propositions, assumptions, limitations, and architectural patterns

**Requirements**

* Experience: 3+ years of Software Engineering experience in Software Testing, Test Automation, DevOps Automation, and Software Development
* Core Test Automation & Programming: Advanced proficiency in test automation, with hands-on expertise in at least one core programming language (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript, or .NET)
* GenAI & AI-Driven Testing (Must-Have):
* Solid practical knowledge of Generative AI, LLMs, prompting techniques, and AI APIs applied directly to QA and automation workflows
* Hands-on experience using GenAI tools to accelerate test design, automation code development, debugging, and synthetic test data generation
* Understanding of agentic workflows, AI evaluation principles, and AI model/system observability
* DevOps & CI/CD: Advanced hands-on experience integrating test automation suites with DevOps and CI/CD pipelines
* Software Engineering Practices: Strong grasp of software design patterns, clean coding standards, static code analysis, and branching strategies (e.g., Git Flow)
* Soft Skills: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, ability to manage tasks independently, and excellent communication and presentation skills for client collaboration

**Nice to have**

* Experience building or orchestrating LLM workflows using frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar
* Advanced skills in embedded systems testing (using Python, Java, or .NET) and experience with testbed creation for physical products
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) and infrastructure monitoring tools

**We offer**

* Dynamic, entrepreneurial corporate environment
* Diverse multicultural, multi-functional, and multilingual work environment
* Opportunities for personal and career growth in a progressive industry
* Global scope, international projects
* Widespread training and development opportunities
* Access to LinkedIn Learning solutions
* Competitive salary and various benefits
* Advanced wellbeing and CSR programs, recreation area

Do you know someone interested in starting a career in IT? Share our EPAM Campus programs with them, where they can enhance their knowledge in various fields online, free of charge.

new_jobs.title: Director, Value Engineering
new_jobs.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

**About Celonis**
-----------------

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes.

The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and operational intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand—turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. By providing the essential business context that AI agents and tools need to act effectively, Celonis makes AI truly enterprise-ready.

Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global partner ecosystem to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together to achieve transformational outcomes. Headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, Celonis operates globally with over 20 offices worldwide.

**About the Role**
------------------

Based at our global headquarters in **Munich**, as a **Value Engineering Manager / Director** for **CPG & Retail**, you will hold full operational and leadership responsibility specifically for the **CPG & Retail segment across the DACH region**. In this role, you will lead a dedicated, high-performing team of 6–7 Value Engineers operating at the intersection of process transformation, executive consulting, and AI-driven product execution, driving the end-to-end customer value journey and accelerating enterprise AI adoption across major retail and consumer goods brands.

In this role, you will serve as a player-coach, actively guiding, coaching, and developing a talented, high-potential team with diverse backgrounds spanning supply chain, procurement, management consulting, and retail operations. This role offers tremendous growth potential as you both develop and learn alongside top-tier talent, while serving as a trusted advisor to C-level executives at major enterprise accounts.

**What Sets Our Patch Apart**
-----------------------------

The DACH CPG & Retail patch represents some of the world's most recognizable consumer brands, retail giants, and mobility innovators.

As our DACH CPG & Retail customers navigate complex global supply chains, omnichannel fulfillment challenges, and the rapid rise of Process Intelligence and Agentic AI, you will engage directly—in both German and English—with vocal customer champions, C-level decision-makers, and pioneering thought leaders shaping the future of retail and consumer goods innovation.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Drive Business Outcomes & Account Growth:** Take full ownership of ARR targets, renewal forecasts, and net retention across the DACH CPG & Retail sector. Ensure high forecasting accuracy and steer accounts toward tangible, realized value.
* **People Leadership & Coaching:** Recruit, onboard, lead, and mentor a team of 6–7 Munich-based Value Engineers. Maintain high standards through proactive coaching, performance management, and career progression planning.
* **Executive Advisory & Player-Coach:** Serve as a Celonis Executive Sponsor on critical DACH deals. Join your team in the field to lead high-impact executive meetings, dry runs, value sprints, and strategic transformation workshops.
* **Enterprise AI Champion:** Partner with customer executives to position Celonis as the foundation for modern process intelligence, digital operational excellence, and next-generation Agentic AI adoption using our Context Model and Digital Twin capabilities.
* **Ecosystem & Partner Strategy:** Cultivate executive-level relationships across regional partner networks, services teams, and account executives to align CPG and retail customer strategies with Celonis AI solutions.
* **Thought Leadership:** Standardize and scale best practices, reusable solution blueprints, and CPG/Retail industry-specific frameworks internally and across external customer communities.

**Leadership Behaviors We Value**
---------------------------------

* **Deliver Business Outcomes:** Focus on top- and bottom-line impact, maintaining green customer health and expanding retention across new logos and key enterprise accounts.
* **Motivate, Develop & Nurture Talent:** Build an inclusive, high-trust environment that attracts top-tier external talent, retains top performers, accelerates individual growth, and addresses underperformance early.
* **Lead by Example:** Embody the "player/coach" mentality, maintaining an active on-site presence with priority accounts and upholding strict quality standards across all engagements.
* **Think BIG, Be BOLD:** Champion an entrepreneurial growth mindset by expanding your internal/external network, spearheading new go-to-market motions, and positioning Celonis as an essential innovation driver in retail and consumer goods.

**Qualifications & Scope**
--------------------------

* **Language Skills:** Native or business-fluent **German** (spoken and written) and fluent **English** are required to interface effectively with executive decision-makers across the DACH market.
* **Location Presence:** Based in or willing to relocate to **Munich**, with willingness to travel to customer sites across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland as needed.
* **Proven Leadership Experience:** Track record leading pre-sales, management consulting, or value engineering teams within Enterprise SaaS, Enterprise AI, or Management Consulting.
* **Domain Expertise:** Deep domain familiarity with supply chain, procurement, fulfillment, and operational processes within the CPG & Retail industries.
* **People Management:** Demonstrated ability to directly manage or mentor a team of 6–7 high-performing individual contributors, with a strong passion for team coaching and talent development.
* **Commercial Acumen:** Strong business acumen with experience owning ACV, net retention, and renewal pipeline metrics.
* **Executive Presence:** Outstanding executive presence with a proven track record of building C-level relationships across global brands and regional retail leaders.

new_jobs.title: Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer

**Locations: SM, KT, SW, SE, WC, EC, W, TW, NW, N**

Are you a qualified Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer looking for excellent earning potential, structured work and the security of working directly for an established energy supplier?

At Utilita, we're growing our award-winning Field Services team. Join one of the UK's fastest-growing energy suppliers and a business that has been recognised as one of the UK's Top 50 Best Workplaces for four consecutive years.

What is in it for you?

You'll receive a base salary of £38,993, alongside uncapped earning potential and a variety of opportunities to boost your overall earnings, including:

* **On-call payment:** Receive £330 for each on-call week, based on an average rota of one week in five. (OTE of £42,293 just with the base salary and conducting mandatory on call requirements)
* **Industry-leading installation bonus:** Benefit from an uncapped installation bonus of £25 per meter or £50 per dual installation once you have completed a minimum of four installations in a day, with additional work opportunities available to further enhance your earnings.
* **London weighting:** Receive an additional £2,000 annual allowance if you live within the M25.
* **Enhanced overtime:** Enhanced overtime rates for Sunday working.

Alongside your salary and uncapped earning potential, you will receive 25 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays, a healthcare scheme, mental wellbeing support, access to 24/7 GP and counselling services, and a generous pension scheme. You will also receive one paid volunteering day each year and have opportunities to win tickets to events at Utilita-sponsored arenas and football matches.

Why work at Utilita?

**A schedule that supports your work-life balance.**

We understand that a great Smart Meter Engineer role is not just about salary. It is also about having a structured working day and being able to plan your life accordingly.

You will be scheduled an average of 4 jobs per day, with an average travel time to jobs of approximately 35 minutes between appointments.

We aim to schedule your work several weeks in advance, giving you greater visibility of your schedule. This helps you plan life outside work while still giving you the opportunity to take on additional work when it suits you.

**First-class training and support.**

Your journey will begin at our award-winning training academy in Warrington, where you will receive a comprehensive induction.

You will then receive ongoing mentoring to help you strengthen your knowledge, understand our processes and confidently adapt to the Utilita way of working.

**A team that keeps you connected.**

We understand that working in the field can sometimes feel isolating, which is why creating a connected and supportive environment is so important to us.

Through regular manager check-ins, access to technical experts, collaborative colleague networks and ongoing communication, you'll always have the support you need and someone to turn to throughout your working day.

What you will be doing.

As a Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer, you will represent Utilita in customers’ homes, installing smart meters safely and professionally across domestic properties.

You will play an important role in delivering our customer-first approach, providing a positive experience while maintaining high standards of safety, quality and service.

**What we need from you.**

To be considered for this opportunity, you will need:

* Smart Metering qualifications, including CCN1 or CMA1 and MET1, or equivalent.
* At least 12 months experience working as a Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer.
* A valid full UK driving licence.

Who are Utilita?

Founded in 2003, Utilita Energy was created to challenge the Big Six energy suppliers by offering a fair and flexible service that is good for both the pocket and the planet.

As the first supplier to install a Smart Meter back in 2005 and kick-start Britain’s smart meter revolution, we continue to invest in smart technology and look for new ways to improve our services through innovation.

We are also committed to sustainability, with an ambition to become a Net Zero business by 2030. We believe everyone can make a meaningful impact through small, positive changes.

Our values are simple but powerful:

**Fairness. Smart. Sustainability.**

Our employees and customers come from all walks of life. We are committed to championing diversity, creating an inclusive culture and providing an environment where you can be your authentic self.

Utilita is part of the Luxion group whichcomprises Luxion Group Ltd, Utilita Energy Ltd, Luxion Sales Ltd, Utilita Field Services Ltd, Procode Technology Ltd and Canary Care Global Ltd.

new_jobs.description:
Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer

**Locations:** DD, PH, TD, IV, KY and DG

Are you a qualified Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer looking for excellent earning potential, structured work and the security of working directly for an established energy supplier?

At Utilita, we're growing our award-winning Field Services team. Join one of the UK's fastest-growing energy suppliers and a business that has been recognised as one of the UK's Top 50 Best Workplaces for four consecutive years.

What is in it for you?

You'll receive a base salary of £38,993, alongside uncapped earning potential and a variety of opportunities to boost your overall earnings, including:

* **On-call payment:** Receive £330 for each on-call week, based on an average rota of one week in five. (OTE of £42,293 just with the base salary and conducting mandatory on call requirements)
* **Industry-leading installation bonus:** Benefit from an uncapped installation bonus of £25 per meter or £50 per dual installation once you have completed a minimum of four installations in a day, with additional work opportunities available to further enhance your earnings.
* **London weighting:** Receive an additional £2,000 annual allowance if you live within the M25.
* **Enhanced overtime:** Enhanced overtime rates for Sunday working.

Alongside your salary and uncapped earning potential, you will receive 25 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays, a healthcare scheme, mental wellbeing support, access to 24/7 GP and counselling services, and a generous pension scheme. You will also receive one paid volunteering day each year and have opportunities to win tickets to events at Utilita-sponsored arenas and football matches.

Why work at Utilita?

**A schedule that supports your work-life balance.**

We understand that a great Smart Meter Engineer role is not just about salary. It is also about having a structured working day and being able to plan your life accordingly.

You will be scheduled an average of 4 jobs per day, with an average travel time to jobs of approximately 35 minutes between appointments.

We aim to schedule your work several weeks in advance, giving you greater visibility of your schedule. This helps you plan life outside work while still giving you the opportunity to take on additional work when it suits you.

**First-class training and support.**

Your journey will begin at our award-winning training academy in Warrington, where you will receive a comprehensive induction.

You will then receive ongoing mentoring to help you strengthen your knowledge, understand our processes and confidently adapt to the Utilita way of working.

**A team that keeps you connected.**

We understand that working in the field can sometimes feel isolating, which is why creating a connected and supportive environment is so important to us.

Through regular manager check-ins, access to technical experts, collaborative colleague networks and ongoing communication, you'll always have the support you need and someone to turn to throughout your working day.

What you will be doing.

As a Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer, you will represent Utilita in customers’ homes, installing smart meters safely and professionally across domestic properties.

You will play an important role in delivering our customer-first approach, providing a positive experience while maintaining high standards of safety, quality and service.

**What we need from you.**

To be considered for this opportunity, you will need:

* Smart Metering qualifications, including CCN1 or CMA1 and MET1, or equivalent.
* At least 12 months experience working as a Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer.
* A valid full UK driving licence.

Who are Utilita?

Founded in 2003, Utilita Energy was created to challenge the Big Six energy suppliers by offering a fair and flexible service that is good for both the pocket and the planet.

As the first supplier to install a Smart Meter back in 2005 and kick-start Britain’s smart meter revolution, we continue to invest in smart technology and look for new ways to improve our services through innovation.

We are also committed to sustainability, with an ambition to become a Net Zero business by 2030. We believe everyone can make a meaningful impact through small, positive changes.

Our values are simple but powerful:

**Fairness. Smart. Sustainability.**

Our employees and customers come from all walks of life. We are committed to championing diversity, creating an inclusive culture and providing an environment where you can be your authentic self.

Utilita is part of the Luxion group whichcomprises Luxion Group Ltd, Utilita Energy Ltd, Luxion Sales Ltd, Utilita Field Services Ltd, Procode Technology Ltd and Canary Care Global Ltd.

new_jobs.description:
**About the role**

**Job Title**: Senior Estimator – Civil Engineering

**Location:** Balfour Beatty Maxim Business Park Eurocentral

**Company:** Balfour Beatty

**Project:** SCAPE Framework

**Build your future with Balfour Beatty**

Balfour Beatty is looking for an experienced Senior Civils Estimator to join our civil engineering work-winning team and support the successful delivery of projects through the SCAPE framework.

This is more than a traditional estimating position. It is a genuine career-development opportunity, created as part of our longer-term succession planning. You will be given the support, exposure and responsibility needed to continue developing your technical, commercial and leadership capabilities, with a clear opportunity to progress into a more senior role within the estimating and work-winning function.

We are looking for someone with approximately 8–10 years of project-focused civil engineering estimating experience who is ready to take the next significant step in their career.

 **What you'll be doing**

**Key Responsibilities**

You will take ownership of the estimating and tendering process for a varied portfolio of civil engineering projects, working closely with operational, commercial, design and supply-chain teams.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Reviewing tender enquiries, scopes of work and commercial requirements.
* Producing accurate estimates from first principles for earthworks, drainage, concrete, reinforcement and formwork.
* Completing quantity take-offs from drawings, specifications and schedules.
* Developing bills of quantities, schedules of rates and material requirements.
* Assessing construction methodologies, temporary works, plant, labour and site-resource requirements.
* Preparing and issuing subcontract and supplier enquiries.
* Interrogating supply-chain quotations, identifying exclusions, omissions and commercial risks.
* Attending pre-tender meetings, site visits and client discussions.
* Producing tender summaries, qualifications and supporting submission documents.
* Supporting tender adjudications and agreeing the final tender price with senior leadership.
* Assisting with post-tender reviews, contract handovers and project kick-off meetings.
* Sharing knowledge and supporting the development of less-experienced estimators

  
**Who we're looking for**

**About you**

You will bring strong estimating experience gained across project-focused civil engineering environments, ideally covering areas such as:

* Roads and highways.
* Bridge construction.
* Public-realm improvements.
* Structural concrete.
* Coastal defence.
* Infrastructure and civil engineering frameworks.

You should also have:

* Approximately 8–10 years’ civil engineering estimating experience.
* The ability to price work accurately from first principles.
* Experience of the NEC suite of contracts.
* Knowledge of highways methods of measurement and CESMM.
* Experience pricing civil engineering projects of varying size and complexity.
* A good understanding of temporary works and associated costs.
* Confidence using estimating software, Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word.
* The ability to manage competing deadlines with minimal supervision.
* Strong communication skills and the confidence to engage with clients, operational teams and supply-chain partners.

**A role designed around your development**

This position offers the opportunity to work on visible and varied SCAPE projects while learning from experienced leaders across our work-winning and operational teams.

As part of our succession-planning strategy, we want to appoint someone who has the ambition and potential to take on greater responsibility over time. You will receive structured support to develop your leadership skills, strengthen your commercial decision-making and build the experience required for future progression within Balfour Beatty.

**Why join us?**

You will be joining a collaborative business where your ideas, experience and career ambitions will be valued. Alongside the opportunity to work on meaningful civil engineering projects, you will benefit from the scale, expertise and long-term career opportunities available across Balfour Beatty.

**Ready to take the next step in your estimating career? Apply today and help us shape the next generation of civil engineering projects and estimating leadership.**

**Professional and personal development**

The size and scale of Balfour Beatty coupled with our strong pipeline of work provides incredible opportunities, regardless of what stage you are at in your career.

We encourage and empower our employees to take control of their career and explore which part of the business they want to work in and what role is right for them. We actively encourage our managers and employees to have open communication throughout the year about wellbeing, development and career opportunities.

We're proud of the Balfour Beatty Academy. Whether it’s sharpening your technical expertise, improving your personal skills or seeking support to become professionally qualified, our 70:20:10\* approach to development means we have a learning approach that suits everyone.

* 70% learning on the job, 20% learning from those around you, and 10% formal training courses and learning events.

**For further information about Balfour Beatty Scotland please go to www.balfourbeatty.com/ Scotland - You can also check out further job opportunities in the careers section**

Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services in strategy and consulting, interactive, technology and operations, with digital capabilities across all of these services. With our thought leadership and culture of innovation, we apply industry expertise, diverse skill sets and next-generation technology to each business challenge.

* Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI/Microsoft Foundry and Generative AI.
* Experience with AI agents, RAG, Azure AI Search, APIs, Power Platform and Dataverse.

**Microsoft Power Platform Senior Developer**

**Location: London**

**Salary: Competitive salary and package dependant on experience**

**Career Level: Associate Manager (CL8)**

**Please Note: Any offer of employment is subject to satisfactory BPSS and SC security clearance, which requires 5 years continuous UK address history at the point of application.**

**About the team and the**

Accenture's Microsoft Business Group (MBG) UK is seeking a technically exceptional Microsoft Power Platform Senior Developer at Level 8 (Associate Manager) to join our growing delivery capability. This sits at the technical heart of our Power Platform practice — combining deep hands-on development expertise with emerging team leadership responsibility across high-value client engagements.

As a Senior Developer at Level 8, you will be the go-to technical authority on Power Platform delivery teams, driving solution quality, architectural integrity, and developer best practices. You will work alongside Delivery Managers and Solution Architects on complex enterprise programmes, whilst beginning to take on line management and mentoring responsibilities for junior developers.

This is ideal for a highly experienced Power Platform developer who has a proven delivery track record in a consulting or SI environment and is ready to step into a formal leadership and technical governance within one of the world's largest Microsoft practices.

What you will do in the of a Senior Developer:

**Technical Delivery & Development**
------------------------------------

* Design, build, and deliver complex Power Platform solutions across Power Apps (model-driven and canvas), Power Automate, Power Pages, and Dataverse for enterprise clients
* Lead technical delivery across one or more workstreams within large Power Platform programmes, taking end-to-end ownership of solution components
* Develop advanced solutions utilising PCF (PowerApps Component Framework) controls, custom connectors, and complex Dataverse data models
* Architect and implement ALM (Application Lifecycle Management) pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, and Power Platform Build Tools
* Build and maintain integrations with D365 CE, M365, Azure services, and third-party platforms using REST APIs, OData, Azure Service Bus, and Logic Apps
* Ensure all developed solutions adhere to Microsoft Well-Architected Framework principles and Accenture delivery quality standards

**Architecture & Technical Governance**
---------------------------------------

* Contribute to solution architecture design, including data model design, security architecture, and integration patterns
* Conduct and lead technical design reviews, code reviews, and architecture assurance sessions
* Establish and enforce Power Platform coding standards, naming conventions, and development best practices across the team
* Implement and manage Power Platform CoE (Centre of Excellence) Toolkit configurations, including environment strategy, DLP policies, and governance frameworks
* Provide technical risk assessments and mitigation recommendations to Delivery Managers and Solution Architects
* Evaluate and recommend emerging Power Platform capabilities including AI Builder, Copilot Studio, and Microsoft Copilot integrations

**Team Leadership & Mentoring**
-------------------------------

* Line manage 2–5 junior and mid-level Power Platform developers, including objective setting, performance reviews, and career development conversations
* Provide day-to-day technical mentoring and guidance to developers, acting as the first point of escalation for technical blockers
* Onboard new team members and ensure consistent application of delivery standards across the developer community
* Contribute to the MBG UK Power Platform community of practice through knowledge sharing, technical blogs, and internal enablement sessions
* Support the identification and recruitment of Power Platform talent in collaboration with the Talent Acquisition team

**Client & Stakeholder Engagement**
-----------------------------------

* Engage confidently with client technical leads and senior stakeholders to present solution designs, demonstrate prototypes, and manage technical expectations
* Lead technical workshops, requirements discovery sessions, and solution walkthroughs with client teams
* Support pre-sales activities including technical solutioning, effort estimation, and proposal contributions
* Participate in client steering groups and technical governance forums as the senior technical voice for Power Platform delivery

**Quality & Innovation**
------------------------

* Champion test-driven development practices including unit testing, automated UI testing (Test Studio), and performance testing for Power Platform solutions
* Drive continuous improvement in delivery tooling, developer productivity, and reusable component libraries
* Identify and prototype AI-augmented development capabilities including Copilot in Power Apps, AI Builder models, and Copilot Studio agents
* Contribute to Accenture IP development through reusable accelerators, solution templates, and internal tooling

  

**We are looking for significant experience in:**  
**Core Power Platform Development**

* Hands-on Microsoft Power Platform development experience in a consulting or SI delivery environment
* Expert-level proficiency in Power Apps (both model-driven and canvas), Power Automate (cloud flows, desktop flows/RPA), and Dataverse
* Proven experience developing PCF controls using TypeScript/React and deploying via managed solutions
* Strong command of Power Fx, DAX (for Power BI integration), and JavaScript/TypeScript for web resource and PCF development
* Deep experience with Dataverse: complex data modelling, relationships, business rules, calculated fields, rollup fields, and virtual tables
* Hands-on experience with Power Pages (formerly Power Apps Portals) including Liquid templates, web templates, and portal security

**ALM, DevOps & Integration**
-----------------------------

* Expert knowledge of Power Platform ALM: solution management (managed/unmanaged), environment strategy, solution layering, and deployment pipelines
* Hands-on experience building CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions with Power Platform Build Tools and PAC CLI
* Strong integration development experience: REST/OData APIs, Dataverse Web API, custom connectors, Azure API Management, and Azure Service Bus
* Experience with Azure services in a Power Platform context: Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Key Vault, and Azure AD/Entra ID
* Familiarity with Dynamics 365 CE customisation: plugins (C#/.NET), JavaScript web resources, Ribbon Workbench, and XrmToolBox

**Architecture & Governance**
-----------------------------

* Experience designing enterprise-grade Power Platform governance frameworks including DLP policies, CoE Toolkit deployment, and environment tiering
* Understanding of Microsoft security and compliance model: Azure AD Conditional Access, Dataverse RBAC, column-level security, and auditing
* Ability to produce and own technical design documentation including solution architecture documents, data flow diagrams, and integration specifications
* Familiarity with Power Platform licensing models and capacity planning for enterprise deployments

**Consulting & Communication**
------------------------------

* Proven ability to engage and communicate confidently with technical and non-technical client stakeholders
* Experience in a professional services, consulting, or SI environment
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions
* Experience producing client-facing deliverables: technical design documents, solution architecture presentations, and sprint reviews

**What will set you apart:**

* Experience with Copilot Studio (formerly Power Virtual Agents): agent design, topic authoring, and integration with enterprise data sources
* Hands-on experience with AI Builder: document processing models, prediction models, and object detection
* Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, or Power BI Premium in a data platform context
* Experience with Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations or Business Central in a Power Platform integration context
* Familiarity with Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Purview, or Compliance Manager in regulated industry deployments
* Experience delivering Power Platform solutions in Financial Services, Insurance, Energy, or Public Sector verticals in the UK
* Knowledge of Avanade co-delivery models and ATCI offshore development engagement practices
* Experience contributing to Microsoft FastTrack for Power Platform or Microsoft Success by Design programmes

**Essential Certifications**

* **PL-400**: the primary technical developer credential — validates advanced development skills including PCF controls, custom connectors, and Power Automate. Mandatory for this role
* **PL-600**: Solution Architect designation — expected at Level 8 to confirm ability to own solution design and technical governance on complex programmes
* **PL-200**: functional consultant credential that complements PL-400 by validating business process and configuration depth across the Power Platform suite
* **AI-200 / AI-103**: Microsoft's new 2026 developer certifications for AI-integrated cloud apps and Copilot Studio agent development — central to MBG's AI Copilot go-to-market
* **AI-901**: mandatory AI literacy baseline across all MBG UK roles — covers generative AI, Azure AI services, and Copilot platform concepts
* **AZ-400**: validates DevOps engineering skills including CI/CD pipeline design and Power Platform Build Tools — strongly recommended for developers owning ALM

**What’s in it for you**

At Accenture in addition to a competitive basic salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package which includes 25 days’ vacation per year and 3 extra days leave per year for charitable work of your choice!

**Flexibility and mobility are required to deliver this role as there may be requirements to spend time onsite with our clients and partners to enable delivery of the first-class services we are known for.**

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Interactive, Technology and Operations services—all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities. Visit us at www.accenture.com.

* Steam Cycle Modelling Oversight – Ability to define modelling outcomes and ensure accurate implementation.

* Cooling Water Equipment Expertise – Strong track record in designing and optimizing cooling water systems.
* Regulatory & Compliance Knowledge – Well-versed in ONR, Environment Agency, and HSE regulations.
* Requirements Capture Experience – Skilled in gathering and defining technical requirements.
* Systems Engineering Awareness – Strong understanding of integrated design principles.
* Subcontractor Management – Experienced in overseeing and coordinating subcontractors.
* Chartered Engineer (CEng) – Professional accreditation in a relevant discipline.
* Security Clearance Eligibility – Capable of obtaining SC clearance for secure projects.

* Excellent communication skills, written and oral
* Strong leadership skills
* Focus on delivering quality output to time and budget
* Act with integrity and instils this in others

* Confident in a multi-party, multi-national environment – Comfortable working with global teams and diverse stakeholders.
