new_jobs.title: Junior Broadcast Event Engineer, Studios
new_jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**

IMG is a leading global sports marketing agency, specializing in media rights management and sales, multi-channel content production and distribution, brand partnerships, strategic consulting, digital services, and event management. It powers growth of revenues, fanbases and IP for more than 250 federations, associations, events, and teams, including the National Football League, English Premier League, International Olympic Committee, National Hockey League, Major League Soccer, ATP and WTA Tours, the AELTC (Wimbledon), Euroleague Basketball, CONMEBOL, World Rugby, DP World Tour, and The R&A, as well as UFC, WWE, and PBR. IMG is a subsidiary of TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO), a premium sports and entertainment company.

TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.



Cingularity is a highly specialised global fibre network provider, delivering premium live broadcast transmission services for some of the world's leading media and sports organisations.Our commitment to quality, performance, and network resilience enables us to support global broadcasters and rights holders including Amazon Prime, Warner Bros. Discovery, and the WTA, delivering live television content to audiences worldwide.

  

In September 2022, Cingularity was acquired by IMG Media, combining our expertise in fibre-based transmission with IMG's ambition to drive the future of remote production through hybrid fibre, satellite, cloud, and IP-based workflows.

  

**Working Conditions:**

* This is a Permanent position
* This role is based at our facility in Gunthorpe St, London
* **You will be required to spend a considerable amount of time away supporting global events. 70% international travel.**
You must have the ability to work unsociable and extended hours as required to cover sporting events.  

  

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

We are looking for a **Junior Broadcast Event Engineer** to join our growing Events team.

  

This role is ideal for a recent graduate, apprentice, trainee engineer, or someone with up to two years of experience in broadcasting, networking, or live events who is looking to build a career in live sports broadcast transmission. Working alongside experienced Event Engineers, you will gain hands-on exposure to every stage of live event delivery, from equipment preparation and testing through to on-site deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and event support.

  

This is a unique opportunity to work on premium global sporting events while developing specialist knowledge in broadcast transmission, IP networking, fibre technologies, and remote production workflows.

  

The role is primarily based in London at **3 Gunthorpe Street, London, E1 7RL** , with regular visits to **IMG Studios, Stockley Park (Hayes, Uxbridge)** for equipment builds and testing. Extensive UK, European, and international travel will be required to support live events worldwide.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Pre-Event Preparation**

* Assist with the staging, configuration, and testing of event equipment.
* Read and interpret network topology, schematic, and engineering drawings.
* Support the creation and maintenance of technical documentation.
* Participate in customer and project planning meetings.
* Liaise with telecommunications suppliers under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Prepare, label, pack, ship, and track equipment for events.
* Maintain accurate inventory records.

### **On-Site Event Delivery**

* Support the installation, rigging, testing, and commissioning of transmission systems.
* Assist with network connectivity, encoding, decoding, and transmission services.
* Monitor event equipment and associated video, audio, and data services.
* Provide first-line technical support to customers and stakeholders on-site.
* Escalate service issues appropriately to senior engineers.
* Maintain accurate operational logs and documentation throughout events.
* Support equipment de-rig and pack-down activities following event completion.
Ensure all work is completed safely and in line with health and safety requirements.  

  

**Training & Development**
--------------------------

We are committed to developing the next generation of broadcast engineers. You will benefit from:

* Structured training and mentorship from experienced Event Engineers.
* Hands-on experience with industry-leading broadcast and networking technologies.
* Exposure to premium live sports productions and global broadcast operations.
* Opportunities to travel internationally and work on major live events.
* A defined progression path toward a Broadcast Event Engineer position.

**About You**
-------------

### **Essential Skills & Experience**

* A genuine interest in live television broadcasting, transmission, or networking technologies.
* Ability to remain calm and focused in time-critical live event environments.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a practical, hands-on approach.
* Ability to follow engineering schematics, diagrams, and technical instructions.
* Experience making and testing Ethernet (RJ45) and coaxial cables.
* Basic understanding of: Video signals (SD-SDI, HD-SDI, UHD) Audio and video routing systems Microsoft Windows and Microsoft 365 Excel or Google Sheets
* Foundational IP networking knowledge, including: Basic network configuration Troubleshooting network connectivity issues Data and telemetry services
* Full UK Driving Licence.
* Valid passport and ability to travel internationally without restriction.

### **Desirable Skills & Experience**

* Qualification, apprenticeship, or certification in Broadcast Engineering, Electronics, Networking, IT, or a related discipline.
* Experience within a broadcast, networking, media, sports, or live events environment.
* Knowledge of fibre transmission technologies.
* Familiarity with MPEG encoding/decoding technologies (AVC, HEVC) and JPEG2000.
* Understanding of IP video transport technologies such as SRT, Zixi, or SMPTE ST 2110.
* Exposure to Net Insight products, including Nimbra platforms.

**Personal Attributes**
-----------------------

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Customer-focused with a positive, professional attitude.
* High attention to detail.
* Well organised and able to prioritise effectively.
* Comfortable working under pressure in fast-paced environments.
* Eager to learn and develop technical expertise.
Collaborative team player with a proactive approach.  

  

**What to Expect**
------------------

This role offers an exciting opportunity to work at the heart of live sports broadcasting. Successful candidates should be comfortable with:

* Frequent international travel and time away from home.
* Working flexible, unsociable, or extended hours, including weekends and public holidays.
* Supporting major sporting and live broadcast events in fast-paced environments.
Taking ownership of tasks while learning from experienced engineers.  

In addition, success at IMG is driven by four **core competencies** that apply to all employees:

  

**Business Acumen** – Understanding financial drivers, interpreting business data, aligning decisions to strategic outcomes

**Operational Excellence** – Driving efficiency, governance, and continuous improvement in delivery & operations

**Innovation Mindset** – Cultivating curiosity, experimentation, and forward-looking capability development

**Leadership & Collaboration** – Inspiring others, building trust, and enabling collaboration across teams

  




**TKO EEO Statement:**

TKO is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws regarding non-discrimination in employment. TKO makes employment decisions based on merit and qualifications, without considering an employee’s or applicant’s race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, or any other basis prohibited under federal, state or local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the Company has facilities. TKO also provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state or local laws. For information about Privacy and Information Security for TKO employment candidates, please review our Privacy Policy . For information regarding Terms of Use for this and other TKO websites, please review our Terms of Use.

new_jobs.description:
**Cześć!**
----------

Skoro jesteś na tej stronie, to pewnie szukasz nowego miejsca dla siebie? Świetnie się składa, bo właśnie powiększamy naszą ekipę

Na początek co nieco o nas:

Jesteśmy na rynku od 2016 roku, a od 2019 naszą specjalizacją jest healthcare

Tworzymy oprogramowanie dla medycyny, genetyki, dietetyki, rehabilitacji, farmacji, psychologii czy biomedycyny

Współpracujemy z klientami z Europy, Ameryki Północnej i Południowej

### **Kogo szukamy, czyli czy ideały istnieją**

Jako Full-stack Developer w Revolve, musisz przede wszystkim rozumieć, że programowanie nie jest sztuką dla sztuki, ale realnie rozwiązania dla prawdziwych ludzi. Programowanie jest bardzo istotnym procesem, w którym stawiamy na jakość i ścisłą współpracę z innymi osobami zaangażowanymi w tworzenie aplikacji.

Nasz zespół to zgrana ekipa. Lubimy swoją pracę, realny wpływ na tworzone rozwiązania, to że projekty, jakie realizujemy wpływają na ludzkie zdrowie i życie. Chętnie uczymy się nowych rzeczy i dzielimy się wiedzą. Stawiamy na szczere ludzkie relacje, zarówno między sobą, jak i z klientami. Jeśli chcesz do nas dołączyć, podobnych cech będziemy oczekiwać od Ciebie.

### **Jesteś naszym ideałem jeśli:**

* masz przynajmniej 4-letnie doświadczenie w programowaniu i nadal Cię to kręci
* dobrze znasz .NET
* chętnie pracujesz też na froncie React.js
* korzystasz z narzędzi AI
* rozumiesz, co to DevOps (obsługa, zarządzanie i monitorowanie Docker, Docker Compose, Github Actions, AWS CloudWatch, AWS Elastic Container Service)
* masz potrzebę nieustannego polepszania swoich technicznych i nietechnicznych umiejętności
* znasz dobre praktyki programowania i wiesz, kiedy z nich nie korzystać
* mówisz i piszesz po angielsku, a swój poziom znajomości języka oceniasz jako min. B2 (średnio zaawansowany, komunikatywny)
* jesteś osobą zaangażowaną w swoją pracę i odpowiedzialnie podchodzisz do swoich zadań
* lubisz pracować z ludźmi, nie tylko z kodem i maszynami

### **Super jeśli dodatkowo:**

* znasz SCRUM i lubisz pracować w tej metodyce
* masz wyższe techniczne wykształcenie
* ważna jest dla Ciebie jakość pracy (w branży healthcare to szczególnie istotne)
* chcesz programować też w Python i/lub Node.js
* zdarzało Ci się dłubać przy mobilce React Native, natywki
* zależy Ci na dołączeniu do branży healthcare, bo jest to spójne z Twoimi wartościami.

Wynagrodzenie

10 000 - 14 000 zł brutto UoP

12 000 - 16 900 zł netto BB

hybrydowa (biuro w Katowicach)

Nasz proces rekrutacji nie jedną osobę już zaskoczył. Stawiamy na dialog, wzajemne poznanie, ludzkie podejście i szybkość działania.

#### **1. Kontakt telefoniczny**

Kiedy dostaniemy Twoje CV - zapoznamy się z nim. Jeśli do nas pasujesz, skontaktujemy się z Tobą telefonicznie jak najszybciej.

Podczas tej rozmowy:

new_jobs.title: Senior AVEVA System Platform / OMI Engineer
new_jobs.description:
#### **Vos missions**

Great assignments await you with our key account clients in rich and varied environments

We are looking for a **Senior AVEVA System Platform / OMI Solution Expert** to join a development team responsible for a business-critical 24/7 SCADA environment supporting the real-time balancing of power assets and ancillary services across multiple European countries. The mission is part of a strategic transformation program aimed at implementing a new standardized SCADA platform based on **AVEVA System Platform / OMI** for real-time control, monitoring, and automation of industrial assets.

The consultant will play a key role in designing, developing, configuring, testing, integrating, and supporting SCADA applications used for Power Dispatch, Energy Management, Remote Dispatching Centers, renewable assets, Battery Energy Storage Systems, and interactions with Transmission System Operators. The role requires a strong hands-on engineering mindset, combining technical expertise, operational support, troubleshooting capabilities, and close collaboration with business and operational stakeholders in a critical real-time environment.

Your missions:

* Contribute to the implementation of a new generation SCADA platform based on AVEVA System Platform / OMI.
* Design and deliver solutions supporting real-time operational decision-making.
* Develop and maintain production-ready SCADA applications.
* Translate operational and business requirements into reliable technical solutions.
* Support the integration of renewable energy assets, flexible assets, and Battery Energy Storage Systems.
* Ensure system compliance with group-wide harmonization and standardization objectives.
* Support the automation of processes required for ancillary services delivery.
* Participate in all project phases from technical analysis to production deployment.
* Provide operational support and contribute to incident resolution in a 24/7 operational environment.
* Collaborate with dispatchers, analysts, developers, and operational teams to continuously improve the platform.
  

Your activities:

Development & Configuration

* Develop, test, maintain, and enhance applications based on AVEVA System Platform.
* Implement and maintain ArchestrA object templates and instances.
* Develop OMI visualization content and operator interfaces.
* Create, maintain, and optimize ASP scripts.
* Configure industrial objects and data acquisition structures.
* Participate in software design and architecture discussions.
* Contribute to workload estimations and implementation planning.

Testing & Validation

* Execute functional testing activities.
* Support Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT).
* Support Site Acceptance Tests (SAT).
* Validate software modifications before deployment.
* Troubleshoot issues identified during commissioning phases.
* Contribute to defect analysis, resolution, and product quality improvements.

Integration & Operations

* Configure and maintain AVEVA System Platform environments.
* Configure and maintain Historian integrations.
* Integrate communication protocols and industrial interfaces.
* Implement and support OPC DA, OPC UA, OPC XML communication layers.
* Implement and support Modbus TCP and Modbus Serial communications.
* Implement and support IEC-104 integrations.
* Perform troubleshooting and log analysis.
* Support production operations and incident resolution.
* Maintain system reliability, availability, and operational continuity.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

* Work closely with dispatchers, analysts, developers, and operational teams.
* Participate in Agile and SAFe ceremonies.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives.
* Share technical expertise, best practices, and lessons learned within the team.

You have the following skills:

Functional & Domain Expertise

* Industrial SCADA systems.
* Real-time operational platforms.
* Energy management environments.
* Remote dispatching and control centers.
* Ancillary services mechanisms (FCR, aFRR, mFRR, MVAr).
* Renewable energy integration.
* Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS).
* Production support in critical operational environments.

Mandatory Technical Skills

* AVEVA System Platform.
* AVEVA OMI.
* ArchestrA Object Modelling.
* ASP Scripting.
* Application troubleshooting.

Technical Experience

* AVEVA Application Server.
* Industrial SCADA development and maintenance.
* High Availability environments.
* Historian integration.
* OPC DA / OPC UA / OPC XML.
* Modbus TCP.
* Modbus Serial.
* IEC-104.
* Industrial communication protocols.
* IP network diagnostics.
* Industrial cybersecurity.
* Production incident management and support.

Education & Experience

* Master's degree in IT, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Electromechanics, or equivalent engineering discipline.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience.
* Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience with AVEVA System Platform in industrial production environments.
* Proven experience in development and maintenance of operational SCADA platforms.
* Experience working directly with operational teams.
* Experience gained with AVEVA, AVEVA-certified organizations, AVEVA ecosystem partners, or equivalent organizations is considered an asset.

Soft Skills

* Strong implementation and delivery mindset.
* Autonomous and proactive.
* Team-oriented.
* Solution-driven attitude.
* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Comfortable in critical operational environments.
* Ability to work under pressure.
* Focus on delivering reliable and maintainable solutions.

Additional Requirements

* Driving license required.
* Ability to work in a hybrid model with a minimum presence of 3 days per week on-site.

#### **Votre profil**

* You have at least 5 years of professional experiences in IT
* If you are at least fluent in FR/ENG or NL/ENG it’s best
* You’re eager to learn, motivated and curious
* Let’s have a chat !

#### **Advantages**

* Hospitalization insurance (partner/children incl.)
* Group insurance
* Dental insurance (partner/children included)
* 20 days statutory paid vacations (legal vacations cumulated for 1 year of work)
* 11 days recovery time work 38/40 per year (= annual average: 1 day per 20 days worked) if the client asks you to work 8h/day
* Representation fee net per month.
* Internet fee of € 40 per month.
* Company car with national fuel card OR Public transport reimbursed OR mobility package.
* Daily fee of 5.50€ net /day provided.
* Subscription GSM unlimited calls for Belgium (ITS subscription)
* Training plan (e-learning - certification at ITS charge)

**Extra advantages:**

* Being a rather small team in BE (6 in back-office), we’re very close to each of our consultants and we differentiate ourselves trying to really take care of you and make you grow with us and within our different clients.
* Regular follow-up (every 3 to 6months depending on your needs/will)
* Regular teambuilding to meet-up and have fun (every 3 months more or less)
* Flexibility and trust
* Benefits of still being part to a bigger group (ITS Group) and having access to resources and of a larger team of Experts
* Co-optation system because sharing is caring!

#### **Processus de recrutement**

* 1st pre-screening on the phone to discuss about your search and conditions and our first potential opportunities matching.
* Job descriptions sent and Teams meeting fixed with us (HR and Sales) to dig into your experience and the role.
* Package proposal so we all agree beforehand.
* Your CV is sent to the different clients you’ve agreed to, to find the best mission for you!
